chapters.title: Chapter 151: The Enemy Base
paragraphs: "What in the world am I seeing?" Kai was stunned at the sight of this A.I. Base...
It was nothing like what he had imagined. There were no high walls or heavy fortifications. Instead, farms stretched around the compound, and humans were the ones tending them.
Their bodies were thin, their faces looked so hollow, and their movements were sluggish from exhaustion.
Kai was unable to comprehend this situation.
"Why would the A.I. use humans for labor? Machines are more efficient... The A.I. should know that better... This doesn’t make sense. Is this some kind of punishment?"
Kai suddenly remembered.
The mechanized army had used humans as meatshields before. Althea and Sera were the living proof of that since they had once been dragged into battle as expendable bodies.
Kai had also seen it with his own eyes. This was no different.
The A.I. didn’t care about efficiency. Maybe it cared about control, about breaking humanity piece by piece.
Kai’s grip tightened on his hatchet.

He knew what had to be done. This wasn’t just for the experience points and not just for the Leaderboard... but to free those people, and to strike back at the machines that thought they could enslave humanity.
He turned to Atom... "We’re attacking this place..."
Down in the fields, one of the slaves wiped sweat from his brow.
His name was Noli.
Over the past three years, every morning began the same.
The barracks doors clanged open, chains rattled, and the humans were driven out into the fields.
The Sentinels marched beside them, and they never spoke.
However, many loudspeakers mounted on the fences and walls of the building gave out announcements for everyone to hear.
"Row Four, begin planting. Row Five, continue watering. Row Six, start harvesting. Any failure to comply will be punished."
Noli then moved forward with the others. At this time, his stomach was already hollow, and his body had become thin from weeks of nutrient paste.
Still, he didn’t want to die!
’I must live...’
Although the gray sludge they were fed at dawn was tasteless, barely enough to keep him upright, he would still eat it to regain his strength.
"Just another day... I can do this..." He reminded himself as he looked at the field.
It seemed as if the fields stretched endlessly.
There were rows of beans, cabbage, and other leaves forced from the soil by starving people...
The atmosphere around them was thick with dust, sweat, and the acrid trace of machine oil. Even drones hovered overhead, recording every movement.
There was simply no way of escaping this place!
If someone slowed, a shock baton cracked against their back.
If someone collapsed, they were dragged away, and Noli never saw them again.
He had learned to keep his head down, to move just fast enough to avoid punishment, but never so fast that he wasted precious strength.
Around him, the world felt like a cage.
There were crude fences marking the perimeter, towers that could be seen ahead with automated turrets, and the sensors of Sentinels that swept across the surroundings to watch them work.
Soon at night, they were locked in cramped quarters, the loudspeakers announcing curfew before shutting off.
Sleep came in fragments as it was broken by hunger, fear, and the rattling of chains.
Noli no longer remembered freedom, but he remembered fear. Fear of punishment, fear of being discarded like the others...
"What’s going on?"
After a few days, rumors had spread among the slaves.
Some of the Sentinels that usually patrolled the perimeter hadn’t returned!
The machines gave no explanation, but the absence was clear.
Noli dared not speak of it aloud, but in his heart, he wondered...
’Could this mean someone out there is fighting back?’
A few days ago, when Kai had discovered this place, he didn’t immediately attack... He knew that there was no way for the two of them to win against these A.I. Soldiers.
With that in mind, he began to study the patrol routes. The Sentinels moved in groups of three or four, circling the perimeter like clockwork.
Their sensors swept the fields, scanning for threats, but they never expected a hunter waiting in the shadows.
"Let’s weaken their army... Let’s do this."
With his Keen Sense active, every vibration, every metallic step echoed in his mind.
He could tell the difference between the heavier tread of a C‐Grade unit and the lighter, quicker movements of an E or D-Grade.
"They’re here..." Kai muttered as he hid himself...
The first group came into view.
There were three E‐Grade Sentinels armed with rifles.
"Atom... Let’s be silent on this. Quick Kill... Ok?" Kai said as he reminded Atom.
Then, Kai tightened his grip on the hatchet. He had fought stronger enemies before, but he felt a little nervous still.
But a huge Tyrant had once tested every ounce of his strength. Compared to that, these were nothing!
"Here we go..." Kai muttered as he triggered Specter Step!
He moved really fast thanks to this Ability.
"Haa!"
Soon, one quick dash, and the hatchet cleaved through the nearest Sentinel’s neck joint.
Thud!
Sparks erupted as its body collapsed.
Before the others could react, Kai’s blade spun in his hand, striking the second across its ’eyes’ or sensors.
The third Sentinel then raised its weapon, but Atom’s shot rang out, piercing its core.
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Sentinel (E) ]
[ +200 Experience Points ]
Three down!
Kai dragged the wreckage into the brush, as he needed to hide the evidence. He knew the machines would notice eventually, but every delay bought him time.
The next patrol was tougher... He found four D‐Grade Sentinels...

"Still reasonable..." Kai muttered as he slowly recalled the rhythm of his fight against the Tyrants and other fast-moving mechanized soldiers like the Hounds. He had learned then that brute force wasn’t enough and precision mattered!
Kai waited until the patrol passed a narrow alley between two ruined structures outside the base.
When the moment came, he struck. His hatchet smashed into the first Sentinel’s knee joint, knocking it off balance.
Thud!
As the machine fell, Kai vaulted over its body and drove the blade into the second Sentinel’s chest plate. Atom then dashed from cover, hitting the third and keeping it distracted.
The fourth Sentinel charged. But Kai noticed this immediately and turned sharply, dodging the strike, then countered with a clean slash that cut off its weapon arm.
"Ha!"
He finished it with a crushing blow to its core!
Another Sentinel was down!
Night after night, Kai repeated this process, eliminating patrols in small groups and leaving fewer machines to guard the base!

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Latest Update
paragraphs: By the third night, the absence of many Sentinels was undeniable.
Patrol routes were broken, gaps widened, and Kai was able to hunt more efficiently.
The loudspeakers continued their cold announcements, but the Sentinels guarding the slaves were fewer.
At this time, Kai wiped the oil from his blade as his eyes fixed on the compound.
"One more..." he muttered.

Just like that, Kai made another operation, eliminating a group of three D-Grade Sentinels! Then, as he finished his ambush, he immediately ran towards a safe spot as the effect of the Chameleon Cloak disappeared.
It was the cloak he previously purchased from the Gene Trader, worth 5 Survivor Medals.
[ Chameleon Cloak (Rare): A cloak made of adaptive fibers that blend with the environment, reducing visibility.
Effects:
- Reduces enemy detection range by 50%.
- Active Skill: Camouflage- briefly blends with surroundings for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
Restrictions:
- Less effective in brightly lit areas.
- Cannot be worn with heavy armor.
Durability: 84/100 ]
"Whew~ Another operation done for the day... I think I need another two weeks to completely weaken their strength." Kai muttered as he turned to Atom, who was also wearing a cloak.
Needless to say, he had also purchased this from the Gene Trader at the Treehouse together with many other special items and gene serums.
Then, as Kai was about to return to the Shelter with his loot of Energy Cores, rifles, and other materials, he was bombarded by notifications!
Ding!
[ System Update: Monthly Rankings Concluded! ]
[ Survivor Leaderboard - Cycle 1 Complete ]
[ Requirement: Level 10+ ]
[ All calculations finalized. Rewards are now being distributed. ]
[ Congratulations, Survivor Kai! ]
[ You have achieved Rank 1 in the Monthly Leaderboard. ]
[ Special Rewards have been granted. ]
Kai’s eyes widened as the glowing text appeared before him. "So... it’s already the end of the month," he muttered, realizing what the message meant.

He remembered clearly... Thirty days ago, when the Leaderboard first appeared, he had been the very first survivor to enter the rankings at Level 10. Back then, reaching that milestone had taken him time and effort after arriving in this world.
Now, only a month later, he was staring at the results with a different kind of shock. His name stood at the very top, and his level had already climbed to 30.
It was such a satisfying feeling...
Soon, he got to check the various rewards.
[ Rank 1 Special Rewards ]
[ Title Acquired: Strongest One
Effect: Increases all base attributes (Strength, Agility, Endurance, Perception) by +5%.
Grants passive intimidation effect against lower‐ranked human enemies. ]
"A new title... And it’s even calling me the strongest? Nice..." Kai muttered as he confirmed that this was indeed an exclusive title for Rank 1 Survivor in the Leaderboard.
Still, it didn’t end there...
[ Item Acquired: Talent Upgrade Crystal x1
Effect: Can be used to permanently upgrade one existing Talent to the next tier.
If applied to a maxed Talent, it unlocks hidden evolution potential.
Single‐use, bound to the player. ]
[ Reputation Points +10 ]
[ Note: Reputation Store will activate upon reaching Level 31.
Reputation Points can be exchanged for rare items, unique skills, or certain privileges.
Current Balance: 50 Points. ]
Kai was shocked as he saw the Talent Upgrade Crystal. It was something he really needed to obtain!
Furthermore, he finally got a hint about the purpose of the Reputation Points that he had been accumulating over the past month!
It was actually for a Reputation Store that would only activate at Level 31!
"Perfect..." Kai muttered as he checked the next window.
[ Bonus Reward: Survival Supply Crate (x3)
Contents: Randomized consumables, weapon parts, and enhancement materials.
Guaranteed: Rare Weapon Component x1
Guaranteed: Healing Serum x1 ]
[ Bonus Reward: Specialized Gene Skill Crystal (Mid-Grade) x1 ]

"Nice..." Kai liked the Supply Crate as he needed some upgrades for his weapons and equipment. Furthermore, he also had Random Gene Skill Crystals with him, but he decided to hold them off for now since they were random skills.
This time, however, he finally got a Specialized Gene Skill Crystal, and it meant that it would give him a Skill according to his current Gene Enhancements, physique, vitality, and other details.
[ Leaderboard Summary - Cycle 1 ]
Rank 1: Kai - Level 30
Rank 2: Claire - Level 22
Rank 3: Mei - Level 21
Rank 3 Top 20 Survivors have received Basic Rewards.
[ Reminder: Cycle 2 begins immediately. Rankings reset. ]
[ Next distribution in 30 days. ]
"So it’s Claire and... Mei?" Kai was stunned as he saw the name once again...
He actually saw her in the World Chat already. Mei was asking for his full name was but he couldn’t just announce it in the World Chat, could he?
After all, it will be revealed to everyone in the world, and he didn’t feel good about that.
Instead, he decided to just act like he didn’t read it yet. If there were a Private Message function. He’s certainly going to give a reply without hesitation.
Then, he turned his attention to the Talent Upgrade Crystal in his inventory.
Without hesitation, Kai took out the crystal.
It glowed faintly red in his hand... Soon, he opened his status window and focused on his talent.

[ Infinite Gift Pack (SSS): You can claim an unlimited number of Basic Gift Packs at any time. There are no restrictions on frequency, quantity, or type. This talent grants continuous access to supplies, ensuring that Gift Packs are always available whenever you choose to obtain them. ]
He wanted to remember this Talent as it would change from now.
Kai then activated the crystal.
Ding!
[ Talent Upgrade Crystal Activated! ]
[ Select Talent to Upgrade... ]
Kai immediately chose his only Talent...
’I guess it means that it’s possible to obtain other Talent? Interesting...’He mused.
Ding!
[ Talent already at the highest rank (SSS). ]
[ Adjustment: Upgrade effect applied. ]
[ Talent Enhanced! ]
The window shifted, and new text appeared:

[ Infinite Gift Pack (SSS): You can claim an unlimited number of Basic or Enhanced Gift Packs at any time. There are no restrictions on frequency, quantity, or type. Enhanced Gift Packs contain higher‐grade supplies, equipment, and consumables compared to Basic Gift Packs. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 153: The Artisan
paragraphs: Ding!
[ Notification: Talent Upgrade complete. ]
[ Current Talent: Infinite Gift Pack (SSS) ]
[ Reminder: Further evolution possible with additional Talent Upgrade Crystals. ]
Kai exhaled slowly after seeing the crystal dissolving into light.
"Perfect... this is exactly what I needed."
He couldn’t help but smile as soon as he confirmed the improvement!
"And I can actually get both the Basic and Enhanced versions of gift packs! This is amazing!"
There was no way he wouldn’t be excited about this.
Without hesitiation Kai checked his current status.
[ Name: Kai ]
[ Title: Skilled Survivor, Trailblazer, Siege Breaker, Guardian, Strongest One ]
[ Level: 30 ]
[ Physique Rating: C ]
[ Talent: Infinite Gift Pack (SSS) ]
[ Active Skills: Spirit Pulse Lv5, Specter Step Lv3, Fast Appraisal Lv2 ]
[ Passive Skills: Keen Sense Lv5, Bio Adaptive Constitution Lv5, Battle Trance Lv3, Bronze Skin Lv2 ]
[ Skill Points: 4 ]

Kai smiled as he saw his Skill level up. Obviously, most of it was thanks to his Trailblazer Title, which made his Skill Mastery improve quickly. The 30% boost was just too incredible if he used the skill every time.
After all, his Siege Breaker Title gives him fast Spirit Recovery, allowing him to use Gene Skills more times than others.
Anyway, now that he had an Enhanced Gift Pack, it was time to say goodbye to his revolver that could only fire six bullets!
He knew already that the Weapons Gift Pack in this new version would provide a semi‐automatic pistol with 17 rounds in each magazine.
Without a doubt, his revolvers could now retire. At the very least, he would let his subordinates take care of them.

Furthermore, no more Free Gift Packs... It was possible for Basic Gift Packs, but they really had to pay him with Survivor Medals, Energy Cores, or other things if they wanted his Enhanced Gift Packs!
Soon, he triggered his Talent, and a familiar menu appeared.
[ Basic Gift Pack Selection ]
[ Enhanced Gift Pack Selection ]
As expected, he now had two options!
He then swiftly checked the Enhanced Gift Pack and soon, the 10 options appeared. They were all similar, but they had an enhanced description on them.
[ Enhanced Energy Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Entertainment Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Food Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Medical Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Shelter Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Stealth Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Survival Tools Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Transport Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Water Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Weapon Gift Pack ]
He had first encountered this version of this after reaching Level 10. Thanks to that, he was already quite familiar with the items he could get from them.
Still, he wanted to make sure of it!
Then, he selected the Weapon Gift Pack and swiftly opened it!
[ You have selected Weapon Gift Pack (Enhanced) ]
Then, Kai opened it from his inventory, and soon, various items appeared in front of him.
There was the familiar semi‐automatic pistol with five spare magazines.
There was also an axe, a combat knife, a holster for his gun, and finally, two boxes of extra ammunition, and each box contained 40 bullets each!
Kai’s eyes lit up as he held the pistol in his hands.
The weight was solid, balanced, and far superior to the revolver he had relied on until now. Seventeen rounds per magazine... it was a massive improvement in firepower and reliability.
He gave the weapon a quick inspection, sliding the magazine in place and pulling the slide back with a satisfyingclick.
"This... this is exactly what I needed," he muttered.
It was similar to the pistol he got before, but that one was just stored back in the shelter since he no longer had any bullets.
"Alright! You’re mine now..."

Without hesitation, Kai holstered the new pistol at his side. He placed his old revolver back into its holster, deciding to keep it as a backup, while the spare revolvers and ammunition were packed into his backpack. After all, once items were opened from a Gift Pack, they couldn’t be returned to his inventory.
Then, the axe and combat knife were strapped securely...
Everything had its place since Kai was meticulous about his gear.
Satisfied, he adjusted the Chameleon Cloak around his shoulders and glanced at Atom, who was already prepared to move.
"Let’s head back," Kai said firmly.
Together, they slipped away from the compound, leaving behind the broken patrol routes...
As for the slaves trapped inside the A.I. base, Kai could only hope they continued to endure. Their time would come, but for now, survival was all they had.
With his new weapon and enhanced talent, Kai knew that he’d be able to conquer this base really soon!
In the meantime, Elena had just finished tending to the injured scouts.

Russel and Augustine seemed to have encountered Dragoons and were injured in the battle. Both had suffered deep lacerations from the mechanized blades, and Russel’s arm was fractured when he tried to block a strike. Augustine had burns across his shoulder from a Dragoon’s plasma shot, leaving him weak and barely able to move.
Although she wasn’t blessed with healing Talents or medical Gene Skills, she had something just as valuable, her training as a registered nurse back on Earth.
That knowledge allowed her to assist Irene, the head nurse, with diagnosis, wound care, and basic treatment.
Even without system‐granted abilities, Elena’s steady hands and calm presence made her indispensable.
But her true gift lay elsewhere...
When the system had first awakened her Talent, it wasn’t combat‐related.
Instead, it was production‐based talent!
[ Artisan (Master): Greatly improves efficiency and quality when crafting weapons, armor, and tools. Crafted items gain durability and minor stat bonuses. ]
This Talent had quickly turned Elena into the shelter’s workshop specialist... or so she thought.

After all, they do not really have many materials she could use aside from the scavenged parts of the Sentinels, Hounds, and other Mechanized Soldiers. Furthermore, there was a limit to her Rare Talent...
"Kai... I’ll make sure that you won’t regret giving this to me..." Elena muttered as she looked at the Blueprint in her hands!

sentences.text: Ding!
[ Notification: Talent Upgrade complete. ]
[ Current Talent: Infinite Gift Pack (SSS) ]
[ Reminder: Further evolution possible with additional Talent Upgrade Crystals. ]
Kai exhaled slowly after seeing the crystal dissolving into light.
"Perfect... this is exactly what I needed."
He couldn’t help but smile as soon as he confirmed the improvement!
"And I can actually get both the Basic and Enhanced versions of gift packs!
This is amazing!"
There was no way he wouldn’t be excited about this.
Without hesitiation Kai checked his current status.
[ Name: Kai ]
[ Title: Skilled Survivor, Trailblazer, Siege Breaker, Guardian, Strongest One ]
[ Level: 30 ]
[ Physique Rating: C ]
[ Talent: Infinite Gift Pack (SSS) ]
[ Active Skills: Spirit Pulse Lv5, Specter Step Lv3, Fast Appraisal Lv2 ]
[ Passive Skills: Keen Sense Lv5, Bio Adaptive Constitution Lv5, Battle Trance Lv3, Bronze Skin Lv2 ]
[ Skill Points: 4 ]
Kai smiled as he saw his Skill level up.
Obviously, most of it was thanks to his Trailblazer Title, which made his Skill Mastery improve quickly.
The 30% boost was just too incredible if he used the skill every time.
After all, his Siege Breaker Title gives him fast Spirit Recovery, allowing him to use Gene Skills more times than others.
Anyway, now that he had an Enhanced Gift Pack, it was time to say goodbye to his revolver that could only fire six bullets!
He knew already that the Weapons Gift Pack in this new version would provide a semi‐automatic pistol with 17 rounds in each magazine.
Without a doubt, his revolvers could now retire.
At the very least, he would let his subordinates take care of them.
Furthermore, no more Free Gift Packs...
It was possible for Basic Gift Packs, but they really had to pay him with Survivor Medals, Energy Cores, or other things if they wanted his Enhanced Gift Packs!
Soon, he triggered his Talent, and a familiar menu appeared.
[ Basic Gift Pack Selection ]
[ Enhanced Gift Pack Selection ]
As expected, he now had two options!
He then swiftly checked the Enhanced Gift Pack and soon, the 10 options appeared.
They were all similar, but they had an enhanced description on them.
[ Enhanced Energy Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Entertainment Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Food Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Medical Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Shelter Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Stealth Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Survival Tools Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Transport Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Water Gift Pack ]
[ Enhanced Weapon Gift Pack ]
He had first encountered this version of this after reaching Level 10.
Thanks to that, he was already quite familiar with the items he could get from them.
Still, he wanted to make sure of it!
Then, he selected the Weapon Gift Pack and swiftly opened it!
[ You have selected Weapon Gift Pack (Enhanced) ]
Then, Kai opened it from his inventory, and soon, various items appeared in front of him.
There was the familiar semi‐automatic pistol with five spare magazines.
There was also an axe, a combat knife, a holster for his gun, and finally, two boxes of extra ammunition, and each box contained 40 bullets each!
Kai’s eyes lit up as he held the pistol in his hands.
The weight was solid, balanced, and far superior to the revolver he had relied on until now.
Seventeen rounds per magazine... it was a massive improvement in firepower and reliability.
He gave the weapon a quick inspection, sliding the magazine in place and pulling the slide back with a satisfyingclick.
"This... this is exactly what I needed," he muttered.
It was similar to the pistol he got before, but that one was just stored back in the shelter since he no longer had any bullets.
"Alright!
You’re mine now..."
Without hesitation, Kai holstered the new pistol at his side.
He placed his old revolver back into its holster, deciding to keep it as a backup, while the spare revolvers and ammunition were packed into his backpack.
After all, once items were opened from a Gift Pack, they couldn’t be returned to his inventory.
Then, the axe and combat knife were strapped securely...
Everything had its place since Kai was meticulous about his gear.
Satisfied, he adjusted the Chameleon Cloak around his shoulders and glanced at Atom, who was already prepared to move.
"Let’s head back," Kai said firmly.
Together, they slipped away from the compound, leaving behind the broken patrol routes...
As for the slaves trapped inside the A.I. base, Kai could only hope they continued to endure.
Their time would come, but for now, survival was all they had.
With his new weapon and enhanced talent, Kai knew that he’d be able to conquer this base really soon!
In the meantime, Elena had just finished tending to the injured scouts.
Russel and Augustine seemed to have encountered Dragoons and were injured in the battle.
Both had suffered deep lacerations from the mechanized blades, and Russel’s arm was fractured when he tried to block a strike.
Augustine had burns across his shoulder from a Dragoon’s plasma shot, leaving him weak and barely able to move.
Although she wasn’t blessed with healing Talents or medical Gene Skills, she had something just as valuable, her training as a registered nurse back on Earth.
That knowledge allowed her to assist Irene, the head nurse, with diagnosis, wound care, and basic treatment.
Even without system‐granted abilities, Elena’s steady hands and calm presence made her indispensable.
But her true gift lay elsewhere...
When the system had first awakened her Talent, it wasn’t combat‐related.
Instead, it was production‐based talent!
[ Artisan (Master): Greatly improves efficiency and quality when crafting weapons, armor, and tools.
Crafted items gain durability and minor stat bonuses. ]
This Talent had quickly turned Elena into the shelter’s workshop specialist... or so she thought.
After all, they do not really have many materials she could use aside from the scavenged parts of the Sentinels, Hounds, and other Mechanized Soldiers.
Furthermore, there was a limit to her Rare Talent...
"Kai...
I’ll make sure that you won’t regret giving this to me..." Elena muttered as she looked at the Blueprint in her hands!

chapters.title: Chapter 154: Under Attack
paragraphs: Although Elena had made her own necklace and started knitting when she was still a college student back on Earth, she could never say that she was an artisan at all.
So the moment she selected the A.I. Rebellion over Alien Invasion and Ragnarok, she was extremely surprised to see her Artisan Talent!
It was definitely a useless talent when fighting against the Mechanized Soldiers, unless she was able to make a decent weapon with it.
Thankfully, after so many things that had happened to her after entering this land, she was able to stay alive. She was even lucky enough to be with the Rank 1 Survivor!
She really felt safer here compared to when she was still in Haven-40, where several high-level Augmented Humans were located. After all, the A.I. wasn’t sending strong mechanized soldiers to them.
’Yes... Having low-level Survivors is still the best. We’re not being targeted by the A.I. Army... Maybe they assessed our threat-level as extremely low or something.’Elena thought.
Thanks to that, she was able to know more about the usage of her Talent.
While others fought to get Experience points, she could just build something, and it would give her Experience Points ranging from 10 to 30 Points.
It was definitely very low since she could get about 300 to 400 Points if she participated in the destruction of a single Sentinel.
However, this was a very safe method!
Now, back in her workshop, she laid out the blueprint Kai had given her.
Soon, the glowing interface hovered above the workbench...
[ Weapon Blueprint: Steelbreaker Sword
Grade: C
A longsword design focused on durability and reach.
The blade structure is strengthened to withstand repeated strikes against armored targets.
Requires standard forging tools and refined metal to craft.
Optimized grip and weight distribution allow steady handling during prolonged use. ]
[ Do you want to learn the Blueprint? ]
[ Warning: Learning this Blueprint will consume the item. Once learned, you will permanently gain the ability to craft the Steelbreaker Sword, even without prior forging knowledge. ]
[ Note: Weapons crafted directly by you will retain system effects. Copies made by ordinary craftsmen will not inherit system effects. ]
Elena looked at the message, and after thanking Kai in her mind, she finally accepted it.
She pressed confirm, and soon, she received a confirmation!
Ding!
[ Blueprint Learned: Steelbreaker Sword ]
The blueprint dissolved into light, merging with her body...
Elena smiled faintly as she saw this.
She wasn’t a warrior like Farrah, Alfie, and others... but with every weapon she forged, she was also participating in their battle against the A.I. Army!
Of course, Elena’s first step was to confirm the materials she needed for the Steelbreaker Sword. The system window listed them clearly...
[ Required Materials:
Refined Steel Plate x2
Iron Ingots x2
Copper Ingot x1
Leather Strips x2
Binding Resin x1 ]
She nodded slowly. "So it’s not just steel... copper is part of the alloying process. Interesting."
Elena quickly checked the warehouse inventory. Thankfully, they had enough refined steel and iron ingots stored from system rewards or maybe previous scavenging runs.
The leather strips had been salvaged from old gear, and resin was available, thanks to the previous shelter. Their supplies were tight, but workable.
However, she couldn’t help but recall her current situation.
[ Crafting Station Required: Forge ]
[ Status: Not Available ]
She sighed. "Of course... we don’t have one."
Still, with her talent, she knew that she could make one.
She just needed some stone blocks, an iron frame, and a fire source...

Elena tapped her chin thoughtfully. They had stone blocks from dismantled ruins, iron frames from broken machinery, and even perhaps energy cores salvaged from a destroyed Sentine for the fire source...
"I can do this..."
It was definitely possible. It would take time, but she could build it.
Just as she was planning the construction, another notification appeared.
"Hmm?"
Ding!
[ System Update: Monthly Rankings Concluded! ]
[ Survivor Leaderboard - Cycle 1 Complete ]
[ Requirement: Level 10+ ]
[ All calculations finalized. Rewards are now being distributed. ]
Elena blinked at the glowing text. She hadn’t expected to be included, so she wasn’t really excited about this Ranking.
Still, she was curious to see whether she’d find familiar items.
"Ohhh... It’s finally done... I wonder if Claire got surpassed by that Renji guy." Elena muttered as they talkedabout them.
[ Congratulations, Survivor Elena! ]
[ You have survived the first cycle. ]
[ Although you are not part of the Top 20 Survivors, recognition is granted for endurance. ]
[ Reward: Basic Survival Gift Pack x1 ]
[ Reminder: Cycle 2 begins immediately. Rankings reset. ]
[ Next distribution in 30 days. ]
Elena exhaled softly, a faint smile tugging at her lips. She wasn’t a fighter, not like Kai or the others. But the system still acknowledged her survival, and it felt really good.
She then placed the Basic Survival Gift Pack aside and turned back to her plans.
The forge would be her next project.
Once it was built, the Steelbreaker Sword would be more than a blueprint... It would become a real weapon, forged by her hands, and ready to be wielded against the A.I. Army!
After some time, as Elena was still organizing the materials for the forge, a sudden alarm blared through the shelter.
Her heart skipped as she knew that the sound only meant one thing... they were under attack.
Almost immediately, the sharp sound of gunfire echoed from outside!
It was then followed by the heavy thud of explosions!
Boom! Boom!
The shelter walls trembled faintly, and shouts rang out as defenders rushed to their positions. Elena froze for a moment, realizing the worst... Kai and Atom weren’t back yet!
"This is bad..." she whispered as she quickly left the workshop...
Thankfully, the shelter wasn’t defenseless!
Claire, the reliable but fierce leader of Assault Team A, was already giving orders, rallying her squad to the front lines.
At the same time, Ralph also took command of Assault Team B, directing them to support Claire’s team with their rifles and revolvers!
Elena took a deep breath as she knew what she had to do...
There would be plenty of injured Survivors later, so she must return to the infirmary!
’These damn A.I. Soldiers...’

chapters.title: Chapter 155: The Rank 2 Survivor
paragraphs: "Hmmm... this is nice. Victor really worked hard," Claire muttered with satisfaction as she appreciated the comfort she was enjoying.
At this moment, steam rose gently from the wooden tub as she let the warmth soak into her skin.
Finally, after arriving at this shelter, she was no longer bathing in cold water!
It was warm, thanks to Victor’s successful restoration of the heater.
Though they had to rely on batteries and energy cores since the generator was broken, Victor had still managed to improvise a solution.
"Improving my skill masteries through sparring is really slow compared to a real battle... should I join Kai’s hunt tomorrow?" Claire murmured as she washed her body.
The battle drills earlier that morning had left her muscles aching, and they had barely increased her Skill Mastery.
For now, she could only relax and enjoy the rare luxury of a peaceful bath.
Whoosh~
As she stood up, her long hair clung damply to her shoulders, framing her face in a way that highlighted her beautiful features.
Claire had always tried to look tough since this was an Apocalypse World. But here, alone, she allowed a softer side to show.

She reached for the towel beside her, drying herself off before slipping into the new clothes they had recently obtained... Thanks to their tailor from Haven-45, she was able to wear a fitted black top and durable trousers made from the fabric they obtained through the Material Treasure Chest!
Furthermore, the fabric was smoother, stronger, and far more comfortable than the ragged outfits they had.
She then admired the way the outfit hugged her figure.
"Finally... something that feels like real clothing again," she murmured...
If possible, she wanted her Material Treasure Chest to provide her with more rolls of fabric, but unfortunately, it wasn’t easy to get them since they were randomized.
In any case, from her small bag containing her personal belongings, she retrieved a glass vial...
It was a perfume she purchased from the Gene Trader by paying a few hundred Experience Points.
It was a luxury and seemed almost frivolous compared to weapons and medicine, but Claire had insisted on buying it.
Clunk...
A single dab at her neck released a subtle fragrance. It was floral, a reminder of the world that had once existed before the machines... and it wasn’t just meant to delay others.
She smiled faintly. "Even in war, a woman deserves to feel human."
Just then, the familiar chime of the system echoed in her ears.
Ding!
[ System Update: Monthly Rankings Concluded! ]
"Ohhhh! It’s finally here!" Claire couldn’t help but celebrate as soon as she saw the message!
She actually felt a little nervous just now, thinking that there was another event they had to prepare for.
She hadn’t been paying attention to the calendar, but of course, thirty days had passed.
[ Congratulations, Survivor Claire! ]
[ You have achieved Rank 2 in the Monthly Leaderboard. ]
[ Special Rewards have been granted. ]
Her eyes were filled with excitement...
At first, she hadn’t really expected to climb so high.
However, thanks to the wealth she had obtained through her sheer efforts and Vale’s assistance, her talent made her incredibly stronger!
Kai was untouchable at Rank 1, but to be second meant her efforts had not gone unnoticed.
She quickly opened the reward window.
[ Rank 2 Rewards ]
[ Title Acquired: Stronger
Effect: Increases defense and resistance to physical damage by +4%. When engaged in battle, your body adapts against impact, reducing the chance of being stunned or knocked down.
[ Item Acquired: Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum x1
Effect: Permanently increases base stats upon consumption. Small chance of awakening a Gene Skill. ]
[ Item Acquired: Talent Upgrade Fragment (1/5) x1
Effect: Can be collected to upgrade one existing Talent to the next tier. ]
After seeing the new Title and the Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum, Claire was already very happy with the reward as a second placer.
However, there was actually a chant to upgrade her Talent!
"Talent Upgrade Fragment, huh... and I need to collect four more. Interesting." Claire’s smile widened as she realized that she might be able to control the greediness of her spirit with this!
However, it still didn’t end there!
[ Reputation Points +5 ]
[ Current Balance: 20 Points ]
[ Bonus Reward: Tactical Supply Crate (x2) ]
Contents: Ammunition, combat gear, and combat rations.
Guaranteed: Rare Armor Component x1. ]
"Oh? Am I having a new combat gear? Sweet..." Claire’s lips curved into a satisfied smile.
"It’s a good thing I worked so hard over the past few days. I surpassed that Renji guy."
To be honest, Claire also knew that she was very lucky... If she hadn’t met Kai, there was no way for her to unleash the full power of her Talent.
After all, it was dependent on the treasures she owned!
In this Apocalypse, she’d be extremely lucky to find valuables that weren’t claimed by others.
There were other Foreign Survivors like her, Local Survivors, even Augmented Humans lurking around... So accumulating wealth would not be easy.
In any case, after drying her hair, she took out the Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum and confirmed that it was similar.
’It’s definitely similar in terms of quality and effects, but why does it feel shinier compared to the ones I got before?’
Anyway, it was tempting to use it immediately, but she decided to wait until she returned to her room.
"I wonder what the others got..."
Claire muttered as she could hear everyone getting excited.
They were definitely receiving their rewards right now.

Soon, her thoughts drifted briefly to Kai. He was out there, weakening the A.I. patrols and carving a path for them all. It was a pity she couldn’t join him now, but she also knew her role was just as vital.

Kai often spent more than fourteen hours outside, sometimes even longer, and without leadership inside the shelter, chaos would quickly take hold. With that in mind, she had to remain within the shelter... or at the very least, avoid straying too far.
She had to make sure Kai had a place to return to.
As she finished dressing, another sound suddenly pierced the air...
Clang! Clang! Clang!
It was the alarm for enemy sightings.
Claire froze, and moments later, the rapid burst of gunfire reached her ears.

Claire frowned in confusion.
Their shelter had plenty of revolvers, but rifles were scarce.
Unlike the revolvers supplied by Kai through his Talent, the rifles they possessed had been stolen directly from mechanized soldiers.
Ammunition for them was even rarer. After all, high‐caliber rounds were difficult to replace.

That meant one thing... if the defenders were using rifles, the threat outside wasn’t just Hounds or Sentinels. It had to be something stronger, something dangerous enough to justify spending their limited rifle ammunition.
She suddenly felt nervous as she tossed the perfume aside. She then snatched up her own rifle and sprinted toward the command post.
The corridors were already becoming chaotic...
Survivors were shouting, boots pounding against the floor, weapons being readied as everyone scrambled to defensive positions.
’Good... Ralph and Farrah are taking control...’
Claire thought as she quickly moved.
She realized that the attack this time wasn’t a routine skirmish. The shelter was facing a serious assault.
Since Kai and Atom, the strongest fighters of the shelter, weren’t back yet, they had to protect this place!
Thud!
Claire burst out of the main building to immediately assess the situation.
The battle was already raging on the shelter’s simple wall... It was a crude barrier reinforced by scavenged steel and stone that was now under assault by the enemies!
Her eyes widened.
Ten Dragoons circled above the wall defenders!
These flying vehicles were moving through the sky with unnerving agility that made them difficult to target with their guns!
Each one carried a Sentinel rider, and as they swooped closer, the riders dropped to the ground!
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Just like that, ten Sentinels landed on the earth below, while the Dragoons remained overhead, unleashing streams of gunfire from their mounted weapons!
Claire felt a little nervous... This wasn’t a simple raid after being scouted, it was a coordinated strike!
’A.I. Aria... They must be aware of the location of our base by now...’
However, there was no need to worry about that right now!
Thankfully, Farrah and Alfie were already on duty.
Farrah, the Spirit Knight, stood firm at the wall. She seemed unfazed by the enemies surrounding them!
Then, Claire’s eyes widened as she saw it... a hazy wave of energy radiated outward from Farrah, slowing and deflecting the bullets raining down from above!
"What is that?!" Claire was shocked. This was her first time witnessing such a Gene Skill in action, and the sight filled her with awe.
Alfie, the Gladiator, was no less terrifying.
With a sudden burst of strength, he leapt unnaturally high, soaring toward a Dragoon that had dipped too low!
His hands clamped around the machine’s head, and with vicious force, he crushed it, sending sparks and destroyed metal raining down.
"Die for me!" Alfie shouted as he landed on the ground.
Just like that, the Dragoon also spiraled out of control, crashing into the ground with its merged pilot!
Boom!
Claire immediately guessed that Farrah obtained a barrier-like Gene Skill while Alfie obtained some kind of Leaping skill!
After all, that jump was more than five meters!
No ordinary Survivors could do that. It could only be done with Gene Skill or perhaps a special item that could help them do so.
Meanwhile, Wallace and his team of Wall Defenders kept the Sentinels pinned.
Their rifles and revolvers fired in unison, suppressing the humanoid machines before they could advance.
Wallace himself moved with incredible speed. He was moving across the ramparts faster than Claire had ever seen.
’His Swift Stride Skill must have reached a new level... perhaps even evolved into something greater.’
He was practically like a blur, repositioning between firing points and keeping the defenders coordinated.
Claire finally realized why Kai adamantly set Wallace as the leader of the Wall Defenders. He’d certainly be capable of protecting them from invasion!
Still, the mechanized army was not stopping until their cores were destroyed.
Claire’s gaze shifted to Ralph, leader of Assault Team B.
Before she could even gather her team, Ralph was already on the battlefield with his team!
He raised his weapon and fired. With his Sharpshooter Talent, every shot struck accurately, disarming Sentinels one by one, knocking rifles and blades from their hands before they could retaliate.
His bullets may not be enough to target their cores within their bodies, but targeting their weapons was different!
With this sudden help, the defenders’ pressure was gone.
"Whoa! They’re disarmed!"
"They dropped their weapons?! Is it Ralph?"
"Awesome! Kill them!"
But at this time, the remaining Dragoons above continued to strafe the wall...
Even with Farrah’s mysterious wave of barrier, they would not be able to hold for long!
"It’s my turn now..."
Claire steadied her breathing, lifted her rifle, and joined the fray.
"Everyone! Just hold on!" Claire shouted before she fired at one of the advancing Dragoons.
Bang!
Her shot struck its shoulder joint, and the machine staggered.
Then, another volley from Wallace’s team pushed it off course!
"I just need to get closer!" Claire yelled, hinting at something she had prepared.
Her words were heard across the wall, and the defenders felt a surge of hope.
Farrah’s energy wave pulsed again, slowing another barrage from the Dragoons.

Alfie roared as he leapt once more, this time grabbing onto a Dragoon mid‐flight. He swung himself onto the vehicle, tearing into the fused pilot with his bare hands before hurling the wreckage down onto the Sentinels below.
Boom!
The defenders cheered, but Claire knew it wasn’t over. Eight Dragoons and six Sentinels were still pressing the attack, and their firepower could not be ignored!
Many of them were already injured from gunshots!
Claire sprinted forward, moving between barricades as bullets tore into the wall around her.
As soon as she got into position, she reached into her pouch and pulled out a small, cylindrical device... one of her newly obtained items.
The EMP Grenade!
Her heart raced as she thumbed the activation switch!

chapters.title: Chapter 157: The Artillery
paragraphs: At this point, every Foreign Survivor was aware of the source of the EMP Grenade that Claire had just used.
As a matter of fact, they could only think of one source, the Gene Trader!
"That’s ten thousand experience points, right?"
"Why did she use it so early? We can still take care of them."
"It’s fine! Let’s just finish them off!"
"Thank you, Claire!"
"Ten thousand... It’s gone, just like that."
Claire smiled faintly as she raised her bat, her eyes fixed on the battlefield. She had already thrown the grenade, and now all they could do was wait.
It hit the ground, rolled once, and then three seconds later, it detonated.
Boom!
A shockwave of blue light burst outward, spreading across the battlefield like a tidal wave. The pulse rippled through the air, shaking the ground beneath their feet.
Even the walls of the shelter trembled under the force!
"Ahh! Stay on your feet!" Wallace shouted, bracing himself as the wave expanded in every direction, washing over the Dragoons and Sentinels.
The grenade didn’t just buy them precious time, it disrupted the enemy formation and cut their numbers.

"Ugh... As expected, they’re not dropping..." Claire muttered, narrowing her eyes. Those positioned farther back weren’t as affected. The EMP wasn’t an instant kill against the Sentinels and Dragoons.
She could only guess that they had some kind of shielding technology protecting their core components. Still, the grenade had damaged several systems, frying circuits and disrupting their functions.
"Don’t waste this chance, you guys!" Claire reminded, her voice sharp and commanding.
Many of the machines were frozen, their limbs locked, but she knew it wouldn’t last forever. The mechanized army was tough, and their systems would eventually reboot.
"Destroy them while they’re down!" Wallace shouted.
This time, the defenders drew their close‐combat weapons. Guns didn’t have the piercing power needed against these stunned enemies. Blunt weapons, hammers, and swords would be far more effective.
Wallace, Farrah, and the rest of the defenders laughed as the EMP blast shifted the battlefield in their favor.
The Dragoons struggled to stay airborne. Their engines sputtered, spewing smoke, and sparks erupted from their cores. Several dropped in altitude, crashing hard into the dirt.
Boom! Boom!
Others hovered weakly, unable to maintain proper flight, but it didn’t take long for them, as they were also caught by Wallace!
On the ground, the remaining Sentinels convulsed.
Their glowing eyes blinked uncontrollably as their limbs stiffened, and their weapons clattered uselessly to the ground!
"Destroy them all! Hahaha!" someone shouted. "EMP is the best!" another cheered.
Claire grinned as she watched the defenders charge forward, pummeling the Sentinels and Dragoons.
Alfie also roared as he charged into a crippled Sentinel, smashing its chest with all his might! After his third swing, the machine’s core shattered!
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Sentinel (D) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +100 Experience Points ]
The reward was small, but no one cared. The important thing was survival.
Wallace dashed across the wall, directing fire at the grounded Dragoons.
Even Ralph’s shots rang out, targeting exposed joints to keep the machines from recovering!
The Dragoons that had fallen were crippled but not completely destroyed.

Thanks to the EMP, however, they were unable to function properly. Survivors swarmed them, smashing into their frames with bats, hammers, and scavenged blades. Even sparks flew as metal was dented and torn apart.
The Sentinels suffered the same fate. Their stunned bodies were battered until their cores shattered one by one.
"Hahaha! You’re all overestimating yourselves! Attacking us with mere 20 units?!" Claire spat at this thought before she continued!
"Everyone, we got this!" Claire shouted as she swung her bat into another Sentinel. She struck its head repeatedly until its systems collapsed in a shower of sparks.
Finally, after a few moments, the battlefield quieted.
The defenders stood among the wreckage, panting, bloodied, but victorious.
"Hahaha! Everyone! Good job!" Claire called out, her voice carrying across the wall.
Soon, Victor, their mechanic, rushed forward, his eyes were almost shining as he examined the remains of the Dragoons!

"The flight engines..." he muttered, almost reverently. "If we can salvage even one, we might be able to replicate the technology. Imagine what this could mean for us... aerial scouting, faster transport, maybe even building our own Dragoon."
Excitement filled his voice as he immediately began inspecting the wreckage.
But his enthusiasm quickly turned to dismay. "Aaack?! Why are they so badly damaged?"
Claire wiped sweat from her brow and looked at the poor mechanic.
"Sorry about that... I used EMP, so their circuits must’ve been fried by now."

Victor groaned while running his hands through his hair. "Fried circuits... of course. It makes sense. The engines are intact, but the control systems are ruined. Still... maybe I can salvage something."
Claire placed a hand on his shoulder. "Do what you can. Even scraps might help us later."

Victor nodded reluctantly while already pulling tools from his pouch. Around them, survivors began gathering the broken cores and scattered parts. Despite having low experience points from the battle, their spirits were lifted by the victory.
The shelter hadn’t just endured a beating, they had struck back!
At this time, a mysterious figure had actually noticed the attack that had just happened.
"This shelter is really strong... I wonder what number it is."
The voice came from a woman, and as she observed the shelter from afar, she couldn’t help but feel worried.
She could see several Sentinels and Spyders preparing something huge in the distance. It seemed that they hadn’t been noticed yet!
These Sentinels and Spyders seemed to be building a massive cannon, or perhaps a siege weapon, designed to obliterate the shelter she had just discovered.
The scale of it was terrifying. Its frame was stretching taller than the nearby ruins.
Heavy cables snaked across the ground, and piece by piece, the structure was taking shape...
"Aahhh... Shit. Isn’t that too huge?!" The figure muttered in shock.
What she was seeing was a massive cannon mounted on four legs, like some monstrous artillery beast!

chapters.title: Chapter 158: It’s Mine!
paragraphs: The enemies were actually building a huge artillery to deal with the shelter!
It was a long and meticulous process, and only after about an hour did the skeletal frame begin to resemble a weapon.
Four massive legs were anchored into the ground, supporting a central barrel that stretched upward like a monstrous cannon...
Then, the female figure watched as the Spyders welded plates into place, while Sentinels carried heavy components and locked them into position.
"What the heck? They’re really building a huge weapon here..." she muttered.
They were certainly a coordinated workforce!
Meanwhile, the defenders of the shelter from afar hadn’t noticed the situation yet.
Their focus had been on repairing the wall and tending to the wounded. But when the artillery’s silhouette grew taller than the ruins nearby, Claire finally spotted it.
Her heart sank.
"They’re building something... something huge!" she shouted.
Panic spread through the shelter. Survivors rushed to the ramparts, staring at the construction in horror.
The realization hit them all at once. This wasn’t just another wave of enemies. This was preparation for annihilation.
Since they had survived Haven-45’s bombardment before, they knew very well about this weapon! It was an artillery meant to destroy shelters!
They had so many questions right now.
Why would the mechanized army suddenly build that and attempt to annihilate them?
Were they considered such a threat that the enemy would deploy a weapon of mass destruction?
Was sending hordes of Sentinels and Dragoons not enough? Why escalate to this level?
Everyone felt the same bitter truth... this wasn’t fair. They had no Augmented Humans on their side, no enhanced warriors to match such overwhelming force.
Yet here they were, being targeted with a weapon powerful enough to erase them in a single strike.
Still, Farrah immediately took command. "We can’t wait for it to finish! If that cannon fires, the shelter is done!"
Within minutes, a strike group was assembled, and this time, Farrah led the team...

It was decided like that because of her ability to create a barrier. It was called Knight Armor, a Gene Skill she had invested with all of her Skill Points! It was now a Level 5 Skill and could block bullets easily.
She hadn’t tried blocking Plasma Burst with this ability yet, but she’s the one with the strongest defense right now...
It was better for her to lead the team.
As she climbed into the armored car, several fighters joined her, armed with rifles, blades, and whatever weapons they could carry.
The vehicle soon started moving with its engine growling as it sped out of the shelter gates toward the construction site.
Claire watched them go, gripping her bat tightly. She wanted to join, but Victor insisted she stay to coordinate defense at the wall or evacuation...
"If they fail, we’ll need you here," he said grimly.

Meanwhile, the mysterious female figure who had been observing from afar squinted her eyes. She had already planned to destroy the artillery herself, silently, before the shelter even realized the danger. But her Spirit Points hadn’t yet recovered, leaving her unable to act for some time...
Then, a moment later, when she finally felt ready, she saw Farrah’s strike team mobilize. She didn’t know them, but she saw them coming out of the fortified shelter...
"So they noticed what’s going on here... good. Maybe I don’t have to intervene after all," she muttered.
Still, worry gnawed at her.

The Spyders weren’t ordinary mechanized soldiers. They carried plasma rifles, weapons far deadlier than the standard blades or guns. A single volley could melt through armor, and the Armored Car they were using wouldn’t last for a long time.
Her eyes narrowed further. "Do they even have the means to fight back against plasma?"
And then, just as her concern peaked, something unexpected happened.
The Spyders noticed them immediately.
Several mechanized soldiers turned their heads with their plasma rifles glowing faintly as they locked onto the approaching vehicle.
One Spyder finished charging and was about to shoot...
It aimed directly at the armored car’s engine and for sure, a single shot could have melted through the metal and crippled their advance.
But before it could fire, a gunshot rang out.
Bang!
From the roof of the armored car, one of the defenders had already taken position. His rifle fired, and the bullet struck the plasma rifle’s barrel at the perfect angle!
The weapon jerked sideways, and its shot discharged harmlessly into the dirt!
The plasma blast scorched the ground, leaving a molten scar, but the armored car was untouched!
"Nice shot!" someone shouted.
At this time, the mysterious female figure was already impressed. However, it didn’t end there...
Boom!
One of the artillery’s massive legs exploded out of nowhere!
It was torn apart by a huge force that she hadn’t noticed until it was already there!
"Hmm? What’s happening here?"
The entire structure shuddered, and its frame started tilting precariously as alarms blasted off from the mechanized soldiers.
"This is crazy... When did they planted a bomb or something?"
However, she soon realized what was going on!
The mysterious woman’s eyes widened as she saw two figures had arrived out of nowhere.
They seemed to have arrived on the battlefield with impossible speed.
But then, she recognized the man instantly.
"Kai!" she gasped.
It was the same for Farrah and the others who were still moving closer with their Armored Car!
"It’s Kai and Atom! Yeah!"
The strongest fighter of the shelter had returned.
Just like that, they watched as Kai’s rifle suppressed the Spyders and Sentinels, enough for the armored car to be relieved from the pressure.
Then, Kai turned his attention back to the artillery’s supports or legs! Beside him, Atom charged forward!
This mechanized soldier didn’t even use a sword or gun as it smashed into a Sentinel, crumpling its chest like paper!
The battlefield erupted into chaos.
Spyders scrambled to defend the artillery!
They tried killing Kai with their plasma rifles, but it was too slow!
Blue streaks of energy lit up, scorching the ground and walls, but Kai’s Specter Step avoided them all.
"This artillery... It’s mine!" Kai shouted as he made sure not to damage the main components of the weapon.

Everyone felt the same bitter truth... this wasn’t fair.
They had no Augmented Humans on their side, no enhanced warriors to match such overwhelming force.
Yet here they were, being targeted with a weapon powerful enough to erase them in a single strike.
Still, Farrah immediately took command.
"We can’t wait for it to finish!
If that cannon fires, the shelter is done!"
Within minutes, a strike group was assembled, and this time, Farrah led the team...
It was decided like that because of her ability to create a barrier.
It was called Knight Armor, a Gene Skill she had invested with all of her Skill Points!
It was now a Level 5 Skill and could block bullets easily.
She hadn’t tried blocking Plasma Burst with this ability yet, but she’s the one with the strongest defense right now...
It was better for her to lead the team.
As she climbed into the armored car, several fighters joined her, armed with rifles, blades, and whatever weapons they could carry.
The vehicle soon started moving with its engine growling as it sped out of the shelter gates toward the construction site.
Claire watched them go, gripping her bat tightly.
She wanted to join, but Victor insisted she stay to coordinate defense at the wall or evacuation...
"If they fail, we’ll need you here," he said grimly.
Meanwhile, the mysterious female figure who had been observing from afar squinted her eyes.
She had already planned to destroy the artillery herself, silently, before the shelter even realized the danger.
But her Spirit Points hadn’t yet recovered, leaving her unable to act for some time...
Then, a moment later, when she finally felt ready, she saw Farrah’s strike team mobilize.
She didn’t know them, but she saw them coming out of the fortified shelter...
"So they noticed what’s going on here... good.
Maybe I don’t have to intervene after all," she muttered.
Still, worry gnawed at her.
The Spyders weren’t ordinary mechanized soldiers.
They carried plasma rifles, weapons far deadlier than the standard blades or guns.
A single volley could melt through armor, and the Armored Car they were using wouldn’t last for a long time.
Her eyes narrowed further.
"Do they even have the means to fight back against plasma?"
And then, just as her concern peaked, something unexpected happened.
The Spyders noticed them immediately.
Several mechanized soldiers turned their heads with their plasma rifles glowing faintly as they locked onto the approaching vehicle.
One Spyder finished charging and was about to shoot...
It aimed directly at the armored car’s engine and for sure, a single shot could have melted through the metal and crippled their advance.
But before it could fire, a gunshot rang out.
Bang!
From the roof of the armored car, one of the defenders had already taken position.
His rifle fired, and the bullet struck the plasma rifle’s barrel at the perfect angle!
The weapon jerked sideways, and its shot discharged harmlessly into the dirt!
The plasma blast scorched the ground, leaving a molten scar, but the armored car was untouched!
"Nice shot!" someone shouted.
At this time, the mysterious female figure was already impressed.
However, it didn’t end there...
Boom!
One of the artillery’s massive legs exploded out of nowhere!
It was torn apart by a huge force that she hadn’t noticed until it was already there!
"Hmm?
What’s happening here?"
The entire structure shuddered, and its frame started tilting precariously as alarms blasted off from the mechanized soldiers.
"This is crazy...
When did they planted a bomb or something?"
However, she soon realized what was going on!
The mysterious woman’s eyes widened as she saw two figures had arrived out of nowhere.
They seemed to have arrived on the battlefield with impossible speed.
But then, she recognized the man instantly.
"Kai!" she gasped.
It was the same for Farrah and the others who were still moving closer with their Armored Car!
"It’s Kai and Atom!
Yeah!"
The strongest fighter of the shelter had returned.
Just like that, they watched as Kai’s rifle suppressed the Spyders and Sentinels, enough for the armored car to be relieved from the pressure.
Then, Kai turned his attention back to the artillery’s supports or legs!
Beside him, Atom charged forward!
This mechanized soldier didn’t even use a sword or gun as it smashed into a Sentinel, crumpling its chest like paper!
The battlefield erupted into chaos.
Spyders scrambled to defend the artillery!
They tried killing Kai with their plasma rifles, but it was too slow!
Blue streaks of energy lit up, scorching the ground and walls, but Kai’s Specter Step avoided them all.
"This artillery...
It’s mine!" Kai shouted as he made sure not to damage the main components of the weapon.

chapters.title: Chapter 159: The Artillery!
paragraphs: The hidden figure remained silent as she watched everything unfold.
Kai moved like a phantom across the battlefield. His speed was so great that he left afterimages in his wake, confusing the Spyders’ targeting systems.
It was definitely a Gene Skill!
’No wonder he’s the Rank 1... I wonder if that Gene Skill is similar to mine...’ she mused.
Soon, smoke grenades burst around him, cloaking his movements in thick clouds.
At times, he seemed to vanish entirely, using a skill or perhaps an item that masked his presence from enemy sensors.
Meanwhile, Atom absorbed the brunt of the fire.
The mechanized soldier accompanying Kai had become the primary target. Its body was even capable of enduring plasma bursts that would have melted through ordinary armor.
Each impact seemed to be capable of destroying a tank, but Atom remained unaffected! It was shielding Kai from the worst of the assault.
Furthermore, Atom wasn’t stopping the destruction of the other Sentinels that came forward!
At that moment, the reinforcements finally arrived as Farrah’s armored car screeched to a halt nearby.
She leapt out, activated her Gene Skill, Knight Armor, and it deflected incoming gunfire!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Sparks scattered across the barrier’s surface, but it held firm. Thankfully, the Spyders with plasma rifles were already being suppressed by Kai’s precision shots and Atom’s relentless advance.
They only had to worry about the few enemies.
"Kai! You’re fast!" Farrah shouted as she arrived in front of the enemies.
Kai gave her a quick nod before firing another volley into the enemy ranks. His shots were deliberate, not aimed at random targets but at key points to disrupt their formation!
"Do not destroy the cannon!" he ordered sharply. "Cover us!"
The survivors were stunned for a moment after hearing the instruction but they all nodded, emboldened by the sudden arrival of their strongest warriors.
"Cover the Leader! Charge!"
Alfie roared as he dashed forward! Soon, his bat smashed into a Spyder and sent it crashing into the dirt. The other Survivors also poured out of the armored car, prepared to fight to the death.
Only Ralph remained on top of the vehicle, with his rifle ready...
Well, with his Sharpshooter Talent, he picked off plasma rifles before they could fire again.
His magazine was nearly empty, but every shot counted! Each bullet disarmed a weapon or crippled a joint, buying precious seconds for the others.
Kai, however, kept his focus on the artillery. His attacks weren’t meant to destroy it outright. Instead, he targeted its supports, testing its defenses, forcing the mechanized army to react.
Boom!
The artillery’s mechanical body groaned under the assault!
As expected, the Sentinels and Spyders shifted their attention. They ignored the other survivors and concentrated their fire on Kai and Atom.
Plasma streaks lit up the battlefield, scorching the ground and walls, but Kai’s Specter Step carried him through the barrage unharmed.
Atom absorbed the rest, with his reinforced body enduring the punishment.
From the wall of the New Haven Shelter-45, Claire noticed what was happening and clenched her fists.
Her eyes were filled with hope!
"Kai... Atom... you came back just in time." she whispered.

As for the mysterious woman who had remained hidden, her Spirit Points were still recovering. But as she watched the defenders rally, her lips curved into a faint smile. She already wanted to join them...
"I guess he wants control over this artillery," she murmured. "He’s baiting them, not destroying it."
She understood now.
Kai’s strategy wasn’t reckless... it was calculated. By drawing the enemy’s focus onto himself, he forced them to overextend, leaving openings for the others to strike.
The cannon wasn’t his target to destroy... it was definitely his prize to claim.
The mechanized army fought desperately to protect their siege weapon, but the tide had turned.
With Kai and Atom leading the charge, Farrah shielding the team, Ralph covering from above, and the survivors continuing to move forward, the team had found their rhythm!
It didn’t take long before the clash reached its peak.
The defenders, emboldened by Kai and Atom’s arrival, became more confident.
"Push forward! Don’t let them regroup!" Wallace shouted.
Alfie, with his Gladiator Talent, smashed into another Spyder that Ralph had already disarmed.
Thud!
Sparks flew as the machine collapsed and its plasma rifle clattered uselessly to the ground.
"Leave it! Focus on the cores!" Alfie shouted as he saw someone aiming to take the rifle.
In just a few more moments, everything was under their control.
One by one, the Sentinels fell. Atom tore even through them with brute strength, ripping a Sentinel’s arm clean off and throwing it away!
Kai caught the motion and smirked. "Nice throw, Atom. Keep them busy."
On the armored car, Ralph was also done...
"Magazine’s empty!" he shouted down. "You’re on your own now!"
"Don’t worry, you bought us time!" Farrah called back.
Thud! Thud!
As expected, it didn’t take long before the battlefield grew quieter as the last mechanized soldiers collapsed.
Several Sentinels lay broken with their cores shattered, while a dozen or so Spyders were reduced to piles of metal.
Kai lowered his rifle and turned toward the massive artillery.
Its huge frame was quite intimidating. Furthermore, it was still intact despite the chaos. He approached slowly, inspecting its supports and central barrel.
"This weapon... it belongs to us now," Kai said firmly.
Ralph’s eyes lit up. "If we can haul it back, we might actually turn this thing against them!"
Kai nodded, already calculating how to move it. He didn’t even bother checking the notification system for the experience points he had earned from eliminating the Sentinels.
"We’ll figure out how to transport it later. For now, secure the area." His gaze shifted toward the treeline.
It should be around here... Kai thought as he scanned the shadows.
"Enough hiding," Kai called out. "Show yourself."
Thankfully, he didn’t have to repeat himself as the hidden figure stepped forward, and this time, Kai realized it was a woman.
Her movements were calm, unhurried, and she seemed completely unbothered by the chaos around her.
Soon, her face was revealed.
Then, Kai froze as recognition struck him.
"Wait... Mei?" he whispered.
The survivors exchanged glances. They all knew that name... it was on the Leaderboard!
Kai didn’t know what to say at first. Finally, he asked,
"Why did you choose this Apocalypse?"

chapters.title: Chapter 160: Officemate
paragraphs: Kai’s grip on his rifle loosened as he stared at her.
’That’s her...’
The battlefield was littered with broken Sentinels and Spyders, but for him, everything seemed to fade into silence.
Mei.
He remembered her from the office, the quiet programmer who had joined their cybersecurity team fresh out of university.
Back then, Kai was already a senior penetration tester and systems engineer, juggling audits and red‐team simulations.
Mei had been assigned under him, and he had spent months guiding her through the labyrinth of firewalls, exploits, and endless lines of code.
It was definitely one of the most memorable times in his company.
She had always called himSenior Kai.

He was seen as reliable, steady, and someone she could lean on when the pressure mounted. Though he didn’t think himself to be like that, he always tried his best to ensure that his junior would have someone to rely on.
After all, he couldn’t have her quit! At that time, many of the new hires would only last a month or two!
As for Mei, Kai had really been careful training her and had read lots of books about it since he no longer wanted to train another hire.
And now, here she was, standing in front of him in the middle of the apocalypse.
Despite the chaos of the world, Mei still looked attractive...
Her short black hair framed her face neatly, and her skin now carried a warm tan, probably because of her constant movement under the sun during this apocalypse...
Still, even in the ruins of civilization, she had managed to keep herself composed...
It was almost surreal, as if she had stepped out of the office and into this nightmare without losing her grace.
Kai’s mind turned back to the leaderboard. He had seen her name there weeks ago, climbing steadily into the top three.

She had even chatted in the world chat once or twice, but he had ignored her messages. Revealing his identity in public was too risky. If private chat existed, maybe he would have reached out. But it didn’t. So he stayed silent.
Now, fate had brought her here.

Mei broke the silence first and smiled. "Senior Kai... I don’t have that many options. I got six, actually... Alien Invasion, Ragnarok, Demon Invasion, Deep Sea Awakening, Zombie Outbreak, and A.I. Rebellion. So I chose A.I. Rebellion... It looked doable."
She glanced at the survivors around them, who were staring in shock that she knew Kai. Her smile widened.
Then, she approached Kai and whispered.
"We’re programmers, right? We just need to hack their systems and take control of them!"
Kai exhaled slowly and shook his head. If it were that easy... Then he would do so. "You always did think like that. It might be doable, but where can we even find a terminal?"
Claire and the others exchanged looks, but quickly turned their attention back to looting the battlefield.
Plasma rifles were the most valuable spoils, and they wasted no time stripping them from the fallen Spyders.
Mei watched them work, impressed at their coordination.
"You’ve built a reliable team in just over a month," she said softly. "Meanwhile, I’ve been alone... surviving with only my Talent."
Kai tilted his head... "A Talent that can help you survive alone? Isn’t that even more impressive? It helped you survive Mech Siege and that Field Tyrant..."
"Hahaha... You’re right. It sounds awesome, but not really... It’s some kind of camouflage."
She then paused for a moment before revealing how she managed to stay on top despite not combat talent...

"You see... If I use it with my other Gene Skills, it works like invisibility... It lets me sabotage their bases, sneak past patrols, and strike when they least expect it. That’s how I’ve lasted this long. It’s why I’m in the top three."
Kai studied her carefully. Since she said what her talent was, Kai felt obliged to reveal something about himself as well.
This way, they could easily trust each other.
"Right... My Talent helps me get resources. If you join my team, I can help you, Mei... I’m really curious how you managed to stay alive alone in this Apocalypse."
Mei smiled as she recalled her lonely days and nights, surviving in the wild.
It was a difficult Chapter of her life. "Yes. Alone. No team, no shelter. Just me against the A.I. army."
After taking a deep breath, she shrugged lightly... "But I was lucky. My Talent suits this Apocalypse."
Kai’s voice softened. "You’ve changed... but not that much."
Mei chuckled. "And you’re still the same Senior Kai. You’re always protecting others."
For a moment, it felt like they were back in the office, sitting side by side in front of glowing monitors.
He remembered her asking endless questions about exploits, about how to bypass intrusion detection systems, about how to patch vulnerabilities in the systems.
She had been eager, determined, and he had taken it upon himself to guide her.
Now, she stood before him as an equal.
Kai finally asked, "Is that camouflage that effective even against Tyrants, or maybe those Hounds?"
She met his gaze and nodded.
"That’s right... It’s pretty awesome, right? I just have to use my Faded Gene Skill while using my Camauflage and even the Hounds would not notice my presence."
Kai gently nodded as he realized how great it would be for them if she stayed in their shelter.
Meanwhile, the other survivors continued looting, and thanks to their experience, they were able to do it quickly.
"Plasma rifles secured!" Wallace shouted.
"We’ll need Victor to check the cores later! We’re ready, Kai... What do we do with this Artillery? I don’t think we can carry these things."
Claire nodded...
"I noticed that they used vehicles to transport the materials based on the tracks they left behind, but they’re already gone."
Kai finally turned his attention to his team and nodded.
"Don’t worry. We’ll disassemble this thing and bring it back to our shelter. We’ll mount it there. Call Victor."
