chapters.title: Chapter 161: The New Member
paragraphs: "Ohh... Are you going to use that instead of destroying it? But are you not worried? What if it’s controlled by an A.I.? It will not self-destruct, is it?" Mei asked as she looked at the large artillery weapon.
The Plasma Rifles and other small weapons taken from them may not have issues, but this one, which was so large, could become a liability if they weren’t careful.

Kai turned back to Mei. "Ahh... Don’t worry about it. I already checked. This one is just a pure weapon. I guess they didn’t even consider their precious weapon to be stolen like this... or maybe this is just an older model made by A.I. Aria."
Mei nodded slowly. "Got it... I guess you have some kind of Observation Skill, huh..."
Kai chuckled and gently nodded. Well, he had Keen Sense and Fast Appraisal Skills!!
Even with just these two Skills, he’d be able to analyze materials a lot faster.
"Alright... Let’s return. I’m sure you’re already tired." Kai said as he invited Mei to the shelter.
"Yes!"
Mei’s eyes were filled with joy. After being alone in the apocalypse for more than a month, she was finally here with someone she knew!
Kai had no idea that Mei had gone through.
She had suffered a lot in her journey despite her successful solo leveling. Furthermore, she had actually visited more than 30 Haven Shelters already!
’Thank you, lord. I didn’t give up...’Mei thought as she really wanted to give up a few days ago.
After all, she had no idea how big this world was... She was already thinking of finding a nice settlement and living there permanently.
"Senior Kai... I’ll follow your lead. Just like before."
Kai shook his head gently.

"No, Mei... It’s different now. Back then, you relied on me. But here, in this world, I know you’ve already become independent. With your unique Talent and skills, I might have to rely on you this time."
Mei’s eyes softened, and without hesitation, she nodded. "Senior Kai... if that’s what you need, I’ll be there. Just like before."
Soon, they left the team scavenging parts from the enemies they had just defeated.
Kai led Mei toward the shelter.
As soon as she stepped inside, Mei froze. Her eyes widened in shock.
Dozens of unmoving Sentinels stood like statues! She hadn’t noticed these things from afar!
"W‐what... Senior Kai, why are they here?!" she gasped, instinctively reaching for her weapon.
Kai raised a hand calmly.
"Relax. They’re drained. No power left in them. I keep them here for intimidation. When outsiders see this, they think twice before attacking us."
Mei blinked, still unsettled at the sight of numerous Sentines, but she slowly lowered her hand. "You... even use broken Sentinels as a deterrent. That’s... clever."
But her surprise didn’t end there. Kai guided her further inside, toward the kitchen.
Amer, the part‐time kitchen helper, was already busy preparing something. Kai reached into his inventory and opened a pack!
[ Food Gift Pack (Enhanced)
Contents: vacuum‐sealed rations, canned goods, dried fruits and nuts, instant soup packs, coffee sachets, and portable cooking stove with fuel canisters. ]
Mei’s eyes widened again. "Gift Packs... you can just summon them?"

Kai smiled faintly. "There’s a limit... Anyway, the vacuum‐sealed rations are basically MREs, but the flavor’s decent. Amer knows how to make them better, add leaves, spices, whatever we can scavenge or grow in the garden."
Amer grinned as he opened the pack. "Don’t worry, Miss... You’ll eat well tonight."
Soon, the aroma of cooked rations filled the room.
The survivors gathered, and when the food was served, Mei tasted it carefully. Her eyes lit up.
"This... this is actually good!" she said, almost laughing.
"After weeks of chewing dried roots and stale bread, this feels like a feast!"
Kai chuckled. "It’s not much, but it keeps us alive."
He knew at the very least that Mei hadn’t been eating proper food over the past month. Even if she still looked beautiful, he could tell that it hadn’t been easy for her.
After the meal, Kai finally felt relaxed and asked, "Do you have a weapon?"
Mei nodded. "Right now, I only keep a sword and a hammer. Both are in my inventory. I rarely use them unless I have to. As for guns... it’s been a long time since I ran out of bullets."

Kai’s smile deepened. "That won’t be a problem anymore. With my ability, I can provide many Gift Packs. That means you’ll not ran out of bullets, too. But..." he paused, his tone then turned serious, "...I have to be careful about how I use it."
Mei tilted her head. "Careful?"

Kai nodded. "If you have a Survivor Medal, I can give you some Gift Packs of your choice... Weapon, Food, Shelter, and more. As many as you need. But we can’t let others know too much about this. It’s our edge."
Mei smiled. "Senior Kai... you really haven’t changed. I have spare Survivor Medals here with me. I want some Weapons Gift Pack..."
"Ohhh... Sur! But let’s do the trade later... For now, I want you to look around. You need to learn more about this place."
Mei nodded firmly, her eyes gleaming with trust.
Then, as if remembering something important, she looked at her Talent and informed Kai about it.

[ Living Camouflage (Epic): You can conceal yourself by blending seamlessly into your surroundings. This Talent suppresses sound, heat, and movement signatures, making you undetectable to ordinary vision and sensor scans. Activation lasts for one hour if you remain still, or 30 seconds while moving, and costs 30 Spirit Points. The effect immediately ends if you attack, create a loud noise, or are struck directly. ]
It was her final way of showing trust in him!
Kai listened carefully and nodded. "That’s... incredible. No wonder you survived alone for so long. With that, you can move through enemy territory like a ghost."
Mei smiled faintly. "It kept me alive, Senior Kai..."
Kai nodded. "Then we’ll rely on each other. This time, it won’t just be me protecting you. You’ll be protecting all of us too."
Mei nodded with a laugh. "Haha... I’ll do my best."
Soon, the night fell over the shelter. The scavenging team returned with parts and weapons, and the survivors settled into their routines.
Kai also retired to his room, finally allowing himself a moment of rest. He would continue his hunt tomorrow...
But then, the quiet room was broken by a soft knock.
"Kai..." Mei’s voice came from the other side.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Jonas’ Talent
paragraphs: Kai explained to the group what he had basically done to the enemies over the past few days...
Well, it was quite simple... He had spent days thinning the patrols. He was striking them silently in specific areas surrounding the base, where he wouldn’t get targeted by a larger force.
Now, with their numbers dwindling, the time had come.
The A.I. base, with its fields tended by enslaved humans, was still standing, but its defenses were weaker than ever.
"This is it," Kai muttered as he looked over his map. "One last push."
He looked at his team... Atom, Claire, Mei, and Jonas.
Jonas still looked nervous, so he approached him and patted his shoulder.
"We will be needing your Iron Stomach Talent later on..."
Jonas finally smiled when Kai patted his shoulder.
The nervousness that had been weighing on him eased a little.
He remembered the times he had explained his Talent to Kai, and how ridiculous it had sounded at first.

[ Iron Stomach (Superior): You can consume and digest non‐food items, and slightly improve satiety. Consume item will be converted into temporary buffs depending on their material, composition, or symbolic value.
Each consumed item grants a unique effect. Buff duration varies depending on its quality and is up to 24 hours maximum only.
Activation costs 20 Spirit Points per item consumed. You cannot gain multiple buffs from the same item type within 24 hours, and consuming an item larger than your body mass will fail. ]
It wasn’t flashy like Claire’s wealth‐driven abilities, nor destructive like Alfie’s combat skills. But it was his, and over time, he had learned that it could be surprisingly useful.
He thought back to the first time he had tested it.
The shelter, Haven-15, had been short on food, and Jonas had been desperate.
He picked up a rusted pipe lying in the rubble, half‐joking to himself that if his Talent really worked, maybe he could chew it down.
To his shock, the system accepted it.
The taste was awful, metallic and bitter, but once he swallowed, a notification appeared...
[ Buff Gained: Rusted Endurance ]
[+5% resistance to physical damage for 30 minutes.]
It wasn’t much, but it was real. That was the first time he realized his Talent could turn trash into strength!
Later, he experimented with an empty energy core scavenged from a broken Sentinel... It was heavy, with only faint residual charge.
He forced it down, gagging at the acrid taste of burnt core and digested it...
Then, the system chimed again:
[ Buff Gained: Static Charge ]
[Minor shock damage added to melee attacks for 10 minutes.]
He remembered swinging his hammer afterward and watching electricity fly with each strike. It had been clumsy, but effective!
Then there was the time he swallowed a revolver. It had taken him hours to break it down into pieces small enough to chew, but he was determined. The result was worth it:
[ Buff Gained: Gunmetal Focus ]
[+10% accuracy with ranged weapons for 20 minutes.]
It was a really fun ability. So after he had it for several days without having to worry about food, he was able to list out the items he must eat to gain specific buffs...
Still, Jonas had laughed at the absurdity of his talent. Eating a gun to shoot straighter... it sounded like a bad joke, but it worked.
Nonetheless, not all of his experiments were combat‐related. Once, he picked up a smooth stone from the riverbank. It was harmless, ordinary, but he wanted to see what would happen.
[ Buff Gained: Stone Calm ]
[+10% resistance to fear effects for 1 hour.]
That buff had saved him during a night raid when Sentinels tried to overwhelm them... It happened in the first wave of the Mech Siege Event in Haven-15...
While others were starting to panic, Jonas was able to calmly hide and follow Terrence at that time.
Regardless, the strangest one had been a book.
He had chewed through the pages, gagging on the dry paper and ink, but the system rewarded him:
[ Buff Gained: Knowledge Spark ]
[+5% experience gain for 24 hours.]
An increased experience gain was too precious, and that was probably the only reason why he was able to keep up with Terrence at that time.
Unfortunately, not every book granted a reward. Some provided no effect at all.
At the very least, he was able to use it for some time...
Then, as he got into Haven-45, he shared what he learned about his Talent with Kai!
Jonas smiled wider as he recalled these moments.
Each item had given him something different, sometimes small, sometimes a surprisingly powerful buff...
His Talent was quite unpredictable, but it was versatile. After all, he had also learned to see opportunity in things others dismissed as junk.
Now, standing with Kai’s team, he wondered what Kai would ask him to eat this time.
The mission ahead was dangerous, and they were about to strike the A.I. base that enslaved humans in its fields.
The machines would surely fight back, and this could become a bloody battle...
’I wonder what he’s thinking...’Jonas thought.
If Kai gave him a weapon part, maybe he could gain extra strength or precision. If it were a Sentinel’s filled energy core, perhaps he could channel shock damage again.
If it was something stranger like a circuit board, a drone lens, or even a piece of armor... who knew what kind of buff it might unlock?
He even imagined swallowing a shard of Sentinel armor and gaining resistance against their rifles.
Or chewing down a Hound’s sensor and suddenly being able to see heat signatures. The possibilities made him a little excited...
Jonas clenched his fists. "I’ll be ready," he whispered to himself.
Soon, Kai and his team arrived at the vicinity of the A.I. base.
From their vantage point, the fields were visible, dotted with exhausted humans forced to labor under the watchful eyes of Sentinels.
The towers and automated turrets could also be seen in the distance...
He then crouched and laid out the simple map he made.
"Though I thinned their numbers, the base itself is still dangerous. We can’t just storm in blindly." He tapped the section of the map where the main gate was marked.
"This is our entry point."
He then turned to Mei. "Mei... I need your help opening that gate. I don’t want to destroy it if possible. Do you think that’s possible?"

chapters.title: Chapter 164: The Siege
paragraphs: "The gate? Alright... Let me see..." Mei whispered.
She activated her Talent.
[ Living Camouflage (Epic): Activated ]
[ Spirit Points -30 ]

Her body suddenly blurred as she moved... Then, in just a second, she blended sseamlessly into the environment. Sound, heat, and movement signatures vanished, making her invisible to ordinary vision and sensor scans.
But she knew the limitation... It was one hour if she stayed still, only thirty seconds if she moved. That wasn’t enough for what Kai needed.
However, with her Passive Gene Skill, she’d be able to do some more...
[ Silent Veins Lv3: Suppresses micro‐vibrations in muscle fibers and stabilizes body heat output. Extends the duration of concealment effects by 300% while moving.]

With Silent Veins’ passive effect, Mei’s Living Camouflage no longer phases out after thirty seconds. Her movements became swift, her body heat regulated, and even the faint tremors of her muscles were muted.
She could now move undetected for a longer time, enough to reach the gate controls.
Just like that, she slipped past the perimeter patrols. Her outline could not be distinguished unless someone was deliberately searching for her presence from where she was standing!
Meanwhile, Kai and the others watched from cover as the turrets swept their sensors across the field.
Mei moved like a shadow... Even when the beams passed directly over her position, nothing registered.
Kai’s eyes widened. "Whoa... incredible. I thought I’d have to send Atom in for this. It really worked."
Claire turned her head sharply, disbelief in her voice. "What? You weren’t expecting her to succeed?"
Kai shook his head, still watching Mei as she reached the gate controls. "No. I knew she could do it. Just in case, I was thinking of sending Atom. But this... this is perfect."
Jonas chuckled, the tension easing from his shoulders.
Meanwhile, Atom remained silent, waiting for Kai’s orders...
"Still... That’s an incredible Gene Skill... I can already imagine what kind of things she’s done to reach her current level." Claire muttered.
Mei had proven that her Talent, paired with her Gene Skill, could bypass defenses even the machines trusted completely.
It didn’t take long before Mei found the controls and immediately tried opening it...
Soon, the enslaved humans in the fields blinked in confusion as the gate’s control panel suddenly lit up, though no one was near it.

However, Mei’s fingers worked quickly, bypassing the mechanical locks and overriding the system. Thankfully, it wasn’t heavily protected by complicated locks since the gate was being used many times every day.
It didn’t take long before she cracked the code!
’Override Successful...’Mei thought.
Just like that, the massive gate creaked open.
Clank! Clank!
Confusion spread among the slaves, who whispered nervously...
As for the Sentinels, they immediately began checking the controller to see if there had been a malfunction.
Kai smiled as he saw this.
The reason why he didn’t want to break the shelter’s gate was obvious... He planned to occupy this base as well!
With his Keen Sense Lv5, he scanned the area.
Every vibration, every metallic step, echoed in his mind.
Soon, he counted the number of remaining enemies!
’So there are 25 Sentinels and 5 Spyder Units...’
The Sentinels were armed with standard rifles, but the Spyders carried plasma rifles...
Of course, at this point, Kai’s team also had plasma rifles, giving them a fighting chance.
He then turned to his team.
He knew that Jonas had been training really well with his gun.
At the very least, he shoots in the training grounds with 20 rounds per day. He should have a better aim now...
As for Claire, there was no need to question her abilities.
He wouldn’t even be surprised if she said that her stats were higher than his. After all, her physical qualities greatly correlated with the wealth she had!
"Alright... Atom! Go in front! Focus on the five Spyders on the buildings!" Kai said as he swiftly followed behind.
"Jonas, stay at the back! Just act as our support! Claire, there’s no need for Spirit Possession! Just go rampage!"
Bang!
Atom charged forward and even crashed into the Sentinel, blocking its path!
Its heavy frame shook the ground as it moved so fast!
Immediately, the other Sentinels locked onto him, and rifles were fired!
Bang! Bang! Bang!

Bullets clattered against his armor, but Atom was an A‐Grade Sentinel... Their rounds couldn’t pierce him. Atom ignored the gunfire entirely, with its sensors locked on the five Spyders perched on the watchtowers!
Meanwhile, Kai moved right behind him, activating his skills in quick succession.
[ Specter Step Lv3: Activated ]
[ Spirit Points -20 ]
His body blurred, vanishing into a ghostlike dash.
In an instant, he crossed the open ground and moved through the battlefield with impossible speed!
It didn’t end there as he triggered another ability!
[ Spirit Pulse Lv5: Activated ]
[ Spirit Points -70 ]
A shockwave of condensed spirit energy erupted from his palm, slamming into a cluster of Sentinels.
Boom!
The blast staggered them, disrupting their aim and leaving Atom free to advance on the Spyders.
Claire followed close behind.
The invisible spirit bound to her whispered insistently, urging her to allow possession, but she ignored it.
"Shut the hell up!"
She didn’t need it. Her own strength was enough!
Claire steadied her plasma rifle as she began shooting at the enemies!
Fwoosh! Fwoosh! Fwoosh!
Seven precise shots tore through the battlefield!
Each shot burned straight through a Sentinel’s chest plate, dropping them one after another!
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Sentinel (E) ]
"They’re just E-Grade! I think we’re wasting our Plasma Rifles..." Claire frowned as she thought that these Sentinels were at least D-Grade if not C-Grade.
In any case, the first three collapsed instantly with their cores ruptured.
The next two staggered before falling with their armor sizzling under the plasma fire. The last pair tried to retreat, but Claire’s aim was merciless! She dropped them down before they could regroup.
Her rifle hissed empty. Without hesitation, she tossed it aside and surged forward.
[ Breakstride Lv5: Activated ]
[ Spirit Points -10 ]
It was a short‐range burst movement that only lasted for 5 seconds. However, it was enough!
Her body blurred, closing the gap in a moment...
Soon, the nearest Sentinel raised its weapon, but Claire was already upon it.
She seized its head in both hands.
[ Titan Grip Lv4: Activated ]
[ Spirit Points -20 ]
Crunch!

[ Silent Veins Lv3: Suppresses micro‐vibrations in muscle fibers and stabilizes body heat output.
Extends the duration of concealment effects by 300% while moving.]
With Silent Veins’ passive effect, Mei’s Living Camouflage no longer phases out after thirty seconds.
Her movements became swift, her body heat regulated, and even the faint tremors of her muscles were muted.
She could now move undetected for a longer time, enough to reach the gate controls.
Just like that, she slipped past the perimeter patrols.
Her outline could not be distinguished unless someone was deliberately searching for her presence from where she was standing!
Meanwhile, Kai and the others watched from cover as the turrets swept their sensors across the field.
Mei moved like a shadow...
Even when the beams passed directly over her position, nothing registered.
Kai’s eyes widened.
"Whoa... incredible.
I thought I’d have to send Atom in for this.
It really worked."
Claire turned her head sharply, disbelief in her voice.
"What?
You weren’t expecting her to succeed?"
Kai shook his head, still watching Mei as she reached the gate controls.
"No.
I knew she could do it.
Just in case, I was thinking of sending Atom.
But this... this is perfect."
Jonas chuckled, the tension easing from his shoulders.
Meanwhile, Atom remained silent, waiting for Kai’s orders...
"Still...
That’s an incredible Gene Skill...
I can already imagine what kind of things she’s done to reach her current level." Claire muttered.
Mei had proven that her Talent, paired with her Gene Skill, could bypass defenses even the machines trusted completely.
It didn’t take long before Mei found the controls and immediately tried opening it...
Soon, the enslaved humans in the fields blinked in confusion as the gate’s control panel suddenly lit up, though no one was near it.
However, Mei’s fingers worked quickly, bypassing the mechanical locks and overriding the system.
Thankfully, it wasn’t heavily protected by complicated locks since the gate was being used many times every day.
It didn’t take long before she cracked the code!
’Override Successful...’Mei thought.
Just like that, the massive gate creaked open.
Clank!
Clank!
Confusion spread among the slaves, who whispered nervously...
As for the Sentinels, they immediately began checking the controller to see if there had been a malfunction.
Kai smiled as he saw this.
The reason why he didn’t want to break the shelter’s gate was obvious...
He planned to occupy this base as well!
With his Keen Sense Lv5, he scanned the area.
Every vibration, every metallic step, echoed in his mind.
Soon, he counted the number of remaining enemies!
’So there are 25 Sentinels and 5 Spyder Units...’
The Sentinels were armed with standard rifles, but the Spyders carried plasma rifles...
Of course, at this point, Kai’s team also had plasma rifles, giving them a fighting chance.
He then turned to his team.
He knew that Jonas had been training really well with his gun.
At the very least, he shoots in the training grounds with 20 rounds per day.
He should have a better aim now...
As for Claire, there was no need to question her abilities.
He wouldn’t even be surprised if she said that her stats were higher than his.
After all, her physical qualities greatly correlated with the wealth she had!
"Alright...
Atom!
Go in front!
Focus on the five Spyders on the buildings!" Kai said as he swiftly followed behind.
"Jonas, stay at the back!
Just act as our support!
Claire, there’s no need for Spirit Possession!
Just go rampage!"
Bang!
Atom charged forward and even crashed into the Sentinel, blocking its path!
Its heavy frame shook the ground as it moved so fast!
Immediately, the other Sentinels locked onto him, and rifles were fired!
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
Bullets clattered against his armor, but Atom was an A‐Grade Sentinel...
Their rounds couldn’t pierce him.
Atom ignored the gunfire entirely, with its sensors locked on the five Spyders perched on the watchtowers!
Meanwhile, Kai moved right behind him, activating his skills in quick succession.
[ Specter Step Lv3: Activated ]
[ Spirit Points -20 ]
His body blurred, vanishing into a ghostlike dash.
In an instant, he crossed the open ground and moved through the battlefield with impossible speed!
It didn’t end there as he triggered another ability!
[ Spirit Pulse Lv5: Activated ]
[ Spirit Points -70 ]
A shockwave of condensed spirit energy erupted from his palm, slamming into a cluster of Sentinels.
Boom!
The blast staggered them, disrupting their aim and leaving Atom free to advance on the Spyders.
Claire followed close behind.
The invisible spirit bound to her whispered insistently, urging her to allow possession, but she ignored it.
"Shut the hell up!"
She didn’t need it.
Her own strength was enough!
Claire steadied her plasma rifle as she began shooting at the enemies!
Fwoosh!
Fwoosh!
Fwoosh!
Seven precise shots tore through the battlefield!
Each shot burned straight through a Sentinel’s chest plate, dropping them one after another!
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Sentinel (E) ]
"They’re just E-Grade!
I think we’re wasting our Plasma Rifles..." Claire frowned as she thought that these Sentinels were at least D-Grade if not C-Grade.
In any case, the first three collapsed instantly with their cores ruptured.
The next two staggered before falling with their armor sizzling under the plasma fire.
The last pair tried to retreat, but Claire’s aim was merciless!
She dropped them down before they could regroup.
Her rifle hissed empty.
Without hesitation, she tossed it aside and surged forward.
[ Breakstride Lv5: Activated ]
[ Spirit Points -10 ]
It was a short‐range burst movement that only lasted for 5 seconds.
However, it was enough!
Her body blurred, closing the gap in a moment...
Soon, the nearest Sentinel raised its weapon, but Claire was already upon it.
She seized its head in both hands.
[ Titan Grip Lv4: Activated ]
[ Spirit Points -20 ]
Crunch!

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Occupation
paragraphs: Crunch!
The metal warped from the force of her grip!
In just a few moments, she crushed the Sentinel’s head like brittle glass.
Bam!
There was a small exploration within its body before she turned and slammed the Sentinel into another one into the ground!
Furthermore, another Sentinel tried to slice her with their knife, but her hands moved and clutched the Sentinel’s neck!
Without hesitation, she snapped its neck joint. This move made it easier for her to crush their cores!
One after another, the Sentinels fell beneath her hands.
She ripped a weapon arm free, threw a machine into its comrade, then crushed another’s head with terrifying ease.
Well, her title, Stronger, kept her body steady, almost shrugging off stray bullets and shockwaves.
[ Stronger ]
[ Title Effect: Increases defense and resistance to physical damage by +4%. When engaged in battle, your body adapts against impact, reducing the chance of being stunned or knocked down. ]
Even as explosions rattled the compound, she remained unshaken!
Kai then glanced sideways as he cut down another enemy.
"Claire... Take care of those Sentinels guarding the workers!" Kai said, referring to the human slaves working in the field.
Kai was worried that the Sentinels would suddenly harm them...
"Got it!"
Claire nodded and moved swiftly...
"I’ll take care of them!"
Kai was indeed correct!
The Sentinels guarding the slaves seemed to be planning something!
In the meantime, Jonas stayed at the rear, just as Kai ordered, covering their advance with shots from his Plasma Rifle...
Fwoosh! Fwoosh!
His training showed good results since his aim was better now! He didn’t expect that each shot was able to find its mark!
’I’m actually good at this...’Jonas was surprised.
’Nice, Jonas...’Kai thought after noticing his good aim.
At this time, Atom had already reached the base of the watchtower... Soon, several plasma fire rained down from above.
But he was able to take cover and dodge them.
Then, he raised his own Plasma Rifle, and started returning fire at them!
The Spyders Units didn’t like that move, so they increased the intensity of their fire!
Still, even if Atom barely had time to dodge or hide, it didn’t take long before it was able to get closer!
For a moment, Atom took several plasma shots...
Soon, its armor sparked under the impact, but the android pressed forward...
With a sudden burst of speed, Atom leapt upward!
This time, it had a blade on its left hand!
The Spyders adjusted their aim, but Atom was already too close.
Slash!
The blade carved through the first Spyder’s leg joint, severing it cleanly.
However, that wasn’t enough for this six-legged mechanical soldier! With another slash that severed two more of its legs, the Spyder got out of balance!
One more push from Atom sealed its fate!
Crash!
The machine toppled from the watchtower, crashing into the ground below.
Atom then turned, striking again, slicing through another Spyder’s arms, dropping its weapon before its head was cut off!
One by one, the mechanical units lost their footing, collapsing as Atom dismantled their supports.
At the same time, Kai also continued overwhelming the enemies!
[ Specter Step Lv3: Activated ]
[ Spirit Points -20 ]
His body seemed to have disappeared as he targeted the next Sentinel...
Bullets whizzed past, but his superior speed carried him safely between cover. He reappeared behind a group of four E-Grade Sentinels, with a palm already filled with spiritual energy...
Spirit Pulse!
Just like that, another 70 Spirit Points were used, leaving him with only 70 Points!
Still, the shockwave of spirit energy erupted, blasting the Sentinels backward.
Their rifles clattered to the ground as their internal systems malfunctioned!
Kai didn’t stop as he finished them off with his axe!
Bang! Bang!
Soon, he failed to dodge several gunshots, but thankfully, he invested a lot in his Bronze Skin!
Rounds struck his body, but the reinforced skin absorbed the impact!
Well, it was still painful, but it didn’t pierce his body!
He gritted his teeth, charging straight into the nearest Sentinel. His axe swung, cleaving through its chest plate.
Another fell as he spun... This time, he no longer triggered his Spirit Pulse since he wouldn’t feel good once his Spirit Points were empty!
Instead, he relied more on his Specter Step like he was used to!
Then, Mei finally made her move.
Still cloaked in Living Camouflage, she slipped behind unsuspecting Sentinels.
They didn’t even register her presence until it was too late!
Her blade moved, cutting through the Sentinel’s core before it could even react!
Another Sentinel turned, confused, but Mei was already gone, as she blended back into the shadows.
She struck again, eliminating another without a sound.
The battlefield was chaos...

Atom dismantling Spyders, Kai eliminating all Sentinels affected by Spirit Pulse, Claire crushing machines with her bare hands, Jonas firing precise cover shots, and Mei assassinating targets from the shadows.
The two remaining Spyders tried to regroup, but Atom also crippled their legs. One toppled from the tower, another was impaled by Atom’s blade!
Kai then capitalized more on his Bronze Skin as he cut down the remaining Sentinels!
At the same time, Claire finished the last of the guards near the slaves, slamming one Sentinel into the dirt before crushing its core.
She glanced back at the humans, ensuring they were safe, then rejoined Kai.
"Hahaha! Two more!"
Jonas fired his last shot, dropping one of those Sentinels!
Claire and Kai planned to kill the last E-Grade Sentinel, but Mei emerged from the shadows!
"Ahhh..."
"Right... You’re there..."
Kai and Claire paused as they saw her camouflage cancelled as the last Sentinel collapsed after its core was pierced by Mei’s sword.
"All clear," Mei said softly as she smiled at Kai.
Just like that, the battlefield fell silent.
Broken machines littered the ground with smoke rising from shattered cores.
Meanwhile, the enslaved humans stared in disbelief... Everything happened so quickly!
"Good job, everyone..."
Kai said scanned the area with Keen Sense.

"Minor injuries only," Kai muttered after checking his team. Atom’s armor was scorched but intact. Claire had a few scratches, Jonas’ shoulder was grazed, and Mei’s breathing was heavy, but she was not injured... It was nothing serious.
Now, Kai turned to Jonas... It was time to utilize his Talent!

chapters.title: Chapter 167: Great Surprise
paragraphs: Claire couldn’t help but glare at Kai’s behavior.
"You’re unbelievable. First you terrify them, then you go straight to their food."
However, Jonas just chuckled while Mei shook her head. They seemed more amused.
Nonetheless, the slaves, still trembling, watched as the Augmented Humans turned their attention to the fields.
Their shock slowly gave way to hope once again.
Whatever strange sense of humor they have, these humans had fought for them...
The slaves shifted uneasily, their chains clinking as they exchanged nervous glances.
Soon, one of them stepped forward.
His face was bony, his body was frail, but his eyes had a spark of determination.
"My name is Noli," he said. "We... we don’t know much. But I have guesses."
Kai tilted his head, impressed by the man’s courage.
He repeated the name slowly, as if committing it to memory.
"Noli. Good. Tell me what you know. Anything helps."
Noli nodded. He swallowed hard as he was thirsty, but he continued.
"At first, we thought we were being kept here to be meatshields."
Claire’s expression darkened.
Jonas and Mei also had a serious look. All of them understood immediately.
They all knew the tactic.
The Sentinels had been seen before, strapping naked humans to their frames, chaining them as living shields.
It was a cruel design, one meant to force the Survivors to hesitate in battle. Every strike against the machines risked killing an innocent, and that hesitation was exactly what the A.I. wanted.
"Meatshields, huh..." Kai sighed.

Noli’s voice shook as he continued. "Yes... that’s what we feared. But then, we realized something else. We weren’t just meatshields. We were bait. The machines wanted us alive so that other survivors would try to rescue us. And when they came... they’d be slaughtered. It happened a few times already. Those who tried rescuing us died from the plasma fires of the Spyders."
Claire nodded grimly. "That makes sense..."
Noli’s gaze drifted toward the fields, before he continued.
"As for the crops... both inside and outside the base... I believe they’re not food. They’re bioweapons."
This time, the four Foreign Survivors suddenly went silent.
Jonas frowned. "Bioweapons? You mean... the plants themselves?"

Noli nodded. "We don’t know the details. But some of us noticed strange things. The soil is treated with chemicals. The crops grow too fast, too uniform. And sometimes, when they harvest, the machines take samples away. Not for us. For something else."
Kai’s eyes squinted as he realized what was going on and he gently nodded.
"So the A.I. keeps humans alive to tend these fields... not to feed them, but to cultivate something dangerous. They’re hitting three birds in one stone for keeping you all alive."

Claire’s voice was quiet, thoughtful. "It fits. The crops could be engineered to produce toxins, spores, or compounds. Maybe humans are forced to grow them because their biology stabilizes the process. Machines can’t replicate that."
"Naah... That’s too far-fetched." Kai said with a dismissive.
"Anything can happen now at this point." Mei added, reminding Kai that they were in a mystical world.
Claire clenched her fists. "Whatever the reason, it’s twisted. They’re using people as farmers for weapons meant to kill more people."
The other slaves, who had no idea about their crops, whispered among themselves. They didn’t expect that Noli had a guess about their situation.
Just like that, fear started mixing with relief. They had lived in ignorance, but now the truth was beginning to take shape.
Kai exhaled slowly and his gaze swept across the chained workers. "We’ll figure out the purpose of these crops. But first..."
Claire stepped forward, cutting him off sharply.
"Kai. Enough talk. Look at them. They’re still chained. We need to free them before anything else."
Her voice carried authority, and even Kai paused. She was right.
The slaves looked down at their wrists and ankles, iron shackles biting into their skin.
The chains rattled with every movement, a constant reminder of their captivity.
Kai nodded. "You’re right. We need the keys."
Jonas glanced around the compound. "The Sentinels must have carried them. Or maybe the Spyders kept them in storage."
Mei’s eyes turned as she scanned the wreckage. "I’ll search the bodies. If they’re not here, then I’ll search their base.
Claire turned back to the slaves, and her tone became softer now.
"We’ll get you out. Just hold on a little longer."
Noli’s eyes glistened as he heard Claire’s angelic voice...
It was as if he was hearing a revelation from his god. "Ahhh... Thank you... thank you all. We thought we’d never see this day."
Kai crouched beside him and smiled.
"Noli, you’ve given us valuable information... Wait. You should all receive something first."
Kai rose to his feet, scanning the group. His Keen Sense had swiftly confirmed their number... forty slaves in total.
He exhaled, then activated his Talent.
[ Infinite Gift Pack: Activated ]
[ Basic Gift Pack Selection ]
[ Enhanced Gift Pack Selection ]
Without hesitation, he selected the Enhanced version before selecting the packs he needed.
Just like that, he selected five Food Gift Packs (Enhanced) and five Water Gift Packs (Enhanced).

Soon, Kai opened one of the packs, revealing vacuum‐sealed rations, canned goods, dried fruits, and even a portable stove with fuel canisters. Another pack spilled out, water bottles, purification tablets, and an insulated canteen.
The slaves gasped audibly.
Noli’s eyes widened, his lips trembling. "Food... real food..."
One of the women covered her mouth with tears streaming down her face as she saw the dried fruits.
Another man reached forward hesitantly, as if afraid it was an illusion.
Claire crossed her arms, still glaring at Kai but unable to hide a faint smile. "You’re unbelievable. First, you scare them, now you’re spoiling them."
Jonas chuckled. "Well, at least this time it’s a good surprise."
The slaves crowded closer, their chains clinking as they knelt around the packs.
Some even started praying.
As Mei was still looking for the keys, it didn’t take long before the smell of sealed soup packs and coffee sachets started spreading...
Glug... Glug... Glug...
The place was filled with amusing sounds as the smell from the food was enough to make their stomachs growl.
Kai didn’t point this out as he handed Noli a bottle of clean water.
"Here. Wash your hands, drink, and eat. You’ll all have your share."
As he said this, he suddenly heard Mei screaming inside the main building!
Kyaaahh!

Without hesitation, he selected the Enhanced version before selecting the packs he needed.
Just like that, he selected five Food Gift Packs (Enhanced) and five Water Gift Packs (Enhanced).
Soon, Kai opened one of the packs, revealing vacuum‐sealed rations, canned goods, dried fruits, and even a portable stove with fuel canisters.
Another pack spilled out, water bottles, purification tablets, and an insulated canteen.
The slaves gasped audibly.
Noli’s eyes widened, his lips trembling.
"Food... real food..."
One of the women covered her mouth with tears streaming down her face as she saw the dried fruits.
Another man reached forward hesitantly, as if afraid it was an illusion.
Claire crossed her arms, still glaring at Kai but unable to hide a faint smile.
"You’re unbelievable.
First, you scare them, now you’re spoiling them."
Jonas chuckled.
"Well, at least this time it’s a good surprise."
The slaves crowded closer, their chains clinking as they knelt around the packs.
Some even started praying.
As Mei was still looking for the keys, it didn’t take long before the smell of sealed soup packs and coffee sachets started spreading...
Glug...
Glug...
Glug...
The place was filled with amusing sounds as the smell from the food was enough to make their stomachs growl.
Kai didn’t point this out as he handed Noli a bottle of clean water.
"Here.
Wash your hands, drink, and eat.
You’ll all have your share."
As he said this, he suddenly heard Mei screaming inside the main building!
Kyaaahh!

chapters.title: Chapter 168: The Crops and the Supplies
paragraphs: As the group of slaves started having some food and water, Kai and the others continued looking around the area, searching for the keys, spoils, or anything they could use.
Jonas moved toward the fallen Sentinels, checking their belts and compartments.
"Nothing here. Just ammo and tools."
Mei also moved swiftly as she searched the towers.

Minutes later, she returned, holding a ring of keys with a terrible look! It seemed as if she had just battled against something! However, none of them was able to get the reason why as she dismissed their questions...
"Found them. Locked in a storage box near the watchtower."
Claire received the keys and walked toward the slaves. One by one, she unlocked their chains, and soon, the iron started falling away with heavy clinks.
Kai watched as the workers rubbed their wrists with tears streaming down their faces.
Noli bowed his head deeply. "We owe you our lives."
Kai shook his head. "No. You owe us nothing. What matters now is survival. Stay close. We’ll secure this base, then figure out what these crops are really for."
Jonas smirked faintly. "And that’s where I come in, right? Iron Stomach. Guess I’ll be the guinea pig."
Claire shot him a look. "Don’t joke about that."
Kai’s lips curved into a grin. "Actually, Jonas is perfect for this. If these crops are poisoned or engineered, his Talent will reveal it. We’ll know exactly what we’re dealing with."
To be honest, Kai was a bit worried about this as well. After all, he wasn’t too sure about the powers of the Iron Stomach.
However, since Jonas could literally eat a rusty pipe, he should be strong enough to handle poison.
Mei folded her arms. "Then we’ll finally understand why the A.I. keeps humans alive here."
The slaves gathered closer, listening intently. They were also curious since they only had guesses before.
Finally, Kai rose to his feet and scanned the field.
"Alright. Let me appraise it first." Kai said.
"Huh? You have an Appraisal Skill?" Jonas was dumbfounded. It meant that he didn’t really have to eat these bioweapon crops!
Kai nodded. "It gives basic information. But I still want you to try later. I’m hoping you’ll gain buffs from these crops. You’re not satisfied being a simple gate guard, are you?"
Jonas chuckled nervously. "Fair point."
Kai stepped forward, touching the first crop... It was a potato‐like tuber with violet and orange spots.
[ Fast Appraisal Activated ]
[ Spirit Point Cost: 13 ]
[ Cooldown: 20 seconds ]
After reaching Level 2, the cost had gone down to 13 and the Cooldown was reduced as well.
Soon, the system window appeared before his eyes:
[ You have discovered Mutagenic Root! ]
[ Grade: Hazardous Material ]
[ Description: A genetically altered tuber designed to produce unstable toxins. When consumed, it can trigger mutations in organic tissue or destabilize biological systems. ]
[ Note: This crop is not intended for food. It is harvested as raw material for bioweapon development. Prolonged exposure may weaken human immune systems. ]
"Ohhh... This is seems to be a bit more dangerous than I thought."
Kai wryly smiled as he explained to Jonas.
"Mutagenic Root... hazardous material. It’s exactly what Noli suspected. These aren’t food... they’re bioweapons. Jonas... I think you let’s not risk it."
The slaves gasped, whispering among themselves. Some recoiled from the fields, horrified that they had been planting weapons all along.
Jonas scratched his head, trying to mask his unease. "Well... I think I can do it. I can even it metal, even mirrors... My Iron Stomach can take it!"
Kai turned to him and confirmed that he was determined to proceed with this.
"Yes. We’ll remember your sacrifice... or your dedication. If you can consume it safely, we’ll learn whether these crops can be turned against the machines."
"What? Sacrifice? Don’t jinx it, Kai..." Claire said. She really wants to smack him sometimes.
Jonas crouched down, staring at the strange tuber Kai had just appraised. The violet and orange spots looked harmless.
He scratched his head, then shrugged. "Well... I’ve eaten worse."
Claire’s eyes narrowed. "Jonas, you don’t have to—"
But before she could stop him, Jonas bit into the Mutagenic Root. The taste was bitter, pungent, almost steel. He forced himself to chew, swallowing with a grimace.
The system chimed immediately:
[ Iron Stomach Activated ]
[ Hazardous Material Consumed: Mutagenic Root ]
[ Buff Gained: Toxic Fortitude ]
[ +100% resistance to poison and toxins for 40 minutes. ]
Jonas gagged, clutching his stomach for a moment. "Ugh... tastes like rotten batteries." He coughed, then straightened, his face pale but determined. "But I’m fine. See? Iron Stomach works."
He then explained what he got.
Kai’s eyes lit up. "Toxic Fortitude... 100% resistance for 40 minutes impressive..."
There were still 3 other types of crops and Kai was already curious what they’d see.
Meanwhile, the slaves gasped as they saw what Jonas did.
They had seen Jonas eat something that should have killed him, only for him to just complain about the taste!
To them, it looked like sorcery.
Even Noli’s voice trembled with awe. "He... he ate poison."
Meanwhile, as Kai and the others were busy with the new territory, it was raining hard outside New Haven Shelter‐45.

At this time, within the chamber inside the main building of the shelter, Sera could be seen idly playing with her dagger... It was her gene weapon, a blade she could manifest out of thin air whenever she wished.
The chamber she was guarding wasn’t just storage. It was filled with supplies Kai had personally gathered and organized. Crates of food, weapons, and gear lined the walls, each marked and catalogued.
Security here rotated between Kai himself, Claire, Althea, and Sera. Tonight, it was Sera’s turn...
Clank...
The door opened, and Victor stepped inside, while shaking water from his shoulders. He glanced around the chamber, impressed by the neat rows of supplies.
"I heard Kai provided new supplies. Is that true?" Victor asked.

Sera looked up, her dagger vanishing with a flick of her hand. "Yes. But the prices are the same. Kai didn’t mention any changes. Also, we have raincoats now. He provided them... It’s perfect timing..."
Victor’s eyes lit up. "Raincoats... that’s good. And is it true I can get a semi‐automatic pistol now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 169: The New Trading Arrangement
paragraphs: Victor’s eyes immediately lit up at the mention of the semi‐automatic pistol. He then learned more about it from Sera.
Compared to the old revolvers, this was a leap forward.
A revolver carried only six rounds, and reloading in the middle of a firefight was slow and clumsy.
But a semi‐automatic pistol, specifically the M9 Beretta, the model Kai had secured, carried seventeen rounds in a single magazine!
That meant nearly triple the firepower before reloading, and faster reloads with spare magazines.
For survivors who often faced multiple Sentinels or mutants, the difference between six bullets and seventeen could mean life or death.
Victor’s voice carried a mix of excitement and disbelief. "Then, for one Survivor Medal... how many rounds of ammunition can I get?"
Sera smiled as she could tell that Victor realized how amazing this was... She then replied with a calm voice.

"Previously, one Survivor Medal could be exchanged for a revolver with at least fifty rounds. But Kai has changed the system. Now, one medal gets you a semi‐automatic pistol with three extra magazines, plus two boxes of ammunition with forty rounds each. That’s eighty bullets, on top of the loaded pistol and magazines. It also comes with a holster, an axe, and a freebie of two stun grenades."
Victor blinked, stunned. "Stun grenades?!" His voice rose in disbelief. "We only had smoke grenades before!"
Sera smirked.

"Kai upgraded the options. Amazing, right? I think he has improved his ability to acquire resources. Anyway, stun grenades can disable machines for a few seconds, enough to give you an opening. It’s a huge advantage."
Victor’s mind raced. He knew the value of a Survivor Medal. One medal wasn’t easy to earn, it represented weeks of survival and acknowledgement from the system.

In the past, a single medal could cover food and necessities for four people for two weeks with three meals a day, clean water, living quarters, and protection under Shelter‐45’s defenses. Obviously, it could increase if they only eat once per day.

Then, if the group contributed more with tailoring, crafting, cooking, or other production skills, the medal’s value could easily stretch to a month, sometimes even longer. It was the currency of survival, tied directly to the prosperity of the shelter.
And now, that same medal could buy not just food or shelter, but a weapon package powerful enough to change a survivor’s odds in battle.
Victor realized this wasn’t just about survival anymore... it was about fighting back. Perhaps, Kai was gearing them up to hunt more Sentinels!
He didn’t hesitate.
"I’ll make the trade."
Sera nodded, retrieving the pistol set from one of the crates. She laid out the Beretta M9, the spare magazines, the two boxes of ammunition, the holster, the axe, and finally, the two stun grenades.
Victor stared at the collection, his hands trembling slightly as he picked up the pistol. The weight felt solid, reassuring.
"This... this changes everything," he whispered.
"Ohhh... Here. Since this is your first transaction. Kai mentioned to give you this." Sera said as she provided Victor with a Signal Jammer!
"Wait? Signal Jammer?" Victor was surprised.
"Yep... This way, you can hunt Swarmers without any issues." Sera replied.
Swarmers were terrifying not because of their strength but because of their ability to call for backup!
But now, it was different. With the Signal Jammer, he’d no longer fear going outside!
"Uhmm... Can I have a raincoat as well?" Victor asked.
Sera stared at him for a moment and nodded.
Then, after getting raining, he didn’t waste any more time. Victor left the chamber and spread the news throughout the New Haven Shelter‐45.
The other Survivors gathered, listening in awe as he explained the new trade system.
They were still doubting the new pistol since they were already used to the revolver’s recoil and had almost mastered it by now.
However, the mention of extra magazines and a higher number of bullets, including the stun grenades, sent a ripple of excitement through the crowd...
"Stun grenades?" Aurora asked.
"Is it like a flashbang in the games I’ve heard about?" Marissa guessed after recalling her classmates talking about some FPS shooting games before.
"Yes. That’s basically the same thing..." Wallace replied.
It was certainly a tool they had never imagined having.
Just like that, word spread quickly... Without Kai’s knowledge, his Survivor Medals increased even more!
Soon, Victor stepped out of the main building, pulling the hood of his new raincoat tighter against the downpour.
The rain was calmer now, but it was still soaking the muddy ground around the shelter. Still, he didn’t care.
He was still excited about his new weapon. With the pistol at his side, and the signal jammer tucked safely away. He felt ready for battle despite being just a mechanic.
Nonetheless, as he went out, his excitement was ignited even more after seeing the massive artillery piece waiting outside.
The weapon was huge. It was nearly ten meters long, its barrel stretching like a steel spear.
Its body was also quite bulky, filled with heavy plating, supported by six mechanical legs designed to anchor and adjust the gun’s position.

They had salvaged it after eliminating the Sentinels and Spyders that had tried to siege the shelter. It wasn’t operational yet, but Victor and his small team had been working tirelessly to position it properly.
Even half‐assembled, the artillery was a sight to behold.
It had the potential to change the balance of power.
Once completed, it could tear through enemy ranks, destroy advancing machines, and give New Haven Shelter‐45 a true defensive backbone.
Victor’s heart raced at the thought of firing it for the first time.
He imagined the thunderous roar, the recoil shaking the ground, and the machines scattering under its destructive force...
"The Sentinels will be no match for this..."
Unfortunately, the rain made progress difficult.
Mud sucked at their boots, tools slipped from wet hands, and visibility was poor. Still, Victor pressed on, determined to see the artillery standing tall.
Then, movement caught his eye.
A few silhouettes appeared in the distance, blurred by the sheets of rain.
At the same time, the watcher stationed in the tower spotted them as well.
Cling! Cling! Cling!
The alarm bell rang out, echoing across the compound.
Everyone froze.
They have visitors!

chapters.title: Chapter 171: The Trades and the New Territory
paragraphs: Jyrus had seen many shelters before, and most of them were miserable places.
He couldn’t help but compare those other places as he walked through Shelter‐45.
Well, in other settlements, filth was everywhere... Trash piled in corners, sewage leaking into walkways, and the stench of human waste was impossible to ignore.
People rarely bathed, saving every drop of water for drinking. Clothes were worn for months without change, some were even stiff with grime and sweat.
The air in those places wasn’t good. It was suffocating, and every step reminded him of how fragile human survival had become.
But here, it was different.
Even with the rain dripping from the roofs and pooling in the mud outside, Shelter‐45 felt clean. The east building, where Wallace had directed them to set up, was tidy and organized.
No trash littered the floors, no foul odor clung to the walls.
Without a doubt, the survivors here had clearly established routines for hygiene and order. They might even have assigned personnel for cleaning alone.
"But what’s even more amazing is this..." Jyrus muttered as he looked at the walls...
Apparently, what struck him most was the light!
Flashlights illuminated the corridors, and emergency lamps glowed faintly along the walls.
They definitely had access to batteries, and it must be a huge amount!
Of course, it also wouldn’t be surprising if they have access to Solar Generator.
"This shelter is way better than the ones we visited before," Jyrus muttered, and his companions nodded in agreement.
Unlike the dim, foul‐smelling shelters he had entered before, this place was bright and clear. It was quite impressive that they had enough batteries to keep the compound lit
Even the air smelled fresher...
Then, as he continued setting up their small stall, Jyrus realized that this shelter must have access to antibacterial soap.
It was quite amazing that they had such items to maintain hygiene.
From within, Jyrus couldn’t help but feel excited...
’This place is thriving. I hope I can earn enough...’
An hour passed, and the east building had transformed into a marketplace.
Jyrus’s team worked quickly, unpacking crates, laying out goods on tables, and arranging their wares swiftly.
Well, they had done this a lot already.
The tarps were pulled back, revealing weapons, tools, clothing, and even luxuries that survivors hadn’t seen in a while.
Jyrus clapped his hands once, satisfied.
"Alright, everything’s ready. Let’s begin."
Victor, already standing nearby, eyed the tables. "So... Survivor Medals for the big stuff, right?"

Jyrus nodded. "Correct. Survivor Medals, C‐Rank cores from A.I. soldiers, are the only currency we accept for important items. Ahem... Of course, if you’re going to give us those Plasma Rifles... I can consider them."
Victor wryly smiled at this and shook his head. They also needed Plasma Rifles. There was no way he could trade them without Kai’s permission.
Although they do not have enough energy cells or cores to modify and charge these weapons, they were still too precious.
"Understandable. Anyway, Gene enhancement serums, firearms, specialized gear... those require Medals or Cores."

He then gestured to another section of the table. "But for basics, we can just barter. Cigarettes, clothes, paper, incense, bells, ingots, jewelry, MRE boxes... all of these can be traded for items we find useful. If you have revolver bullets, smoke grenades, bicycles, some food... it depends on what you bring."
A survivor stepped forward, pointing at a stack of MRE boxes. "How much for those?"
"They’ll expire in a month, and they only contain 12 packs each... So a box of revolver rounds will do." Jyrus replied smoothly. "Fair trade."
Another survivor from the Sanitation Crew leaned closer to a golden ring.
"Jewelry? You’re really trading that?"
Jyrus smirked. "People value such things... Sometimes, they want to remember who they were."
The crowd murmured...
Still, none of them purchased anything just yet.
For now, Victor confirmed that Jyrus was also selling Alpha Gene Enhancement Serums together with Emerald and Crimson Gene Enhancement Serums.
"Ohh? Only 10 Survivor Medals for the Alpha?" Victor asked. Although it was still more than double the price from the Gene Trader, it was less than what Diego and Santiago’s price!
Jyrus nodded. "Yes! It’s cheaper, right? We managed to find our supplier, and we purchased a lot from them. Since we have a lot of stocks, we’re offering them for a lower price."
"I see... Still expensive, but I understand." Victor said as he stepped back. He wasn’t interested in the items at all. He had already purchased enough Gene Enhancements anyway.
Soon, other survivors began lining up.
Russel came and traded a smoke grenade for two sets of clean clothes.
Mila from the Sanitation Crew offered a folding bicycle for a set of incense, papers, and a wristwatch, for an unknown reason...

Another survivor nervously asked about what item he could trade for one Survivor Medal... Jyrus explained that even if he couldn’t provide a vial of Gene Enhancement Serum, he could offer about 5mL of Crimson Gene Enhancement Serum for one Survivor Medal.
"I don’t think you’ll regret this..." Jyrus said as he looked at the Survivor Medal.
"I... I’ll think about it." Augustine said... Well, he actually received the medal from Kai himself after he got rewarded for his efforts during the last event.

Since it was raining, they couldn’t really hunt for Sentinels outside. Thanks to the presence of the merchants, they weren’t bored anymore.

All of them looked healthy and clean.
’I should inform the other merchants about this place...’

’Did they encounter strong enemies?’
’No way... Atom is there... They shouldn’t worry about low-tier mechanized soldiers.’
’But what if—’

Then, on the next day, they received a message from Kai on the radio!
"We’ve claimed another base from the machines... I’m about to return. Inform Aurora to get ready... I need her in that new shelter..."

chapters.title: Chapter 172: The Unexpected Companion
paragraphs: The next morning, the storm had finally passed.
The sky was still gray, but it was already calm. Still, the roads were filled with puddles left behind by the heavy rain.
At this time, Kai led the small group, with Aurora, Russel, and Amer, toward the newly claimed shelter.
Aurora walked beside him with her boots splashing lightly in the shallow water.
"Kai, what are we going to call this new shelter? You haven’t named it yet."
Kai slowed his pace, as he hadn’t considered it yet...
"Hmm... I haven’t decided. Names should be good since they’ll be on the maps. They’re also going to become our identity. What do you think?"
Russel chuckled. "If you ask me, we should call itIron Haven. Sounds strong and dependable. I think people will feel safe hearing it... probably."

Amer shook his head. "Too boorish. It sounds like a Blacksmith City or something. I’d go with something simpler, likeClearwater. After all, it will attract other Survivors too. Water means life, and if they hear about this shelter, they’ll feel safe for sure..."
Aurora smiled faintly. "Both good suggestions. But I’d prefer something that inspires hope. MaybeDawn Era. A name that reminds people of light after darkness."
Kai listened carefully... "Iron Haven, Clearwater... and Dawn Era. They all sound great, but I’ll think about it. We’ll decide once we get there."
The group continued along the muddy path until the terrain leveled out into a flat road.
Thankfully, they didn’t encounter enemies so far...
Soon, Kai stopped the group, then reached into his inventory. With a wave of his hand, a folding bicycle appeared in his hands.
Aurora did the same, pulling out another.
Russel’s eyes widened. "You’ve got bikes?"
Kai smirked. "Of course. I’ve got an extra. Here, Russel... take it." He handed over the bicycle, adjusting the handlebars.
Aurora turned to Amer. "And this one’s for you..."
At this time, Kai and Aurora only had limited Inventory Slots, but they deliberately stored bicycles for this situation.
Amer and Russel smiled and immediately accepted the familiar folding bicycles. They had already tried using them back in the shelter, so they weren’t new to this.
Russel couldn’t help but laugh as he mounted his bicycle. "So we’re going to use this to arrive early. Nice..."
Kai also swung onto his own, adjusting the seat. "That’s right... Let’s move. It’ll be faster this way."
The four of them pedaled down the road...
It was such a strange experience as the morning air felt cool against their faces.
However, Kai also noticed that someone was watching them...
’It’s not an A.I. Soldier... Must be a survivor.’Kai thought as he decided to ignore the stalker for now.
He just continued pedaling like the others. It felt as if the wasteland didn’t feel oppressive. It didn’t feel like there was an A.I. Apocalypse as they passed along the road...
After some time, the outline of the new shelter came into view. Its walls were scarred but it had a thick metal gate protecting the base.
As they approached, something unexpected caught their attention.
Outside the shelter, Mei was crouched down, laughing softly.
Beside her, a golden retriever wagged its tail, bounding playfully in the mud.
Russel blinked. "Is that... a dog?"
Amer’s jaw dropped. "I thought they were all gone. I haven’t seen one except from the picture books..."
Aurora also slowed her bike, smiling in disbelief. "A golden retriever... here of all places."
Kai stopped, resting one foot on the ground.
Kai couldn’t help but smile wryly at the sight.
Yesterday, Mei had screamed with a resounding’Kyaah’while searching for the keys, and this was the cause. It hadn’t been a Sentinel or any enemy at all... it was this dog!
Mei looked up, with her face filled with excitement.
"Kai! Look! He’s friendly!"
She hugged the retriever, who licked her cheek enthusiastically.
It was definitely a rare sight...
Kai shook his head, amused. "In the middle of an A.I. apocalypse, and here we are... watching someone play with a dog."
Russel grinned. "Maybe that’s a good sign. If animals are still around, maybe the world isn’t completely lost."
Aurora dismounted before walking closer. She wanted to pet the dog but held herself back, clearing her throat instead.
"Ahem... so we have a pet now, huh? I wonder if we even have enough food to feed this one."

For survivors like them, even the locals who had consumed drops of Gene Enhancement Serums, hunger wasn’t a major issue. They could function on a single meal per day without much trouble. It only became a problem if they skipped food for several days.
Russel tilted his head, watching the retriever wag its tail.
"Wait... are we sure this isn’t some kind of cyborg? Machines have copied animals before."
Amer crouched beside Mei, inspecting the dog carefully. He pressed his hand against its fur, then checked its eyes and ears.
"No implants. No metal. It’s real. Just a dog."
Mei laughed after seeing this, since she had the same concern at first...
Then, she hugged the retriever tightly. "See? He drinks water like crazy and eats anything I give him. Leftovers, scraps... he doesn’t complain. As long as we share what we have, he’ll be fine."
Kai gently nodded as it wasn’t really a big concern. He wouldn’t mind opening Food Gift Packs for the dog every day.
"Then we’ll keep him. A shelter with a dog isn’t a bad idea. Besides, he might be useful. I heard that dogs can sense danger before we do."
Aurora finally allowed herself to reach out, stroking the retriever’s head.
"That’s right and they’re cute!"
Mei’s eyes sparkled. "Can we name him?"
Kai chuckled. "Another name to decide, huh? Just decided on it. You found him... or her, anyway."
"Him..." Mei corrected.
"Alright... I’ll think about it."
Just like that, the group entered the new shelter, and as soon as Aurora stepped inside, she immediately turned to look at the field.
Her Talent, Plant Enthusiast, immediately noticed the problem in the fields being tended by a group of people wearing Camouflage Suits, probably from Kai’s Gift Packs.
"Kai... Wait, this field is..."
Kai nodded as soon as he noticed her reaction.
"That’s right. That’s the reason why I brought you here..."

chapters.title: Chapter 173: The New Shelter
paragraphs: "Alright... Let’s get in."
The heavy metal doors creaked open as Kai pushed them aside, allowing Aurora, Russel, and Amer to see the main building of the shelter for the first time.
Immediately, the atmosphere shifted. This wasn’t just a survivor’s hideout, it had been an A.I. Army base. The evidence was everywhere.
Although there were no Automated Turrets and CCTVs everywhere like what Aurora imagined for an A.I. Base, she still knew that this was indeed a military base.
There were a total of three buildings in this shelter... The one in the east was the living quarters, the one in the west was the warehouse, but at the center was the main building.
As expected of the main building, it was filled with crates, and they were stacked neatly as if awaiting deployment.
Based on the signs, there were various weapons or supplies, like rifles and handguns.

Still, there were also ammunition boxes that piled high beside them. On the other side, they also noticed blades of varying sizes, some designed for humans, others clearly meant for mechanized soldiers.
But what truly stunned Aurora’s group were the spare parts scattered across the west building’s warehouse floor.

Extra limbs of Sentinels were everywhere! Mechanical Arms with pristine hydraulic joints, even spare legs of Spyders lay bundled together, probably for emergency usage if the A.I. Army needed quick replacements.
And among them, Kai pointed out the most valuable find... energy cells for plasma rifles, still sealed and untouched!
Aurora’s eyes widened. "This... this is incredible. With these supplies, Shelter‐45 could arm an entire battalion."

Kai nodded calmly. "Yes... That’s a nice surprise. I also didn’t expect to find that here. The machines left behind weapons and resources we can use. But we have to ensure that only people we trust can have these... We don’t want another Terrence incident."
Aurora nodded as she recalled the incident.
As they explored, Aurora’s group began to settle into their roles.
Amer, the cook, immediately moved toward the kitchen area.
Unfortunately, there weren’t any gas stoves he could use here, and he had to rely on dried wood for fire.
Though primitive, it had enough space and storage to work with. Kai had already arranged food packs and utensils, but Amer brought his own tools... a ladle, a pan, and a few knives he had kept safe.
"There’s a week’s worth of wood and dried branches... We should be fine for some time."
He pulled out a fire starter, striking sparks until a small flame caught.
Soon, smoke curled upward as he built a cooking fire.
Just like that, he set the pan over the flames, ready to prepare a proper meal. Well, he was sure that these guys were only eating by heating the MREs with some instant noodles...
Since Kai asked him to bring spices and various vegetables, he knew what he had to do...
Soon, the smell of sizzling rations quickly spread, drawing curious glances from the freed slaves nearby.
Meanwhile, Russel, the scout, was already inspecting the perimeter.
He greeted Jonas, who was guarding the wall as expected, since it was also his job back in New Haven Shelter-45.

He then started looking around, and he caught cracks in the walls and weak points near the gate. Without hesitation, he headed to the warehouse that Kai had pointed out and started rummaging through supplies until he found coils of barbed wire.
"Perfect," he muttered.
Using scattered stones and debris as anchors, Russel reinforced the weak spots, placing the barbed wire into improvised barriers.
Within an hour, the holes and cracks in the shelter’s defenses were filled with the help of a few other people who had noticed what he was trying to do.
Kai smiled as he observed all this quietly, impressed by how quickly the group adapted.
Amer served healthier meals, Russel was fortifying defenses, while Claire and the others seemed to be cataloguing weapons and energy cells.
Soon, Kai, Jonas, and Aurora were looking at the crop samples on the table...
"These crops..." Aurora muttered as she saw four baskets containing four different crops...
"These are what the slaves were forced to grow," Kai said.
"I’ve already appraised them..."
Kai then shared what he had found out... He pointed first to the potato‐like tuber with violet and orange spots.
[ Mutagenic Root ]
[ Grade: Hazardous Material
Description: A genetically altered tuber designed to produce unstable toxins. When consumed, it can trigger mutations in organic tissue or destabilize biological systems. ]
[ Note: Not intended for food. Harvested as raw material for bioweapon development. Prolonged exposure may weaken the human immune system. ]
Aurora frowned as she saw these...
Kai then moved to the second basket.
Inside were thick, pale stalks with spherical ends...
[ Disruptive Stem ]
[ Grade: Hazardous Material
Description: A modified stalk crop engineered to interfere with human gene stability. Prolonged contact or ingestion can disrupt gene mutations, weakening or nullifying enhancement serums. ]
[ Note: Survivors exposed may lose the benefits of specific gene enhancements temporarily. ]
Aurora’s eyes widened. "That’s... dangerous. If this spreads, it could undo everything the serums gave us."

Kai nodded. "Exactly. They’re cultivating weapons meant to cripple us. Anyway, a few of them nearby aren’t a big issue. Also, I don’t think those with Alpha Gene Enhancements will have issues. Jonas tried... I think only the low-quality ones will be affected."
He then pointed to the third basket. This one contained oily pods...
[ Oil Pod ]
[ Grade: Industrial Material
Description: A crop designed to produce synthetic oil. Not edible for humans. When processed, it serves as fuel and lubricant. ]
[ Note: Survivors cannot consume this safely. However, it may be repurposed as crude fuel for generators or mechanical repairs. ]
"Smells like engine grease..." Aurora muttered as she recalled the Artillery in New Haven Shelter-45.
Finally, Kai gestured to the fourth basket. Inside were small, thorny tubers...
[ Sustenance Vine ]
[ Grade: Hazardous Material ]

[ Description: A vine engineered to produce watery sap. When consumed, the juice fills satiety and prevents starvation, but it gradually poisons the body, weakening organs and causing long‐term damage. The leaves can also be eaten, offering temporary relief from hunger while accelerating the toxic effect. ]
[ Note: Survivors relying on it will eventually suffer organ failure or collapse from cumulative poisoning. ]
Aurora frowned at this as she realized that this crop was what kept the slaves alive.
However, she looked at Kai, confused by what he was trying to show her.
"Wait... Do you want me to cultivate these plants?"
