[ Alfie has joined Codebreakers Guild. ]
"Everyone...
Welcome to Codebreakers Guild!" Kai finally said as the group celebrated.
They even asked if they could brag about it in the World Chat...
However, as Kai planned to visit the warehouse, he soon realized something...
All of them were actually carrying the same type of sword!
"This..."

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Better Gift Packs
paragraphs: Kai’s eyes widened as he recognized the blades hanging at their sides.
"Wait... Steelbreaker?!" he gasped.
Only a few weeks had passed since he had transferred the Steelbreaker Sword’s blueprint, along with the Repeater Crossbow’s, to Elena.

She was the only Survivor with a Master‐Grade Artisan Talent, so there had been no doubt about her ability to craft them. But still, Kai hadn’t expected her to produce so many weapons in such a short time.
"Elena... where did you get enough—Ah!" His words trailed off as he realized the answer to his own question.
He had seen the blueprint himself. He knew exactly what material matched the requirements.
"You noticed?" Elena smiled knowingly. "That’s right. They’re all forged from the Tyrant’s armor plating. The alloy is a perfect match for the Steelbreaker Sword."

Kai nodded slowly. It made sense. Their team had harvested a large number of Tyrant parts during the previous event. Those pieces had been dismantled and stored in the warehouse, waiting for repairs or construction.
Elena had simply taken the initiative.

Furthermore, the system had allowed her to "learn" the blueprint directly. Once integrated into her Artisan Talent, the process became far more efficient. She no longer needed to reference the design every time... it was part of her skill set now.
"Tyrant’s armor... that’s perfect," Kai muttered in admiration.
Elena continued, as she patted her sword’s hilt...

"The furnace wasn’t difficult either. Just like what you suggestion the Field Tyrants have cores that function like built‐in furnaces. We modified one to fit our needs. Without that, production would’ve been impossible."
Kai nodded.
The Steelbreaker wasn’t just a sturdy blade. It was designed to shatter machines, to pierce through the hardened plating of mechanical soldiers. It had special effects brought by the system.
Having an entire squad armed with them would change everything.

"Hehe... that’s right," Elena added with a laugh. "If not for the Steelbreaker’s requirements, I’d probably just sharpen Tyrant steel with Victor’s help. Durable, sharp... but they wouldn’t carry the special effect. These swords are different. They’re made to break machines."
Kai exhaled, impressed. "I guess you have enough to make more of them. Can you craft additional sets for Freedom Shelter?"

His thoughts turned to the upcoming Surveillance Sweep. Freedom Shelter wasn’t that heavily protected yet, so equipping its defenders with Steelbreakers aside from the guns they have could mean the difference between survival and annihilation.

"Yes," Elena replied confidently. "That’s no problem. It’s for the Sweep, right? I have enough time to make twenty more before it begins. Right... I’ve already started on a batch of Repeater Crossbows too. As for arrows, they’re simpler. I’m handling the tips, while the others help with shafts and fletching."
Kai’s lips curved into a faint smile.
Twenty Steelbreakers. Repeater Crossbows... It was enough to arm both shelters with weapons designed specifically to counter machines...
Kai didn’t waste time and informed them not to focus on their Guild Mission for now. They needed to prepare the shelter for the upcoming event.
After that, Kai headed straight to the vault, pulling out more of his Gift Packs... Food, Weapons, and even the Stealth Gift Packs for the grenades...
He stacked them neatly, ensuring that everyone in Haven‐45 could access supplies whenever needed.
"Take what you need, when you need it," Kai reminded Sera, who was currently guarding the Vault.
"No hoarding. These packs are meant to keep you all alive through the Sweep."
Soon, even Althea, who was nearby, helped arrange the supplies that Kai had just taken out.
The Food Gift Packs were distributed first. Dried rations, canned goods, and nutrient bars filled the shelves, enough to sustain the shelter for weeks.
The Weapons Gift Packs followed, producing axe, guns, and ammunition that were quickly catalogued so they could be easily accessed by the fighters...
Finally, the Stealth Gift Packs were stored carefully... night vision goggles, signal jammers, and camouflage gear that could make the difference when drones passed overhead.
Kai didn’t stop there.
He joined the workers in reinforcing the shelter itself.
Together, the windows were sealed with steel plates, doors were layered with steel plates, and weak points were patched with scavenged metal.
Furthermore, he personally helped hammer boards into windows, ensuring no drone could slip through unnoticed.
Some time later, he assisted with trap placement outside, testing tripwires and adjusting angles so that any intruder would be funneled into kill zones.
By the time the work was done, Freedom Shelter looked far more reliable.
Then, as Kai wiped the sweat from his brow, a familiar chime echoed in his vision.
Ding!
[ Notification: Talent Upgrade complete. ]
[ Current Talent: Infinite Gift Pack (SSS) ]
Kai froze... The upgrade had finally finished.
Without hesitation, he checked his Talent.

[ Infinite Gift Pack (SSS): You can claim an unlimited number of Gift Packs at any time. There are no restrictions on frequency, quantity, or type. This talent grants continuous access to supplies, ensuring that Gift Packs are always available whenever you choose to obtain them. ]
It was still quite the same description.
Still, as he activated the [ Gift Pack Selection ]
He saw three tabs!
[ Basic Gift Pack Selection ]
[ Enhanced Gift Pack Selection ]
[ Superior Gift Pack Selection ]
"Superior!" Kia was expected.
Needless to say, his focus was immediately turned to three specific Gift Packs.
The first one was obviously the Weapon Gift Pack!
[ Weapon Gift Pack (Superior)
Contents: carbine rifle with spare magazines, shotgun with shell packs, spear, combat knife, protective vest, grenade launcher with smoke and fragmentation rounds, and extra ammunition crates. ]
"Oh my..." Kai was stunned as he realized that the upgrade this time was too huge!
"This is... a game changer!"
The carbine, shotgun, spear, vest, and grenade launcher were too huge an improvement to their arsenal!
Then, he swiftly turned to the second most important gift pack.
[ Stealth Gift Pack (Superior)
Contents: advanced camouflage gear, thermal detection goggles, portable disruptor field unit, flashbang grenades, decoy emitter device, and sensor‐disrupting smoke grenades ]
"Portable disruptor field unit?" Kai muttered as he saw something that caught his attention.

chapters.title: Chapter 187: The Superior Ones
paragraphs: Kai didn’t even bother checking the other packs. His attention was locked on one item alone.
"Portable disruptor field unit..." he muttered.
Without hesitation, Kai selected the Stealth Gift Pack.
The system confirmed his choice, and in an instant, the pack entered his inventory.
He immediately opened it, and soon, a wave of light filled the room as the items materialized before him.
The first item he took note of was the camouflage gear, since there was actually a set of them.
It wasn’t just a single suit.
There was a jacket, pants, gloves, boots, and a mask, all made from special fibers.
As he brushed his hand across the fabric, the material shifted in tone, blending with the steel wall behind him. Even the boots carried the same adaptive texture...
’Interesting piece of tech...’Kai mused.
It was equipment designed for full‐body integration, and he really liked it.

Next, the thermal detection goggles. He then confirmed that heat signatures would glow even through smoke or darkness... It was a direct counter not just to machines but also to humans that relied on stealth or cover.
With Angelo’s matter still happening, they had to be careful on this.
But soon, Kai’s focus locked on the portable disruptor field unit.
It was a rectangular device, no larger than a toolbox, with antenna‐like rods folded neatly against its sides.
He also noticed the control panel at the top with three distinct settings.
Kai activated his Fast Appraisal.
[ You have discovered Portable Disruptor Field Unit! ]
[ Grade: Superior Equipment ]
[ Description: A deployable device that generates a localized disruption field. It interferes with drone sensors, communication signals, and targeting systems within a fixed radius.
Effective against machine vision, infrared, and wireless coordination. ]
[ Note: Field radius expands with energy input. Prolonged use may drain portable batteries rapidly. ]
Kai felt really excited now...
This wasn’t just a jammer. Against the machines, it was basically a battlefield control. With this, drones wouldn’t just lose signal... they’d be blinded, confused, unable to coordinate.
"This is too OP... But I’ll take it..."
His gaze shifted briefly to the rest...
The flashbang grenades were also compact cylinders designed to overwhelm machines with bursts of light and sound... Well, it was, without a doubt, the glorified version of the stun grenade.

Anyway, the decoy emitter devices were small pods that projected false signals and noises to lure machines or even humans away... and finally, the sensor‐disrupting smoke grenades, which released a thick cloud infused with particles that scrambled their devices...
Kai couldn’t help but laugh in excitement.
"Hahaha... This... this changes everything."
Just like that, Kai then focused on the other Gift Packs to see what kind of improvement he had.
[ Energy Gift Pack (Superior)
Contents: portable fuel generator, foldable solar panel set, high-capacity battery pack, rechargeable batteries, and emergency radio.]
[ Entertainment Gift Pack (Superior)
Contents: media tablet with stored library, random musical instrument, group board game set, music player with speakers, creative kit, and offline knowledge archive. ]
[ Food Gift Pack (Superior)
Contents: dehydrated meal packs, protein concentrate packs, hydroponic starter kit, fruit juice packs, portable cooking stove with extra fuel,]
[ Medical Gift Pack (Superior)
Contents: advanced surgical kit, trauma kit, portable diagnostic scanner, IV kit, emergency defibrillator unit, and medical reference guide.]
[ Shelter Gift Pack (Superior)
Contents: modular survival pod, weatherproof clothing set, perimeter alarm system set, portable air filtration device, calming incense set, and sleeping bag. ]
[ Survival Tools Gift Pack (Superior)
Contents: multi-tool kit, digging tool, fire starter kit, portable fishing kit, navigation kit, portable drone scout, communication radio set, emergency repair kit, and survival clothing set. ]
Kai’s curiosity pushed him to open the next Gift Pack.
"Interesting items... This is just too awesome."
Just like that, Kai decided to check each of them!
The portable fuel generator appeared first.
It was compact but looked sturdy...
A small control panel displayed fuel levels and output capacity.

Kai crouched down, inspecting the exhaust vent and the refill slot. It wasn’t the kind of generator that powered an entire city, but for a shelter like Haven‐45, it was more than enough. He activated his Fast Appraisal.
[ You have discovered Portable Fuel Generator! ]
[ Grade: Superior Equipment ]

[ Description: A compact generator designed for field use. Provides steady electrical output for shelters, tools, and defensive devices. Runs on standard fuel and can be maintained with basic repair kits. ]
[ Note: Output capacity sufficient to power multiple devices simultaneously. Fuel efficiency improved compared to standard models. ]
Kai nodded in satisfaction. "This... this is exactly what we need."
Next, he examined the solar panel set.

Unlike the foldable chargers from the Enhanced packs, this was a complete system. The panels were larger and came with bundled wiring, a power station hub, and a battery rack. Everything was modular, designed to be assembled quickly.
Kai smiled faintly. "A full kit... not just scraps. This is nice..."
He then moved on to the Entertainment Gift Pack.
At first, he wasn’t expecting much. But when the items materialized, he blinked in surprise.
A musical instrument sat among the supplies. It was randomized, apparently.
This time, he got a pair of cymbals.
Kai laughed... "Cymbals? Really?" He tapped them together lightly, and it was all just a noise for him.
Curious, he opened another Entertainment Gift Pack. This time, a harmonica appeared. Kai chuckled. "Better. At least someone can play this."
He appraised the harmonica.
[ You have discovered Harmonica! ]
[ Grade: Common Equipment ]
[ Description: A portable wind instrument. Can be used for recreation, morale, or signaling. Durable casing ensures long‐term use in harsh environments. ]
Kai shook his head, amused but also impressed. "So it’s random... keeps things interesting."
Finally, he turned to the Food Gift Pack. The pack was filled with dehydrated meal packs, neatly sealed and lightweight.

Unlike canned goods, these meals were compact and easy to store, requiring only hot water to prepare. Alongside them were protein concentrate packs, small sachets designed to deliver nutrition quickly.
A hydroponic starter kit appeared next... There were trays, nutrient solution, and seeds ready for cultivation.
That alone made Kai pause.
"Alright... They all sound cool, but wait... what the heck happened with the Water Gift Pack?!"
Kai was shocked as he saw its content!

This time, he got a pair of cymbals.
Kai laughed...
"Cymbals?
Really?" He tapped them together lightly, and it was all just a noise for him.
Curious, he opened another Entertainment Gift Pack.
This time, a harmonica appeared.
Kai chuckled.
"Better.
At least someone can play this."
He appraised the harmonica.
[ You have discovered Harmonica! ]
[ Grade: Common Equipment ]
[ Description: A portable wind instrument.
Can be used for recreation, morale, or signaling.
Durable casing ensures long‐term use in harsh environments. ]
Kai shook his head, amused but also impressed.
"So it’s random... keeps things interesting."
Finally, he turned to the Food Gift Pack.
The pack was filled with dehydrated meal packs, neatly sealed and lightweight.
Unlike canned goods, these meals were compact and easy to store, requiring only hot water to prepare.
Alongside them were protein concentrate packs, small sachets designed to deliver nutrition quickly.
A hydroponic starter kit appeared next...
There were trays, nutrient solution, and seeds ready for cultivation.
That alone made Kai pause.
"Alright...
They all sound cool, but wait... what the heck happened with the Water Gift Pack?!"
Kai was shocked as he saw its content!

chapters.title: Chapter 188: The Impressive Water Gift Pack
paragraphs: Kai looked at the contents, and he couldn’t help but notice that it was on a different level now. The other Gift Packs had certainly improved by a tier... However, the Water Gift Pack was on a different scale.
[ Water Gift Pack (Superior)
Contents: atmospheric water generator, portable desalination unit, fire extinguisher, gene stimulant injector, spirit‐boosting potion flask, and stainless steel tumbler. ]
Kai then quickly selected the Water Gift Pack, and as soon as he found it in inventory, he activated it.
One by one, the items materialized before him, each resting neatly on the floor.
First, the atmospheric water generator.
It was a small, rectangular device with a vented intake system and a digital panel on the front. Kai crouched down as he inspected the cool metal surface.
He then activated his Fast Appraisal.
[ You have discovered the Atmospheric Water Generator! ]
[ Grade: Unique Equipment ]
[ Description: A portable device capable of extracting moisture directly from the air. Produces clean, drinkable water even in arid environments. Output increases in humid conditions. ]
[ Note: Requires steady power input. ]
Kai’s eyes widened. "This is something... I guess this means we’ll never run dry again."
Being able to obtain water from the air was just too incredible. This gift pack truly deserved to be a Superior Version!
Next, his attention shifted to the portable desalination unit.
It was compact, with a metal casing and a detachable hose system.
Then, there was a small pump and filtration chamber that were visible through its transparent panel.
Fast Appraisal activated.
[ You have discovered Portable Desalination Unit! ]
[ Grade: Unique Equipment ]
[ Description: A compact device designed to convert seawater into a drinkable supply. Includes pump, filtration chamber, and mineral balance system. ]
[ Note: Can process multiple liters per cycle. ]
Kai smiled as he already had an idea just by seeing its name.
Confirming it just made him happier.
"So even the ocean becomes a resource now..."
Unfortunately, they weren’t close to the shoreline. They had to head south if they ever wanted to make full use of it...

Then came the fire extinguisher. Unlike the standard ones he had seen before in school and office buildings. It had a dual‐nozzle system. One setting released a high‐pressure foam stream, while the other dispersed a fine mist designed to smother electrical fires.
In any case, he was already satisfied with it even without using his Fast Appraisal.
Well, it costs Spirit Points to activate his appraisal after all.
Still, his attention turned to the gene stimulant injector.
He had heard of it before from Alfie and Farrah. They even had access to it back in their previous shelter.
However, it was something only the Shelter Leader possessed at that time...
In any case, Kai held it in his hands.
It was a slim, metallic injector with a transparent vial chamber. Inside, a faintly glowing liquid pulsed.
It was quite scary thinking about how this liquid would enter their bodies.
"Let’s see how you work..."
Just like that, he triggered the Fast Appraisal.
[ You have discovered Gene Stimulant Injector! ]
[ Grade: Unique Equipment ]
[ Description: A specialized injector containing a biochemical stimulant. Temporarily enhances cellular recovery, stamina, and reflex response. Effects last for at least 10 minutes. ]
[ Note: Overuse may cause strain on the body. ]
Because of the side effects, it was only recommended for emergency combat or survival situations.
Still, it was an incredible addition to their arsenal.
Having Gene Stimulants during a siege or any combat against a large wave of android soldiers would give them an edge!
"This is just too amazing... Now I can have as many of them as I want."
There was no need to explain how useful it could be for the next global event.

There was no doubt that they’ll be able to survive this event with just this alone! Perhaps, if they have 10 or so of these, they’d be unstoppable. The only concern would be the duration and the strain that would follow.
’This Water Gift Pack is just too good...’
Finally, his eyes fell on the spirit‐boosting potion flask.
It was a small, glass container with a sealed cap.
The liquid inside was something Kai would want to put in a large jug or container.
After all, just from its name, it must have the effect of increasing their Spirit Points... Everyone basically needed this thing, especially if there were no negative side effects.
In any case, he also used his Appraisal.
[ You have discovered Spirit‐Boosting Potion Flask! ]
[ Grade: Unique Consumable ]
[ Description: A prepared tonic designed to restore mental clarity, focus, and Spirit Energy. Provides temporary resistance against fatigue and despair. ]
[ Note: The effect weakens if consumed repeatedly in a brief period. ]
Kai gently nodded as he saw this.
"Alright... This is nice..."
He looked at the collection before him.
The generator, desalination unit, extinguisher, oxygen tanks, injector, potion flask, and others.
"Well... How should I tell them about this?" Kai muttered to himself as he considered how much he’d be selling this... Or perhaps, how he would set up the Medal trade with these items.
Nonetheless, for now, he planned to be a bit more generous. The trade for a single Survivor Medal would probably include at least 3 Gift Packs of their Selection for now.

In any case, he wanted to keep the New Haven-45 strong, not just because he had befriended the people here, but because of the drained Sentinels that could be used as spare parts for Atom and perhaps become their future soldiers.
As he planned to check the last gift pack, he soon noticed the hydroponic kit that he hadn’t appraised yet... It was quite large, and it was already blocking his space...
Before opening the last pack, he might as well clear the items around.
After cleaning up, he then appraised the kit...
[ You have discovered the Hydroponic Starter Kit! ]
[ Grade: Unique Equipment ]
[ Description: A compact cultivation system designed for indoor farming. Includes trays, nutrient solution, and seed packs. Enables sustainable food production without soil. ]
[ Note: Requires water and a light source to maintain growth. ]
With generators, solar hubs, and hydroponics, Haven‐45 could sustain itself with these things...
"Perfect... I don’t have to worry about constantly taking out Food Packs anymore."

chapters.title: Chapter 189: The Last Pack and the Intruders
paragraphs: Kai then recalled something as he turned his attention to the Transport Gift Pack.
To be honest, he wasn’t really concerned about this since there wasn’t really a decent road they could use.
He also had an armored car now, so getting a better bike, maybe an e-bike or something, wasn’t really something he’d be excited about.
However, now that the Water Gift Pack showed him something awesome, he immediately checked the pack for its contents.
In the end, mobility was still something that he must take note of.
[ Transport Gift Pack (Superior)
Contents: off‐road motorbike, fuel reserve containers, protective riding gear, repair kit with spare parts, collapsible canoe, emergency thruster pack, and compact grappling launcher. ]
"Mhmm? This is quite impressive." Kai commented after seeing the upgrade from the mountain bike to an off-road motorbike...
Furthermore, the thruster pack and the grappling launcher seemed really unique...
Kai immediately selected the pack.
The system confirmed his choice, and in an instant, the items entered his inventory.
He activated it without hesitation.
Soon, the items appeared in front of him. One by one, the items materialized before him.
The first thing that caught his eye was the off‐road motorbike because of its size... It was quite easy to notice at first.
It was slim with tires that were clearly built for rough terrain.
Nonetheless, the engine casing was armored, and the seat was designed for long rides. Kai smiled as he touched. Though he wasn’t really a biker, he knew how to drive them.
Soon, his Fast Appraisal was activated.
[ You have discovered Off‐Road Motorbike! ]
[ Grade: Unique Equipment ]
[ Description: A durable motorbike designed for rough terrain. It is equipped with special tires, shock‐absorbing suspension, and an armored engine casing.
Capable of high speed and maneuverability across uneven ground. ]
[ Note: Requires gasoline. ]
Kai gently nodded as he saw it.
The item wasn’t crazy, but he appreciated having it.
Next, he noticed the fuel reserve containers stacked neatly beside the bike. Each was compact, sealed, and clearly designed for safe transport.
Then came the protective riding gear.
It was a full set!
It had a helmet, jacket, gloves, pants, and boots...
It wasn’t flashy, but it was clearly built for survival.
"Mhmmm... This set looked nice."
The helmet had a tinted visor, designed to withstand impact and shield his eyes from dust and glare.

The jacket was also durable, and it provided protection without restricting movement like the pants... Meanwhile, the gloves were padded at the knuckles, with a grip texture that would keep his hands steady even in rain or mud.
Finally, the boots seemed better than the Tier 2 boots he was wearing right now!
Kai smirked. "Now this is style and survival combined."
Beside it was the repair kit with spare parts. Tools, replacement chains, bolts, and even a compact welding unit. Everything was neatly packed into a reinforced case.
Kai chuckled. "They really thought of everything. No more abandoning vehicles just because of a broken chain."
Next, his eyes fell on the collapsible canoe. At first glance, it looked like a folded bundle, but as he touched it, the frame extended, revealing a lightweight yet sturdy watercraft.
Fast Appraisal activated.
[ Description: A portable canoe designed for rapid deployment...
Kai’s grin widened. "Still quite similar to the Enhanced Version. The difference was just the size, as it seemed.
Then came something unusual... the emergency thruster pack. It was small, compact, with a single nozzle and fuel chamber. Clearly a one‐use item.
Fast Appraisal activated.
[ You have discovered Emergency Thruster Pack! ]
[ Grade: Unique Consumable ]
[ Description: A single‐use propulsion device designed to provide rapid movement in emergencies. Capable of launching the user several meters forward or upward. ]
[ Note: Limited to one use.. ]
Kai laughed. "A one‐shot escape tool... but in the right moment, this could save a life."

Finally, his eyes locked on the compact grappling launcher. It was something that could fit in his backpack... It was also handheld, with a barrel and a coiled cable inside. The grip was molded for precision, and a small targeting sight sat on top.
Fast Appraisal activated.
[ You have discovered Compact Grappling Launcher! ]
[ Grade: Unique Equipment ]
[ Description: A handheld launcher designed to fire a special grappling hook attached to a high‐tensile cable. ]
[ Note: Cable is retractable and reusable. Effective range up to 30 meters. ]
Kai’s eyes lit up. "Now this... this is freedom."
He imagined scaling ruined skyscrapers, crossing gaps, or pulling himself out of danger in seconds. The grappling launcher was definitely something he could rely on.
Kai stood, surveying the collection before him... motorbike, fuel reserves, riding gear, repair kit, canoe, thruster pack, grappling launcher. His chest tightened with excitement.
"This is amazing..." He just couldn’t believe it...
He even imagined himself like a spider moving from building to building with the grappler!
Kai then shook his head as he reached this thought.
For now, he started filling the vault with new items from all Gift Packs.
He had to ensure that they would have enough for several days or until the end of the Global Event...
After all, he needed to ensure that this shelter would remain safe with his Clan Members...
Meanwhile, as Kai was busy prepping the newly acquired items and organizing them into the vault, Dylan and Gabby burst through the gates of the shelter...
Their faces were pale and drenched in sweat.
They had clearly been running hard.
Wallace, who was stationed at the wall as a guard, immediately raised his voice.
"What happened?"
Dylan bent over, catching his breath, while Gabby pressed her hand against the steel frame of the door. There was panic and some hint of excitement written all over his expression.
This made Wallace confused.
"It’s a herd..." Dylan finally managed to say.
Wallace frowned. "A herd? Of what?"
Gabby swallowed hard and answered.
"Bulls. A whole herd of them!"
Wallace’s eyes widened in disbelief. "What? Bulls?! Wait... That’s not bad news, is it?"
Gabby steadied her breathing and said, "There must be at least fifty... maybe more. If they reached the perimeter, they’ll trigger all the traps we’ve placed so far..."

chapters.title: Chapter 191: Effects
paragraphs: Gabby’s voice trembled as he pointed at the horn.
"It’s gold... this one’s horn is different!"
The defenders gathered quickly... Their curiosity overcame their disgust of these bulls.
Wallace looked skeptical after hearing this, but he was intrigued. "Gold horn or not, check the flesh. If it’s the same blue‐streaked rot, we’re burning it."
Dylan crouched beside Gabby, cutting into the carcass.
His knife slid through muscle that was pure red... It was a good sign!
They continued to check it, and as expected, it was unmarred by the corruption they had seen in the others. He looked up, stunned.
"It’s clean. No blue veins. No foul smell."
As soon as they heard this, everyone felt excited as they all felt hopeful about this. Wallace turned sharply toward Kai. "Kai. Appraise it. We need to know for sure."
Kai stepped forward, crouching beside the golden‐horned bull.
"Let me see..."
His hand pressed against the hide, and his Fast Appraisal activated.
[ You have discovered Golden‐Horned Bull Carcass! ]
[ Grade: Rare Resource ]

[ Description: A resilient creature. Flesh is pure and safe for consumption, rich in nutrients. Hide is durable, suitable for crafting protective gear and the horns contain condensed spiritual energy. ]
[ Note: Meat provides high nutritional value. Horns may be harvested for spiritual enhancement or crafting. ]
Kai’s eyes widened as he shared the information with others...
"It’s edible. Safe. And the horn... It’s packed with spiritual energy."
The defenders gasped as they heard this...
Dylan laughed nervously. "Finally... real meat!"
Gabby grinned as well. Her earlier fear was replaced with excitement.
"And that horn... we could trade it, or use it for crafting... Can we repurpose it into a cup or something?"
"A cup? Is that the best you can think of?" Wallace laughed at her suggestion, but in the end, he was also unsure what they could do with the horn that had high spirit energy in it.
Kai, on the other hand, immediately gave his command.
"We’ll dismantle it carefully. Nothing goes to waste."
The group nodded eagerly.
Soon, the carcass was set aside, and the defenders worked together to dismantle it.
The hide was stripped clean. It was thick and durable, perfect for armor or protective coverings. The golden horns were removed with care and their purpose was still unknown for now.
Kai held one of the horns, feeling the energy pulsing within. "It’s more than just decoration. Give this thing to Marissa. She’ll know what to do with this."
Meanwhile, Mila, the cook and head of sanitation, stepped forward as she saw the meat being stored...
"Leave the meat to me. I’ll make sure it’s prepared properly."
She then inspected the cuts of flesh and nodded in satisfaction.
"This is clean. I’ll boil it first, then we’ll add it to the soup. With the herbs and vegetables from our garden, we can make something special."

The survivors cheered faintly, as they were already excited to taste it. Of course, all of them knew that bull meat was tough. Because of that, it was suited perfectly for strewing, braising, or even grinding...
For the first time, they would taste real meat!
Mila wasted no time.
She carried the cuts to the kitchen, where pots of water were already boiling.
She added the meat, letting it simmer...

Soon, the rich aroma filled the shelter. Then, she tossed in herbs, spices, and fresh vegetables from their garden... With the onions, garlic, leafy greens, and peppers added, the scent became intoxicating.
Survivors gathered near the kitchen with their mouths watering. Everyone, including those busy with their work, Victor, Marissa, Elena, and others, came to check what was going on.
Even Kai felt his stomach tighten with anticipation.
Needless to say, Mila could tell that everyone was looking forward to this meal..
"Instant noodles with real broth. Meat soup with fresh herbs. Tonight, we eat like humans again."
When the food was finally served after a few hours, the defenders savored every bite.
The broth was rich, the meat was tender, and it was blending perfectly with the noodles and vegetables. For a moment, the fear of the upcoming event faded away.
Wallace raised his tomato-flavored drink... "This... this is what we needed."
Gabby grinned between mouthfuls. "Best meal I’ve had since that egg we stole before..."
Dylan laughed. "Worth the risk of being chased by bulls."
Meanwhile, Kai ate quietly as well.
The golden‐horned bull wasn’t just food. It was proof that rare, uncorrupted creatures still existed.
In the end, survival wasn’t only about fighting machines... it was about finding these rare resources and using them wisely.
He set his bowl down as he finished his meal.
"We’ll need to hunt for more. If one bull was spared, there could be others. And if their horns carry spiritual energy... Haven‐45 might gain more than just food."
Wallace nodded. "Agreed. Tonight, let’s just celebrate!"
However, it was at this point that Kai heard a chime and echoed in his mind!
To be exact, it wasn’t just him!
The familiar tone of a system notification was heard by the other Foreign Survivors as well!
[ You have consumed Golden‐Horned Bull Meat Soup! ]
[ Effect: Spirit Recovery +20%, Physical Stamina +25%, Mental Clarity Boost ]
[ Duration: 24 hours ]
This result made them freeze. They were staring at one another in disbelief.
Victor laughed nervously. "We... we got a buff? From eating meat?"
Marissa’s eyes widened. "So it’s not just food. It’s power."
Kai set his bowl down slowly as he realized how precious the meat was!
This changed everything.
Just like what he guessed before, the A.I. Apocalypse wasn’t only about machines and gift packs. Even mutated creatures could become resources.
His understanding of this A.I. Rebellion had truly flipped. There was far more to learn than he had ever imagined.
But the surprise didn’t end there...
A day later, Marissa was busy examining the golden horn, trying to figure out how to refine its spiritual energy.
Suddenly, she rushed out, her face was pale, and soon, she found Kai.
"Kai... Are you returning to Freedom Shelter? I think Terrence is getting closer," she whispered urgently. "Careful..."
Kai stiffened as he heard the name of that person once again...

sentences.text: Gabby’s voice trembled as he pointed at the horn.
"It’s gold... this one’s horn is different!"
The defenders gathered quickly...
Their curiosity overcame their disgust of these bulls.
Wallace looked skeptical after hearing this, but he was intrigued.
"Gold horn or not, check the flesh.
If it’s the same blue‐streaked rot, we’re burning it."
Dylan crouched beside Gabby, cutting into the carcass.
His knife slid through muscle that was pure red...
It was a good sign!
They continued to check it, and as expected, it was unmarred by the corruption they had seen in the others.
He looked up, stunned.
"It’s clean.
No blue veins.
No foul smell."
As soon as they heard this, everyone felt excited as they all felt hopeful about this.
Wallace turned sharply toward Kai.
"Kai.
Appraise it.
We need to know for sure."
Kai stepped forward, crouching beside the golden‐horned bull.
"Let me see..."
His hand pressed against the hide, and his Fast Appraisal activated.
[ You have discovered Golden‐Horned Bull Carcass! ]
[ Grade: Rare Resource ]
[ Description: A resilient creature.
Flesh is pure and safe for consumption, rich in nutrients.
Hide is durable, suitable for crafting protective gear and the horns contain condensed spiritual energy. ]
[ Note: Meat provides high nutritional value.
Horns may be harvested for spiritual enhancement or crafting. ]
Kai’s eyes widened as he shared the information with others...
"It’s edible.
Safe.
And the horn...
It’s packed with spiritual energy."
The defenders gasped as they heard this...
Dylan laughed nervously.
"Finally... real meat!"
Gabby grinned as well.
Her earlier fear was replaced with excitement.
"And that horn... we could trade it, or use it for crafting...
Can we repurpose it into a cup or something?"
"A cup?
Is that the best you can think of?" Wallace laughed at her suggestion, but in the end, he was also unsure what they could do with the horn that had high spirit energy in it.
Kai, on the other hand, immediately gave his command.
"We’ll dismantle it carefully.
Nothing goes to waste."
The group nodded eagerly.
Soon, the carcass was set aside, and the defenders worked together to dismantle it.
The hide was stripped clean.
It was thick and durable, perfect for armor or protective coverings.
The golden horns were removed with care and their purpose was still unknown for now.
Kai held one of the horns, feeling the energy pulsing within.
"It’s more than just decoration.
Give this thing to Marissa.
She’ll know what to do with this."
Meanwhile, Mila, the cook and head of sanitation, stepped forward as she saw the meat being stored...
"Leave the meat to me.
I’ll make sure it’s prepared properly."
She then inspected the cuts of flesh and nodded in satisfaction.
"This is clean.
I’ll boil it first, then we’ll add it to the soup.
With the herbs and vegetables from our garden, we can make something special."
The survivors cheered faintly, as they were already excited to taste it.
Of course, all of them knew that bull meat was tough.
Because of that, it was suited perfectly for strewing, braising, or even grinding...
For the first time, they would taste real meat!
Mila wasted no time.
She carried the cuts to the kitchen, where pots of water were already boiling.
She added the meat, letting it simmer...
Soon, the rich aroma filled the shelter.
Then, she tossed in herbs, spices, and fresh vegetables from their garden...
With the onions, garlic, leafy greens, and peppers added, the scent became intoxicating.
Survivors gathered near the kitchen with their mouths watering.
Everyone, including those busy with their work, Victor, Marissa, Elena, and others, came to check what was going on.
Even Kai felt his stomach tighten with anticipation.
Needless to say, Mila could tell that everyone was looking forward to this meal..
"Instant noodles with real broth.
Meat soup with fresh herbs.
Tonight, we eat like humans again."
When the food was finally served after a few hours, the defenders savored every bite.
The broth was rich, the meat was tender, and it was blending perfectly with the noodles and vegetables.
For a moment, the fear of the upcoming event faded away.
Wallace raised his tomato-flavored drink...
"This... this is what we needed."
Gabby grinned between mouthfuls.
"Best meal I’ve had since that egg we stole before..."
Dylan laughed.
"Worth the risk of being chased by bulls."

The golden‐horned bull wasn’t just food.

In the end, survival wasn’t only about fighting machines... it was about finding these rare resources and using them wisely.

If one bull was spared, there could be others.
And if their horns carry spiritual energy...
Haven‐45 might gain more than just food."
Wallace nodded.
"Agreed.
Tonight, let’s just celebrate!"

To be exact, it wasn’t just him!

[ Effect: Spirit Recovery +20%, Physical Stamina +25%, Mental Clarity Boost ]
[ Duration: 24 hours ]

From eating meat?"

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Selection and the Mysterious Figure
paragraphs: Marissa’s Talent was Witch Doctor, and she had obtained Gene Skills related to a particular darker side of alchemy, and also, she had a skill called Tracker.
Some time ago, they had decided to place a Tracker on Terrence after he tried to use his Hypnotic Suggestion Skill on Claire.
It didn’t cause any harm, and he may even be just playing a prank since he had basically failed in the process. No one could really know.
However, they could not take that risk...
Since killing him immediately would be a bit too brutal, considering how he had saved Aurora and Jonas, they had banished him instead when he was still Level 12...
"He’s back?" Kai asked after recalling the man.
"Yes... Or not? I don’t think so... He probably just passed by. My Tracker could sense at least about 300 meters with its current level. I think he just left..." Marissa explained.

"Or maybe he’s scouting? Since there’s an upcoming event, he probably wanted a safer location, or maybe he wanted to see if we’ll fall or something." Kai muttered as he was really unworried about Terrence’s presence.
Even if he bore a grudge and wanted to exact vengeance, his Superior Gift Pack would be helping everyone increase their combat abilities soon.
Right now, he planned to open the warehouse for everyone and use their collected Energy Cores and Survivor Medals in exchange for the new items he had taken out from the Gift Packs...
"Alright. Forget about him... Marissa, how about you check the Vault now?" Kai said with a smile.
"Y-yes! But I only have 2 Survivor Medals left. I’m thinking of saving more of them to buy an Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum once the Gene Traders are back." Marissa explained.

Kai shook his head. "No need to make payment. Just study the golden horn and find out how to use that thing. As long as you’re contributing to the development and safety of the shelter, you ought to get paid... For now, you can get five things for free in the shelter. If you give me some good news about the horns we collected, then I’ll reward you even more."
"If that’s the case, then let’s do it!"
Kai motioned for Marissa to follow him.
Along the way, they also met Mila and Irene so Kai invited them.
The three women quickly joined him as they were curious about the new things that Kai had provided to the vault...

As they reached the vault, they found Althea seated at her desk beside the heavy steel door. She was twirling her dagger, her Gene Weapon, between her fingers... She seemed quite bored guarding this vault.
Hearing the footsteps, Althea looked up and nodded.
"Kai. You’re here to open the vault again?"
Kai nodded. "Yes. I want them to take five things each..."
Needless to say, the three of them weren’t the first people to be invited here.
The wall defenders, the scouts, and the trap makers had also received the items of their choice...

As Kai had expected, aside from the Carbine Rifle, most of them selected the Emergency Thruster Pack, followed by the Grappler Launcher, which they could easily equip and allow them to climb atop the walls and roofs a lot more easily.
"Alright... You can take your time."
Althea said as she unlocked the reinforced door.
The vault opened with a low groan, revealing shelves stacked with crates, weapons, gear, and supplies.
The sight alone was enough to make Mila, Marissa, and Irene pause in awe.
Kai stepped inside, gesturing toward the rows of items.
"You already know the basics... food packs, medical kits, survival tools, and others... But I’ve added more. Superior items from the Gift Packs. They’re here. You can check them out."
Kai didn’t even have to explain the new items to them, as they had their own methods of assessing these items.
Soon, the three women exchanged glances, overwhelmed by the sheer variety.
There were just too many new things in front of them!
After some time, Mila’s eyes locked onto the weatherproof clothing set from the Shelter Gift Pack...
She stepped closer, running her fingers over the fabric.
"This... this is perfect. Cooking outside, cleaning, even tending the garden... This will help a lot." As she said this, she started looking at the shelf containing the Survival Tools Gift Pack.
Marissa, however, was drawn to the carbine rifle with spare magazines. She picked it up carefully, testing its weight.
"This one looked easier to handle than the ones we’ve found from the Sentinels." She muttered.
Well, she always relied on her Gene Skills, but this item gives her range. It was certainly a decent weapon to protect herself.
Irene, the nurse, moved toward the shelves stacked with medical gear.
"Right... I’ll supply you with Medical Gift Packs since that’s for everyone’s sake. Just look for other items." Kai reminded.
Just like that, the three of them selected five items, and as expected, they all got at least one weapon.

Furthermore, Kai recommended the gene stimulant injector and spirit‐boosting potion flask... They all realized how valuable it was, and Marissa even used three of her chances to get three spirit‐boosting potion flasks!
"With these potions and stimulants, I think that the next Global Event will be a lot easier," Marissa muttered.
Kai chuckled. This was something that he had planned to happen. He needed to ensure that they stay on top.
Furthermore, he wanted many more Survivors he trusts to reach a high level.
That way, he’d be more at ease leaving this place.
After all, he still planned to visit the Human City he had seen on the map.
Just like that, Kai took a few more people to enter the vault.
Of course, he only allowed three to five people to select at the same time, careful not to let the place get crowded.
Then, each group left with their chosen items...
Once the last group exited, Kai finally decided it was time to leave Haven‐45 and return to Freedom Shelter.
After saying goodbye, he mounted the off‐road motorbike and sped across the rough terrain.
A few hundred meters out, Kai slowed as he noticed someone watching him...
On a hill overlooking the path, a lone figure stood...
At first, he thought it was Terrence... But as Kai focused, his eyes widened.
The man actually had four arms!

chapters.title: Chapter 193: The Picture and the Secret Conversations
paragraphs: Kai was shocked at the sight. Soon, his motorbike slowed to a halt as he wanted to understand what he was seeing.
"What? What is that thing?" he muttered.
At first glance, he thought it was Terrence... However, seeing that it had four arms, it might be another mechanical soldier, maybe a variant of Sentinel or the Spyders.
But as hisKeen Senseskill sharpened, the truth became clear.
The aura wasn’t anything artificial... Instead, it was human.
Kai gripped the handlebars, debating whether to drive straight toward the man.
But before he could decide, the figure suddenly retreated, vanishing from his senses as if swallowed by the landscape.
"Huh?" Kai frowned as he realized that the man had incredibly stealth abilities, probably similar to what Mei had.
"He disappeared so quickly. This feels dangerous."
It was strange, unsettling even. Without wasting time, he pulled out his radio and informed Haven‐45.
"Be careful when going outside to collect resources. I spotted a man with four arms nearby."
With that warning delivered, Kai revved the motorbike and continued his journey.
Since he didn’t know the enemy, there was no need to waste time worrying about it. In any case, he knew that they were also unaware of the strength of his shelter.
At this point, with almost everyone equipped with a rifle, with some of them even having clearance to use the remaining Plasma Rifles, Kai wouldn’t have to worry about their safety.
Reminding them of the dangers was already more than enough, since Claire was a Rank 2 Survivor for a reason.
Hours later, the walls of Freedom Shelter came into view.
He felt relieved seeing the unharmed shelter as his senses confirmed the farmers were still tending Aurora’s modified crops.
They weren’t ready for harvest yet, but soon they would be.
Just as Kai approached the gate, Noli, one of the freed slaves he had rescued, rushed forward. He seemed quite excited.
"Sir Kai! You’re finally back. I think I found another shelter nearby!" he exclaimed while waving a digi‐cam in his hands.
Kai recognized it instantly. It was Aurora’s digi‐cam, bought from the Gene Trader’s miscellaneous items. He smiled, intrigued at the sudden report.
Then, he immediately recalled something.
"Wait... Is it foggy or near the swamp?" Kai asked.
Needless to say, he was hoping that Noli had found Angelo’s shelter! He could still remember the threat that he had left behind.
If not for the Global Event, he would’ve dealt with the man.
Noli nodded eagerly. "I think so... there’s a large mist, and also a swamp..."
"That’s great. Let me check the pictures later..." Kai said as he planned to visit the vault first. He needed to provide them with better supplies that they could use against the A.I. Soldiers.
Kai then entered the shelter with Noli, who also left immediately, saying he was so sleepy.
As for Kai, he immediately felt relaxed. The tension from the road had already faded...
Just ahead, Mei was lounging under the sun...
At this time, her eyes were fixed on something invisible in the air, and from time to time, a soft laugh escaped her lips.
It sounded light and carefree... like music in his ears.
However, Kai felt a little helpless.
’This...’
He expected to be greeted warmly as soon as he arrived.
Though he wasn’t expecting a hug from her, he was at least hopeful to hear her welcome his safe return.
For a moment, Kai tilted his head, curious at what she was doing. As he approached, he realized she wasn’t laughing at anything physical...
Right, she was interacting with the system!
"Are you on chat?" Kai asked.
Mei flinched, startled at the sudden familiar voice.
She hadn’t noticed him. "Y‐yes! Kai, you’re back. You should be making noise," she scolded lightly, though her smile betrayed her amusement.
Kai chuckled, shaking his head. "Noise? The gate was literally opened just now. Anyway, I thought you’d sense me before anyone else."
Mei grinned, tapping at the faint interface only she could see.
"I was distracted. I’m using the Guild Chat." Her tone carried excitement. "Ohhh... By the way, just a few more and we’ll complete the first Guild Mission!"

Kai chuckled. "Well... That’s all for you. My guild contribution will naturally increase, so tell everyone to deposit some precious items and complete their missions if they want to increase their contribution points. They’ll benefit a lot from it."
Mei nodded. "Yeah... We know. We’re now talking about something else. Don’t open the Guild Chat, okay?"
"Huh?" Kai was confused as he stopped his hands. He was just about to open the Guild Chat.
"Yes! Don’t open it," Mei said, using the best angry face she could make.
"Fine... fine. You probably heard about the new items I can take out. I’ll be filling up the vault, okay?" Kai said as he left the courtyard while shaking his head.
"Yes! That jetpack and that grappling hook... I want those, Kai!" Mei said as she already saw everyone in the Guild Chat talking about them.
Furthermore, the stimulants and potions were definitely something she’d like to have in her inventory.
"Got it... You can take them to the warehouse later." Kai replied with a wave of his hand before he left the courtyard.
For now, he had other priorities... and that was to use his Infinite Gift Pack Talent and provide supplies to everyone.
Meanwhile, Mei’s attention returned to the system interface hovering before her.
The Guild Chat was buzzing with activity, but this time the conversation wasn’t about missions or supplies.
Instead, the members were talking about Kai’s birthday.
Mei smiled as she saw everyone’s reaction.
Even in the middle of an apocalypse, she had not forgotten about it.
For some time, she scrolled through the messages, reading their ideas...
[ Victor: Let’s craft him a custom blade. ]
[ Claire: He deserves something symbolic, maybe a statue? I’m quite good with my hands. Should we try sculpting his face on a block of wood first? ]
[ Mei: What about a feast? I heard Mila can cook something special if we have decent meat we could use. ]
As soon as Mei said this, everyone suddenly received a notification.
Apparently, they had just completed the guild’s first mission!

For some time, she scrolled through the messages, reading their ideas...
[ Victor: Let’s craft him a custom blade. ]
[ Claire: He deserves something symbolic, maybe a statue?
I’m quite good with my hands.
Should we try sculpting his face on a block of wood first? ]
[ Mei: What about a feast?
I heard Mila can cook something special if we have decent meat we could use. ]
As soon as Mei said this, everyone suddenly received a notification.
Apparently, they had just completed the guild’s first mission!

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Hard
paragraphs: The Supply Run Mission, where they had to submit 100 units of food to the Guild Storage, was soon completed.
The reward was 50 Reputation Points for the Guild and 5 C-Grade Energy Cores. This would allow the Level 5 people to break through their limit.
Aside from that, the people who had participated would receive Guild Contribution Points that they could use to retrieve certain items in the Storage.
This was the reason why Kai didn’t just fulfil the mission. He needed the others to accumulate their Contribution Points as well.

As for the Patrol Sweep, where they had to eliminate 10 Drones controlled by the A.I. Rebel, and the Survivor Integration, where they had to recruit a total of 15 Survivors from Earth, that could be completed later on.
At this time, there were only 12 Guild Members.
They were missing three more to complete one of the missions. Still, none of them was in a hurry.
After all, they had to start being careful when letting other people in, considering the prestige that they had now.
Since most of them were actually wi thin the Top 15 in the Survivor Leaderboard, they should focus more on recruiting Survivors with specialized Talents as much as possible.
In the meantime, while everyone else was exploring the Guild Feature, Kai had soon finished supplying the vault, ensuring every shelf was stocked with the new Superior items.
Then, just like what he had done in Haven‐45, he ordered Jonas and the others to take out one of the most critical pieces of equipment.
It was the Portable Disruptor Field Unit that could generate a localized disruption field and interfere with drone sensors, communication signals, and targeting systems within a fixed radius.
It would be useful for the next event.
Kai personally taught them how to use the device, explaining its settings and limitations.
Soon, the Freedom Shelter was surrounded by twenty of these units, forming a protective barrier against any incoming drones or mechanical scouts.
Indeed, Kai decided to take out 20 of them...

Then, after securing the perimeter, Kai moved on to distributing the stimulants and potions. He introduced the Gene Stimulant Injector, a specialized tool designed to temporarily enhance cellular recovery, stamina, and reflexes.
The effect was short‐lived, lasting only minutes, but in combat it could mean the difference between survival and defeat.
"Haha! You want to drug us now, Kai?" Mei teased as she saw it.
"Hey... You all got Gene Enhancement Serums, ok? You’re all drugged already." Kai shot back as he handed over their supplies.
"Now that you said it like that..." Aurora paused as she couldn’t help but feel that it sounded a little wrong.
"Don’t mind him..." Mei said as she patted her shoulder.
Next was the Spirit‐Boosting Potion Flask, a tonic that restored mental clarity and Spirit Energy, giving resistance against fatigue and despair.
Kai reminded them that repeated use in a short span would weaken its effect, but even a single dose could keep a fighter sharp during long battles.
Just like that, everyone received their free items, though Jonas wasn’t satisfied with just the freebies.
He approached Kai and requested an exchange, offering one of his Survivor Medals.

In return, he asked for a carbine rifle, another Emergency Thruster Pack, a Grappling Launcher, two sets of survival clothing, and, surprisingly, the Modular Survivor Pod that still needed to be assemble.
"Are you planning to camp outside or something?" Kai asked, but Jonas just laughed. He actually wanted to try building it first and then, store it in his System Inventory.
"Wouldn’t it be amazing if it works?" Jonas said with a smile.
Kai was stunned at this, as he didn’t consider this until now.
"T-that... I want to know too!"
"Haha! I’ll let you know if it worked." Jonas replied.
Kai completed the transaction without hesitation, pleased to see his collection of Survivor Medals grow even larger.
Then, by the time the last exchanges were completed, night had already fallen.
The survivors returned to their quarters, each carrying their new equipment, while Kai remained alone in the courtyard...
"Mhmm... I should at least know how it feels." Kai muttered.
This time, he had something different in mind. He wanted to experiment.
Soon, he retrieved one of the stimulants, holding the injector firmly in his hand.
Of course, he also wanted to know how effective this really was. Although it said that it would increase his strength and other stats, he wouldn’t know the difference until he tried it.
Soon, he called for someone.
"Atom. Come here."
Moments later, his A‐Grade Sentinel appeared...
"Tonight, we’ll spar... W-wait! No, I’m not ready yet!" Kai immediately said, seeing that Atom was ready to fight.
Atom’s sensors then locked onto him before staying still, awaiting the command.
After taking a deep breath, Kai then pressed the injector into his arm. Soon, he felt the surge of energy flood his body.
"Wow..." Kai paused as he felt the changes in his body.
"I can’t believe this is included in the Water Gift Pack." Kai muttered as he informed Atom not to use any weapons...
"We fight barehanded."
The Sentinel’s sensors blinked, acknowledging the command.
Then, Atom shifted into a combat stance, as it prepared for close‐quarters engagement.
Kai exhaled slowly...
At this time, his body was brimming with the stimulant’s surge.
Even so, he knew the disadvantage... Atom was made of a special alloy, built for durability to the point that a Plasma Rifle wouldn’t immediately destroy its armor.
Still, Kai was confident.
With his boost in strength, his Gene Enhancements, Gene Skills, and his current stats as the highest‐level survivor, he believed he could hold his ground.
Soon, the first clash came fast.
Atom charged forward and swung its mechanical arm, aiming to hit his chest.
"So slow, Atom!"
Kai sidestepped as he felt his reflexes sharper than ever... Then, he countered with a heavy punch to its chest.
Bang!
The impact rang out... It was a metal against flesh, and Atom was barely pushed back.
Kai helplessly smiled. Though he didn’t use his full strength, he was hoping to at least dent its armor. However, none of it could be seen at all.
"Tch... harder than I thought."

chapters.title: Chapter 195: The Sparring
paragraphs: Kai shook out his hand, flexing his knuckles.
’No wonder the Plasma Rifle can be deflected by that body.’He mused.
The alloy was harder than stone, harder than bone. His Bronze Skin had absorbed most of the shock, but the dull ache reminded him that Atom wasn’t an opponent he could brute‐force through.
The A-Grade Sentinel’s sensors then glowed faintly. Its stance remained unshaken, but it had recorded Kai’s attack pattern just now.
In any case, since it was only a sparring, Atom wasn’t hurrying to defeat its opponent. It knew that the opponent wanted to try its skills and other abilities.
With that in consideration, it fought while giving a chance for its opponent to show off. However, it would also record its opponent’s combat ability.
Soon, it advanced again...
Kai also charged forward, relying on his agility. His footwork carried him around Atom’s strikes, his body moving in and out of range.
Thankfully, Kai still had a higher Agility Points than Atom.
He landed a series of punches, each one sharper than the last, but Atom absorbed them all, its alloy frame wasn’t even dented!
Kai grinned despite himself. "Alright... let’s turn this up."
Atom retaliated instantly, sweeping low to knock him off balance.
Kai leapt back and landed smoothly on the ground before charging forward again.
His fists struck against Atom’s frame, and each strike was faster and more forceful than before.
However, the Sentinel absorbed the blows, then drove its knee forward. Kai blocked with his forearm, and the shock rattled through his bones, but he endured it...
He then countered with a kick, forcing Atom to step back for the first time.
"Not bad," Kai muttered as he took a deep breath...
His muscles felt alive as he could still feel the stimulant in his body.
Atom advanced again, and this time, Kai used his speed once again and ducked under a strike, before slamming his elbow into its side!
Bam!
Kai then jumped back before Atom’s counter could land.
Just like that, the battle continued... The courtyard echoed with the sound of flesh and metal colliding. Furthermore, each exchange was getting faster than the last.
The two were slowly adjusting to their speed and attack patterns!
For several minutes, Kai relied only on his natural strength, agility, and passive skills.

Bronze Skinabsorbed the worst of the impacts, whileKeen Sensesharpened his instincts, allowing him to read Atom’s movements more clearly and pick up the faint shifts in Atom’s movements. Although he wasn’t able to predict its next attack, he was slowly getting used to Atom’s speed.
But Atom was not getting tired...
Its calculation speed was unmatched, adjusting instantly to Kai’s attack patterns.
He had to do some new moves or try to be faster to avoid being predicted...
Unfortunately, it didn’t take long before every punch Kai threw was met with a counter, every kick was anticipated, and Kai was no longer striking his opponent.
The Sentinel’s toughness and read on him made it nearly impossible to break through.
Kai exhaled sharply.
This was going nowhere. He had to change his gear now.
"Fine... let’s see how you handle this."
He finally shifted his stance. Finally, he decided to use his Active Gene Skills!
At this time, his reserves were vast... He currently had 350 Spirit Points thanks to the B‐Grade Cores he had absorbed. He could afford to unleash his skills many times!
"Spirit Pulse!"
[ Spirit Points: -70 ]
A burst of Spirit Energy erupted from his palm, slamming into Atom’s chest.
The shockwave reverberated through the courtyard, forcing the Sentinel back several steps. Atom didn’t expect that attack, and of course, it started recalculating his strength.
Kai smirked. "That got your attention, huh..."
Atom didn’t reply and just steadied itself before charging again.
This time, Atom decided to use its advantage. With its body that never gets tired, it didn’t stop attacking Kai, no matter what kind of punches or kicks it received!
Atom stood its ground!
Seeing this, Kai activatedSpecter Step.
[ Spirit Points: -20 ]
His body formed between two points. Soon, he reappeared behind Atom, delivering a crushing blow to its back.
Bang!
The Sentinel staggered, but it was only for a moment as its mechanical limbs swept in a wide arc, hoping to catch him.
However, Kai just ducked before rolling across the ground before springing up with anotherSpirit Pulse.
[ Spirit Points: -70 ]
Bam!
The blast hit Atom’s upper body. But it didn’t leave any faint scorch mark on the alloy at all.
Still, the fact that Atom was unable to dodge and could only attack him in brute force, Kai knew that he had really gotten stronger and faster...
’So... without weapons, I can actually hold my own against an A‐Grade Sentinel...’Kai thought.

Of course, with his Stimulant and Title calledStrongest Onethat amplified his attributes further, he had received a lot of buffs. However, it still showed that he was strong enough not to die against them.
Atom, however, was adapting.
Its calculation continued adjusting as it analyzed Kai’s attack patterns, and was even predicting the timing of hisSpecter Step.
Soon, when Kai used his movement Skill again, Atom’s arm was already waiting, intercepting him in his movement!
Bam!
The impact of the punch sent Kai skidding across the courtyard.
Kai wiped the blood from his lip and grinned.
"You’re learning... good."
Thankfully, his Bronze Skin made him really durable.
Kai didn’t want to end this with Atom getting the last solid hit, so he continued.
He continued attacking, relying on his speed and the stimulant’s effects!
However, his punches weren’t going through!
Atom blocked, countered, and retaliated!
It was keeping pace with Kai’s enhanced speed.
The battle escalated... The effect of the Stimulant still had a few more minutes, so Kai decided to go all out!
Specter Stepallowed him to evade the dangerous counters and attack Atom’s feet to destroy its balance!
However, Atom’s toughness was just too much!
Furthermore, this Sentinel was so heavy.
Kai’s health points were 2,000 in total, and it gave him endurance, but the strain was accumulating.
His muscles burned, his Spirit Points dwindled with each skill activation.
With a few more seconds of his stimulant’s effects, he called out.
"Come on, Atom! Show me what you’ve got!"
