chapters.title: Chapter 197: The Start of the Event
paragraphs: Based on the clues they obtained, it seemed that it was really Angelo’s Shelter!
The swampy terrain surrounded them, and faint outlines of structures could be seen in the background.
Kai smiled...
"Yes... I’m sure of it. This is a shelter. And if it’s Angelo’s..."
Noli nodded. "That’s what I thought too. The way they moved... it didn’t feel random. They were guarding something."
Kai studied the images carefully. His instincts told him this wasn’t a simple shelter...
Angelo had been a threat before, and if this was his base, then Freedom Shelter couldn’t ignore it.
"We’ll need to confirm," Kai said firmly. "But after the Global Event. Right now, our focus is survival. Once that’s over, we’ll deal with Angelo."
Noli hesitated, then asked, "Are we going to raid them?"
Kai’s eyes hardened. "If it’s Angelo, then yes. He’s dangerous. Leaving him alone would be a mistake."
The two stood in silence for a moment...
Finally, Kai handed back the digi‐cam. "Keep this safe. Don’t let anyone else see it yet. We’ll plan carefully when the time comes."
Noli nodded, clutching the device tightly. "Understood, Sir Kai."
Kai leaned back against the wall, closing his eyes briefly.

His body was exhausted from the spar, but his mind was already thinking about the next challenge. The fight with Atom had proven his limits. Now, the looming presence of Angelo’s shelter reminded him that greater battles were still ahead.
For now, though, he allowed himself a moment of rest.
Tomorrow, they had to complete their preparations for the upcoming global event...
Kai’s preparations proceeded smoothly, and soon, the day of the event had finally arrived!
Five days had already passed since the warning from the system!
The Freedom Shelter had fortified its defenses... They had practiced with their new weapons and devices, stocked supplies, and distributed the disruptor units.
The survivors knew that the Global Event was not something they should be afraid of...
At dawn, Kai and every foreign survivor on the continent received the new broadcast.
[ The Global Event: Surveillance Sweep is here! ]
[ Attention Survivors! The countdown has ended. The hostile operation is now active. ]
[ Event Duration: 7 Days

Objective: Survive continuous drone sweeps across all regions. Drones will scan for survivors, marking detected targets for hunter bot deployment. Survivors must hide, jam signals, or destroy drones... or face reinforcements from the Swarmers.
Enemy Composition: Surveillance Drones, Swarmers, Hounds, Hunters, and one unidentified special unit. ]
[ Mechanics:
Drones operate in waves, covering wide areas.
Once marked, hunter bots will arrive within minutes.
Survivors are advised to minimize outdoor activity and prepare countermeasures. ]
[ Rewards ]
[ High Experience Points for every drone destroyed or wave survived.
Rare Loot Drops, including advanced crafting materials.
Survivor’s Medals for those who endure the full event.
Special Devices and fortification upgrades for shelters that repel multiple waves.
Additional hidden rewards may be unlocked by defeating special units or completing undisclosed objectives. ]
[ Notice ]
[ Survivors are reminded: hiding may save lives, but destroying drones will weaken the A.I. Rebel’s army.
The choice is yours... endure quietly, or strike boldly. ]
[ The Surveillance Sweep has begun. The battlefield awaits. ]
Kai lowered the message window as he read it carefully.

Just like the previous information, it would be seven days of continuous sweeps. For many, survival meant hiding in the shadows, praying the drones passed them by. But for Kai, this was an opportunity.
"Seven days..." he muttered. "Either we hide, or we use this chance to cut down the A.I. Rebel’s army."
Mei smiled as he looked at Kai. "Do you think we can really fight them all?"

Kai shook his head. "No way... We’ll observe how strong they are at first. We don’t need to fight them all. But every drone we destroy weakens their numbers and increases the level of our members. If we want Freedom Shelter to stand against Angelo later, we can’t just hide. We need strength. If possible, I want you all to reach Level 30."
This was a pretty obvious decision...
The Global Event had begun, and for the next seven days, they would have to protect themselves.
Kai ordered everyone into the main building’s basement.
The heavy steel doors were shut tight, and the survivors gathered in silence.
For now, only the Portable Signal Jammer from his Enhanced Gift Pack was activated...
This small device gave a faint hum filling the room with 43 people inside...
It wasn’t as powerful as the portable disruptor field units, but it was enough to mask their presence for now.
"Stay quiet," Kai whispered. "No one moves until I say."
The tension was escalating as Kai felt that the enemies were coming...
Dozens of survivors huddled together, rifles clutched tightly, as they looked toward the ceiling...
Apparently, the faint buzzing of drones echoed outside.
’They’re already here... That’s fast.’
Indeed, the first batch of surveillance drones arrived as they swept across the sky. Their red sensors scanned the terrain, but no movements came back..
The survivors held their breath.
Still, they learned that the jammer worked as the drones passed overhead without detecting them.
Minutes dragged on, and finally, the buzzing faded! Relief washed over the group, but it didn’t last that long!
From outside, a new sound emerged...
This time, the sound was sharper and seemed more erratic.
Without a doubt, the Swarmers had arrived!
Everyone also recognized this sound!
These insect‐like drones, each the size of a human head, flew and hovered around the shelter. They were lurking around the walls as they searched for openings!
Unlike the surveillance drones, they weren’t just passing by. They were probing, testing, trying to find a way inside!
"They’re hunting, huh..." Mei muttered as she also felt their presence.
As for the slaves, they definitely felt scared. But they just had to trust the group.
Soon, even the Swarmers scraped against windows and vents...
One of them even latched onto a ventilation. Then, another hovered near the basement hatch, scanning for weaknesses...
The jammer kept their signals distorted, but Kai knew it wouldn’t last forever. The Swarmers were persistent, and if they found even the smallest gap, they would pour inside!

sentences.text: Based on the clues they obtained, it seemed that it was really Angelo’s Shelter!
The swampy terrain surrounded them, and faint outlines of structures could be seen in the background.
Kai smiled...
"Yes...
I’m sure of it.
This is a shelter.
And if it’s Angelo’s..."
Noli nodded.
"That’s what I thought too.
The way they moved... it didn’t feel random.
They were guarding something."
Kai studied the images carefully.
His instincts told him this wasn’t a simple shelter...
Angelo had been a threat before, and if this was his base, then Freedom Shelter couldn’t ignore it.
"We’ll need to confirm," Kai said firmly.
"But after the Global Event.
Right now, our focus is survival.
Once that’s over, we’ll deal with Angelo."
Noli hesitated, then asked, "Are we going to raid them?"
Kai’s eyes hardened.
"If it’s Angelo, then yes.
He’s dangerous.
Leaving him alone would be a mistake."
The two stood in silence for a moment...
Finally, Kai handed back the digi‐cam.
"Keep this safe.
Don’t let anyone else see it yet.
We’ll plan carefully when the time comes."
Noli nodded, clutching the device tightly.
"Understood, Sir Kai."
Kai leaned back against the wall, closing his eyes briefly.
His body was exhausted from the spar, but his mind was already thinking about the next challenge.
The fight with Atom had proven his limits.
Now, the looming presence of Angelo’s shelter reminded him that greater battles were still ahead.
For now, though, he allowed himself a moment of rest.
Tomorrow, they had to complete their preparations for the upcoming global event...
Kai’s preparations proceeded smoothly, and soon, the day of the event had finally arrived!
Five days had already passed since the warning from the system!
The Freedom Shelter had fortified its defenses...
They had practiced with their new weapons and devices, stocked supplies, and distributed the disruptor units.
The survivors knew that the Global Event was not something they should be afraid of...
At dawn, Kai and every foreign survivor on the continent received the new broadcast.
[ The Global Event: Surveillance Sweep is here! ]
[ Attention Survivors!
The countdown has ended.
The hostile operation is now active. ]
[ Event Duration: 7 Days
Objective: Survive continuous drone sweeps across all regions.
Drones will scan for survivors, marking detected targets for hunter bot deployment.
Survivors must hide, jam signals, or destroy drones... or face reinforcements from the Swarmers.
Enemy Composition: Surveillance Drones, Swarmers, Hounds, Hunters, and one unidentified special unit. ]
[ Mechanics:
Drones operate in waves, covering wide areas.
Once marked, hunter bots will arrive within minutes.
Survivors are advised to minimize outdoor activity and prepare countermeasures. ]
[ Rewards ]
[ High Experience Points for every drone destroyed or wave survived.
Rare Loot Drops, including advanced crafting materials.
Survivor’s Medals for those who endure the full event.
Special Devices and fortification upgrades for shelters that repel multiple waves.
Additional hidden rewards may be unlocked by defeating special units or completing undisclosed objectives. ]
[ Notice ]
[ Survivors are reminded: hiding may save lives, but destroying drones will weaken the A.I.
Rebel’s army.
The choice is yours... endure quietly, or strike boldly. ]
[ The Surveillance Sweep has begun.
The battlefield awaits. ]
Kai lowered the message window as he read it carefully.
Just like the previous information, it would be seven days of continuous sweeps.
For many, survival meant hiding in the shadows, praying the drones passed them by.
But for Kai, this was an opportunity.
"Seven days..." he muttered.
"Either we hide, or we use this chance to cut down the A.I.
Rebel’s army."
Mei smiled as he looked at Kai.
"Do you think we can really fight them all?"
Kai shook his head.
"No way...
We’ll observe how strong they are at first.
We don’t need to fight them all.
But every drone we destroy weakens their numbers and increases the level of our members.
If we want Freedom Shelter to stand against Angelo later, we can’t just hide.
We need strength.
If possible, I want you all to reach Level 30."
This was a pretty obvious decision...
The Global Event had begun, and for the next seven days, they would have to protect themselves.
Kai ordered everyone into the main building’s basement.
The heavy steel doors were shut tight, and the survivors gathered in silence.
For now, only the Portable Signal Jammer from his Enhanced Gift Pack was activated...
This small device gave a faint hum filling the room with 43 people inside...
It wasn’t as powerful as the portable disruptor field units, but it was enough to mask their presence for now.
"Stay quiet," Kai whispered.
"No one moves until I say."
The tension was escalating as Kai felt that the enemies were coming...
Dozens of survivors huddled together, rifles clutched tightly, as they looked toward the ceiling...
Apparently, the faint buzzing of drones echoed outside.
’They’re already here...
That’s fast.’
Indeed, the first batch of surveillance drones arrived as they swept across the sky.
Their red sensors scanned the terrain, but no movements came back..
The survivors held their breath.
Still, they learned that the jammer worked as the drones passed overhead without detecting them.
Minutes dragged on, and finally, the buzzing faded!
Relief washed over the group, but it didn’t last that long!
From outside, a new sound emerged...
This time, the sound was sharper and seemed more erratic.
Without a doubt, the Swarmers had arrived!
Everyone also recognized this sound!
These insect‐like drones, each the size of a human head, flew and hovered around the shelter.
They were lurking around the walls as they searched for openings!
Unlike the surveillance drones, they weren’t just passing by.
They were probing, testing, trying to find a way inside!
"They’re hunting, huh..." Mei muttered as she also felt their presence.
As for the slaves, they definitely felt scared.
But they just had to trust the group.
Soon, even the Swarmers scraped against windows and vents...
One of them even latched onto a ventilation.
Then, another hovered near the basement hatch, scanning for weaknesses...
The jammer kept their signals distorted, but Kai knew it wouldn’t last forever.
The Swarmers were persistent, and if they found even the smallest gap, they would pour inside!

chapters.title: Chapter 198: The Swarmers
paragraphs: The survivors waited in silence while listening to the faint hum of the jammer and the scraping noises above.
They didn’t want to be discovered by the noise... None of them would want that to happen.
At this time, Kai’s eyes squinted as he focused on the vibrations coming from the walls.
At first, it seemed the Swarmers were simply probing. But then, a sharper sound cut through the air...
There was a sizzling hiss, followed by the faint glow of heat.
’What?!’
He didn’t even have to use his skill to know what was happening. His instincts alone could tell him what was going on.
’They’re cutting...’
Sure enough, the Swarmers had deployed thin, heated blades from their appendages.

The insect‐like drones pressed against the barricades, slowly slicing through barbed wire, metal sheets, and wooden planks that they used to cover their windows and other entry spots like ventilation.
Just like that, sparks were everywhere as the blades carved shallow grooves into the defenses. It might take a long time, but it was definitely happening.
As soon as everyone realized that it was happening, many of the workers couldn’t help but feel worried.
Some raised their rifles, but Kai motioned for them to hold.
"Not yet," he whispered. "Wait."
The scraping grew louder. One Swarmer clung to a window frame with its blade melting through the metal bars. Another hovered near the basement hatch, carving into the steel very slowly...
Needless to say, fear rippled through the group of workers.
These freed slaves could still remember how they were exploited by the machines... They exchanged nervous glances, clutching their weapons tighter.
As time passed, even Mei’s expression hardened as she watched the drones work.
"They’re really trying to breach," Aurora muttered as she readied for a fight.
Kai, however, remained calm...
He knew the jammer couldn’t stop physical intrusion. If the Swarmers succeeded, the shelter would be exposed.
But he was trying to see their limit for now. He even ordered Atom not to act yet.
But then, just as the cuts began to deepen, the sound shifted.
The Swarmers paused...
One by one, they disengaged from the barricades!
"Hmm?" Mei was confused as she also sensed what was going on outside.
Without warning, they pulled back before rising into the air.
The heated blades retracted, and the drones hovered briefly before darting away into the sky.
The survivors blinked in confusion.
"Why did they leave?" one of the younger survivors whispered.
Mei frowned. "Maybe they have a time limit?"
Aurora nodded thoughtfully. "Right... they’re also running on battery. They must reserve enough power for their return trip. Cutting through defenses drains energy fast."
Kai nodded... This was actually what he wanted to know. He wanted to have a clear view of their operating time.
"They’re persistent, but not limitless. That’s about 15 minutes..."
The group settled slightly, though the tension remained.
They had learned something important... They were now aware of how these enemies operate!

Basically, the surveillance drones scanned from above. However, the Swarmers weren’t just doing the same. They were capable of direct intrusion. Their heated blades could slice through almost any obstruction given enough time.
Kai couldn’t help but smile as he realized this.
’If they had more power, they could have breached us already... We can’t rely on barricades alone. Their next arrival has to be dealt with.’
"Alright... We’re going to stop the next drones and swarmers..." Kai announced.
"Perfect! Should I move out now? I also want to see whether they could sense my camouflage or not." Mei replied enthusiastically.
"Yes... Make sure to be close to the secret tunnel." Kai replied.
Just like that, the plan had changed.
Minutes passed as the survivors prepared themselves.
At this time, they had already activated their Portable Disruptor!
The sound of this device was a bit quieter compared to the Portable Jammer.
"They’re coming..." Kai muttered.
Everyone went silent as they heard this.
As expected, another batch of surveillance drones swept across the sky.
Their sensors scanned the terrain with beams of red light passing through their shelters.
Again, the jammer held, and the drones passed overhead without detection.
But soon after, the familiar erratic buzzing sound returned.
The Swarmers were back!
Kai then turned to his team.
"We already know how they operate," he said firmly.
"It’s time to stop watching. This time, we will destroy them all..."
The survivors looked at him and nodded.
Aside from their Survival Clothing Set, they were all equipped with spears and guns. They were confident of winning this!
Amer nodded. "Yes... We can’t just sit here. If they keep probing, eventually they’ll find a way in. I want to raise my level too!"
Aurora smiled since this was also her aim... She needed to level up!
Soon, as the buzzing grew louder once more and confirmed that the Swarmers had arrived, they finally made their move, giving Mei a signal to attack!
A few moments ago, outside the shelter, Mei’s figure dissolved into the walls as her camouflage skill activated.
She crouched near the tunnel entrance, waiting...
As the drones swept overhead with their sensors, Mei remained undetected as they simply passed her! None reacted to her presence.
’Still the same tech, huh...’Mei mused as she confirmed her guess.
It seemed that their detection technology didn’t change even after the event started.
Moments later, the Swarmers descended again...
This time, Mei received the signal and shot one of the Swarmer!
Bang!
At the same time, the main door and the basement hatch swung open, and thirty survivors poured out with their carbines equipped with suppressors!
Just like that, the courtyard erupted in muffled gunfire.
Pfft‐pfft‐pfft!
One after another, the insect‐like drones dropped from the air!
Within minutes, twenty‐nine Swarmers lay broken across the ground. But one managed to escape, as it shot into the sky!
Kai’s eyes followed it and confirmed the direction it escaped to. "That one will call for backup."
He didn’t mind it at all... Instead, he raised his rifle and warned the others. "Ready for the real battle!"
Sure enough, fifteen minutes later, the ground trembled faintly...
The Hunter Units had arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 199: The Hunter
paragraphs: Thud... Thud...
The enemies had finally arrived.
Kai raised his head as he looked at the silhouettes of the supposedly Hunter Units of the A.I. Army.
’Wait... It’s alone?’Kai was shocked.
He thought that they would be facing multiple Hunter Units!
However, his shock didn’t end yet. The appearance of the Hunters surprised him even more.
At first, he thought the Hunters would resemble assassins.
Well, based on their names, he imagined them to be dark, humanoid killers armed with daggers, rifles, or plasma weapons that could instant-kill their targets.
But what stepped into view shattered his imagination.
The figure was humanoid, and certainly, it was cloaked in high‐tech fabric that faintly absorbs the surrounding light...
The cloak even rippled like liquid shadow, making the Hunter appear half‐invisible as it advanced.
Then Kai saw the thing on its back...
There were two mechanical, octopus‐like tentacles extended from a Hunter’s back! It was writhing and curling like they were alive!
The appendages moved independently, scanning the terrain, occasionally striking the ground with metallic sound...
’What the heck? Doctor Octo?’
Without a doubt, the tentacles weren’t just decoration! They were weapons, sensors, and tools all at once.
Kai couldn’t help but feel a little disappointed...
’Tentacles... I didn’t expect this.’
Furthermore, the Hunter’s face was hidden beneath an angular helmet with a visor that was glowing with a blue light.
Then, unlike Sentinels or Spyders, the Hunter carried no rifles.
Their arms ended not in hands, but in blades!
"Ah... Blades?" Kai was shocked once more as he just realized what he was seeing.
Instead of hands, the Hunter had long, sharpened extensions of their forearms.
Fighting against a Hunter Unit in close combat would be terrifying!
Now, Kai knew that this event, which would last for 7 days, would not be easy!
’No plasma rifles... no ranged weapons. They’re built for close combat for sure...’
He then studied the Hunter’s legs, half expecting them to end in blades as well.
But no, their feet were standard, humanoid in shape, designed for speed and agility. That detail made these units less outrageous, but no less terrifying.
The survivors murmured behind him, unsettled by the sight of the new A.I. Soldier...
Kai exhaled slowly, forcing himself to remain calm.
"So this is the Hunter Unit..." he muttered. "It looks strong, but we’re also strong..."
"Yes... They’re not assassins. Something else entirely." Mei agreed. She had imagined them wrong.
"They look like predators. They’re not going to be easy," She added after observing them for a bit.
Aurora, however, felt the dangerous enemy’s presence and immediately retreated.
"Those tentacles... they’re scanning us."
Kai nodded at this.
"Yes. I think they’re built to chase and cut down survivors. They have no rifles... Just blades and speed... Close combat is not an option."
Indeed, the Hunter moved closer, with their cloaks making them really hard to notice... It was as if it was shifting in and out of visibility.
Thud... Thud...
As it moved, the tentacles scraped against the ground, leaving faint marks everywhere...
Kai’s grip tightened on his rifle as the lone Hunter advanced.
"Ready!" Kai shouted.
The survivors raised their weapons with a hint of nervousness on their faces.
"Aim!"
Dozens of rifles locked onto the Hunter.
"Fire!"
The courtyard was filled with muffled gunfire.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Bullets struck the Hunter’s armor again and again... However, only sparks were flying as the rounds bounced off.
The enemy only slowed under the barrage as the shots did little damage!
Kai frowned, seeing this...
They emptied their magazines, but it was not enough!
’It’s only being slowed... no penetration.’
This wasn’t like the weaker E‐Grade or D‐Grade machines they had fought before. The Hunter’s armor was thick!
The survivors kept firing, but the Hunter slowly crept forward...
It raised its arms and soon most rounds ricocheted harmlessly off its armor plating!
Kai gritted his teeth...
’This thing... it’s at least B‐Grade. Maybe even A‐Grade.’
The Hunter seemed to have adjusted to their attacks and soon, its tentacles slammed into the ground!
Bang!
The survivors hesitated as fear spread through the line.
Kai didn’t hesitate. "Atom! Join the battle!"
From the side, Atom stepped forward, its heavy frame looked as reliable as ever!
The A‐Grade Sentinel raised its plasma rifle as it locked onto the Hunter!
A burst of plasma fire erupted, searing through the air.
Fwoosh~
The shots struck the Hunter squarely, forcing it to stagger back.
Unlike the bullets, the plasma burned into its armor, leaving faint scorch marks across its chest.
The survivors cheered as they finally saw some hope!
But the Hunter didn’t fall.
It steadied itself with the tentacles whipping outward as if enraged!
Thud! Thud!
The Hunter advanced again, slower now, but it seemed as if it was unstoppable!
Kai’s heart pounded.
’Even that plasma shot can’t finish it quickly... this thing is definitely a high-grade one...’
"Keep firing!" he shouted. "Don’t let it close the distance!"
Atom unleashed another volley with its plasma bolts, hammering into the Hunter.
The survivors added their fire, shooting it from every angle.
Perhaps, if there were three more... or maybe even one more Hunter, they might actually get into trouble!
Thud! Thud! Thud!
The Hunter’s cloak flickered violently as it endured the gunfire...
Still, it was being pushed back, but not destroyed.
’Seriously... Why are you too strong?’
This was only one Hunter, and it was already testing their limits.
Mei and everyone else had similar thoughts...
’If more arrive... Freedom Shelter will face hell itself.’
Kai no longer hesitated as he knew he needed to act...
"Cover me!" Kai shouted.
The survivors understood as they unleashed another volley to keep the Hunter’s attention. Atom’s plasma rifle also forced the machine to stagger.
Kai took a deep breath as he began with his plan...
Well, his plan was simple, he needed to get behind it and unleash his strongest Gene Skill, Spirit Pulse!
He then signaled for the others to stop firing!
As soon as the path was clear, Kai’s body vanished.
In an instant, he reappeared behind the Hunter with his afterimage still lingering in front of it. It was the Specter Step that cost 20 SP!
Kai then raised his hand as Spirit energy surged through his body, gathering in his palm.
It was his Spirit Pulse!
But before he could aim it properly, one of the mechanical tentacles shot backward in an instant!
Clank!
The mechanical tentacle was already inches from his face!

Perhaps, if there were three more... or maybe even one more Hunter, they might actually get into trouble!
Thud!
Thud!
Thud!
The Hunter’s cloak flickered violently as it endured the gunfire...
Still, it was being pushed back, but not destroyed.
’Seriously...
Why are you too strong?’
This was only one Hunter, and it was already testing their limits.
Mei and everyone else had similar thoughts...
’If more arrive...
Freedom Shelter will face hell itself.’
Kai no longer hesitated as he knew he needed to act...
"Cover me!" Kai shouted.
The survivors understood as they unleashed another volley to keep the Hunter’s attention.
Atom’s plasma rifle also forced the machine to stagger.
Kai took a deep breath as he began with his plan...
Well, his plan was simple, he needed to get behind it and unleash his strongest Gene Skill, Spirit Pulse!
He then signaled for the others to stop firing!
As soon as the path was clear, Kai’s body vanished.
In an instant, he reappeared behind the Hunter with his afterimage still lingering in front of it.
It was the Specter Step that cost 20 SP!
Kai then raised his hand as Spirit energy surged through his body, gathering in his palm.
It was his Spirit Pulse!
But before he could aim it properly, one of the mechanical tentacles shot backward in an instant!
Clank!
The mechanical tentacle was already inches from his face!

paragraphs: Kai could only release the Spirit Pulse to the ground as the mechanical tentacle was already close to his face!
Boom!
The impact created a shockwave that forced him back. Kai avoided the attack, but the tentacle of the Hunter Unit could lengthen itself!
This time, Kai turned his body, barely dodging the move...
Thud!
The tentacle only smashed into the ground, leaving a deep crack.
"Boss!" Amer shouted. "Are you okay?"
He was really worried just now. To be exact, the others were also afraid that their leader was caught in that attack! It was just too close!
Thankfully, they didn’t see any blood splatter.
Kai gritted his teeth and nodded. "I’m fine! Keep firing!"
The survivors obeyed. They had no time for a break! Their rifles were triggered as they poured bullets into the Hunter.
Clank... Clank... Clank...
Sparks flew, but the monster kept advancing. Its armor wasn’t being penetrated or damaged by their normal bullets at all.
Atom stepped forward and used its plasma rifle again...
Fwoosh!
A burst of plasma slammed into the Hunter’s chest, burning through its cloak.
The machine stepped back, and now, it seemed as if the light in its visor grew brighter!
Mei’s eyes widened. "It’s angry now!"
"Hey! That’s a machine... Why would it get angry?" Aurora reminded Mei before she reloaded her gun.
"I’m sure it will have a similar reaction..." Mei replied.
At this time, the Hunter spun with its blade arms, slicing through the air!
The tentacles lashed out, sweeping across the courtyard.
Survivors ducked and rolled, barely avoiding the deadly strikes.
Aurora shouted, "Stay spread out! Don’t let it hit us all at once!"
Then, the cooldown on Kai’s skill finally dropped, so he used Specter Step to get closer!
He reappeared at the Hunter’s side, his afterimage confusing the machine for a moment.
"Atom, cover me!" Kai yelled.
Atom fired another volley, plasma bolts struck into the Hunter’s armor! The survivors added their shots, forcing the monster to focus forward.
Kai took the chance. He raised his hand and released another spell that cost 70 Spirit Points!
Spirit Pulse!
Boom!
A wave of Spirit energy burst from his palm, slamming into the Hunter’s side. The cloak ripped apart, and one tentacle was blown back, sparking violently.
Thankfully, all their attacks from the very start had already dropped the Hunter’s durability!
"Yes!" Amer cheered.
"You hit it!"
But the Hunter didn’t fall yet. It steadied itself with the remaining mechanical tentacle and charged at Kai with both blade arms.
Since the Specter Step was still on cooldown, Kai used his leg strength to back away!
He didn’t have the confidence to block its attack with his axe after all.
He might be able to endure the attack, but his axe might get cut in half!
"Too close..." Kai muttered.
The Hunter then made a grinding noise like its mechanical gears were overheating...
But then, it started attacking any Survivor that was caught in its line of sight!
The Hunter dashed and slammed into a wall, smashing it apart!
The Survivors were able to dodge in time but the Hunter was quick to recover. It tentacle moved and swept across the ground, knocking two survivors off their feet.
"Help them!" Aurora shouted, rushing to pull the fallen men back.
Mei darted forward, with her Silent Veins skill, making her concealment better...
After seeing an opportunity, she struck at the Hunter’s leg with her blade!
Clank!
The blade hit its target, but the armor was too thick. Sparks were there, but no damage was caused.
"It’s too strong!" she cried.
Kai clenched his fists. "Then we work together. Atom, keep burning it! Everyone, aim for the tentacles! Mei, distract it!"
Everyone moved at once.
Atom unleashed another plasma volley, forcing the Hunter to step back...
The survivors aimed carefully, firing at the writhing tentacle...
Bullets were finally chipping at the joints, slowing its movements.

Mei also kept her presence close to the Hunter to ensure that she was being targeted by the enemy.. After all, she was probably the fastest among the group, and being able to take the aggro would be the best for everyone.
Soon, Kai charged again with Spirit energy gathering in his palm. "One more time!"
Boom!
The Spirit Pulse slammed into the Hunter’s back, tearing off part of its cloak and removing its last tentacle!
The machine stumbled, and its movements were now slower!
Aurora shouted, "It’s working! Keep pushing!"
The survivors cheered as they could finally see hope!
But the Hunter wasn’t finished. Its visor glowed red, and suddenly its cloak changed!
In an instant, it vanished.
"What?!" Amer gasped. "Where did it go?"
The survivors looked around and started panicking...
Kai frowned as he relied on his Keen Sense...
"It’s not gone..."
The courtyard fell silent, only the faint hum of Atom’s plasma rifle filling the air...
Then—
Clank!
The Hunter reappeared behind two survivors, its blade arms slashing down.
"Look out!" Aurora screamed.
The men dove aside, one barely escaping as the blades cut into the ground... Unfortunately, the other survivor was not lucky enough to dodge it!
Kai used his Specter Step again after its cooldown was dropped and appeared at the Hunter’s side. He swung his glowing hand, releasing another Spirit Pulse.
This was the last Spirit Pulse he could use!
Boom!
The blast struck the Hunter’s helmet, cracking the visor. The machine stepped back with its cloak malfunctioning...
Finally, Atom seized the chance.
Fwoosh!
A plasma burst slammed into the Hunter’s chest. The armor glowed red, then cracked.
Mei also moved as she struck the exposed joint and made the Hunter kneel...
As Kai and Mei stepped back, everyone else fired their guns...
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The Hunter staggered, its movements slowing.
Kai raised his hand one last time. This time, it wasn’t to cast another Spell but to use his fist!
Bam!
The Hunter’s head exploded with a punch containing all of his strength!
